title: Associate Portfolio Advisor
description:

Experience :• Minimum 2 to 4 years of investment experience working in investment services industry

$114,540 - 194,580 USD

title: Power Generation Technician – CAT Generator Operations
description:
Power Generation Technician – CAT Generator Operations

​

Location: McKinney, Texas.

Work Arrangement: On-site | Project-Based (2 months)


Position Overview

PRISMECS is seeking experienced Power Generation Technicians for a temporary power project in McKinney, Texas. The technicians will support the safe and reliable operation and monitoring of fourteen CAT 2 MW diesel generator units.

This assignment is expected to last approximately two months. Technicians will work closely with the customer, PRISMECS project management, and the qualified electrical professional assigned to the site.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate and monitor CAT diesel generator units during scheduled operating hours.
  • Perform routine equipment walkdowns and visual inspections.
  • Monitor operating parameters, alarms, temperatures, pressures, fluid levels, and overall generator performance.
  • Complete daily operating logs, shift reports, and equipment status documentation.
  • Perform basic preventive checks and minor operational troubleshooting within the technician’s qualifications.
  • Identify abnormal operating conditions and promptly escalate mechanical or electrical concerns.
  • Assist with generator startup, shutdown, loading, unloading, and operational checks as directed.
  • Coordinate with the on-site qualified electrical professional regarding electrical conditions and equipment safety.
  • Follow site safety procedures, including lockout/tagout, required PPE, and established operating protocols.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.
  • Support shift handovers by communicating equipment status, alarms, open issues, and completed activities.
​

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience operating, monitoring, or maintaining industrial diesel generators or temporary power systems.
  • Experience with large CAT generator units or similar multi-megawatt power-generation equipment is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of diesel engines, generator controls, alarms, fuel systems, cooling systems, and basic electrical-generation principles.
  • Ability to recognize abnormal operating conditions and follow escalation procedures.
  • Ability to accurately complete logs, reports, and shift documentation.
  • Strong safety awareness and experience following lockout/tagout procedures.
  • Ability to work 12-hour shifts in an industrial or outdoor project environment.
  • Ability to stand, walk, climb, bend, and perform routine equipment inspections throughout the shift.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting temporary, rental, standby, or prime-power generator installations.
  • CAT generator operation or maintenance experience.
  • OSHA 10, OSHA 30, NFPA 70E, LOTO, or related safety training.
  • Previous experience working on data-center, utility, construction, industrial, or temporary-power projects.
  • Mechanical or electrical troubleshooting experience.

U.S. Work Authorization & Location Requirement


U.S.-based candidates only. Candidates must currently be based in the United States, be able to work on site in McKinney, Texas (or relocate to the area), and be legally authorized to work in the U.S. for Prismecs without current or future employer sponsorship. Prismecs is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

title: Data Centre Engineer - Storage, Compute and Virtualisation
description:
Role Purpose

The Data Centre Engineer designs, implements and maintains enterprise compute, storage and virtualisation platforms, ensuring that core Data Centre services are secure, resilient, scalable and capable of supporting critical business operations.

Role Purpose

The Data Centre Engineer designs, implements and maintains enterprise compute, storage and virtualisation platforms, ensuring that core Data Centre services are secure, resilient, scalable and capable of supporting critical business operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operational Stability: Monitor system performance and environmental conditions, identify and elevate potential issues, and follow standard operating procedures. Participate in incident, problem, change and lifecycle management, including the on-call rota. Contribute to disaster recovery, resilience and business continuity planning.

title: Director, Data and AI Platform Engineering Lead
description:

Our team provides technology services to Finance, People and Engagement, supporting the functions that underpin Macquarie's people, communications, strategy and financial management activities. Working at the centre of a highly connected and global environment, we deliver technology solutions that enable business performance, support informed decision making, strengthen governance, and help drive innovation through data and artificial intelligence.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you're empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

What role will you play?

In this role you will lead our enterprise Data and Artificial Intelligence Platform, providing strategic, technical and people leadership across a large global team of platform engineers, data engineers and data risk professionals. You will partner closely with senior business and technology leaders to define the platform vision, strategy and roadmap, while ensuring the delivery of secure, scalable and compliant data capabilities that support multiple business groups.

You will act as the key point of contact for platform stakeholders, oversee platform operations and engineering delivery, manage strategic vendor relationships, and drive strong engineering, governance and risk management practices. You will have the opportunity to embed artificial intelligence capabilities into the development lifecycle, support the adoption of compliant artificial intelligence platforms, optimise platform performance and costs, and lead the resolution of significant operational, risk and audit matters.

  • Strong expertise in defining and delivering enterprise data platform strategies, operational excellence frameworks and governance practices across complex organisations
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, manage strategic technology partners and vendors, and achieve outcomes across matrix environments

What we offer

At Macquarie, you're empowered to shape a career that's rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on employment type, include:

Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We're a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Description

TensorX is a sovereign AI infrastructure platform headquartered in Dublin. We deploy and host open-source large language models on EU-sovereign infrastructure across Europe, providing private, zero-retention inference for regulated industries including finance, healthcare and government. Our platform offers drop-in OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling developers and enterprises alike to adopt AI without compromising on data privacy, compliance or performance.

We are looking for Full-Stack Engineers at various levels to join our growing engineering team. You will take ownership of features across the entire product surface, from our customer-facing dashboard and billing systems through to our backend API services and infrastructure tooling. This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving scaleup where your work will directly shape the platform our customers rely on.

You will work across multiple projects, primarily in TypeScript, spanning a React/Next.js frontend and a Node.js/Express API layer backed by PostgreSQL and Redis/Valkey. Frontend development is a key part of this role, and you will be responsible for building the interfaces our customers and their agents interact with daily. We are an AI-native team and tools such as Claude Code and Codex are part of our standard workflow, not an experiment. We value engineers who can deliver polished, accessible user experiences while also contributing to robust backend services.

Responsibilities
  • Feature Delivery - Design, build and ship end-to-end features spanning the frontend dashboard, REST API and database layers, taking work from specification through to production deployment.
  • Frontend Development - Build responsive, accessible and performant interfaces using React and Next.js with server-side rendering, middleware and modern routing patterns. Implement design systems using headless component primitives and utility-first CSS.
  • Backend & API Development - Develop and maintain RESTful API services in Node.js/Express with full TypeScript type safety. Design relational database schemas and write performant SQL. Implement caching, rate limiting and background job processing.
  • Testing & Reliability - Write and maintain automated tests across the stack, including unit, integration and end-to-end tests. Champion testing best practices and help build a culture of confidence in deployments.
  • Authentication & Security - Own and evolve our authentication and authorisation systems, including JWT-based auth flows, role-based access control and security hardening throughout the platform.
  • Payments & Integrations - Build and maintain third-party integrations including payment processing, cryptocurrency payment flows, transactional email, bot protection and customer messaging.
  • Infrastructure & DevOps - Manage containerised development and deployment workflows using Docker within a cloud-native environment. Maintain CI/CD pipelines and contribute to platform reliability.
  • Code Quality & Collaboration - Participate in code reviews, contribute to architectural decisions and help establish best practices. Share knowledge and support your teammates across the engineering team.
Skills & Experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience building full-stack web applications
  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript across frontend and backend codebases
  • Strong frontend skills with React and Next.js (SSR, App Router, middleware), headless component libraries (e.g. Radix UI, shadcn/ui) and utility-first CSS frameworks
  • Solid backend experience with Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL (schema design, raw SQL) and Redis/Valkey
  • Practical experience with authentication systems, role-based access control and web security practices
  • Familiarity with payment platform integration (e.g. Stripe). Experience with cryptocurrency payment protocols is desirable
  • Experience with Docker and containerised deployment workflows
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) as part of your daily workflow
  • A clear and concise communicator who thrives in ambiguity and can articulate technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences
Nice to Have
  • Experience working with large language models, including areas such as prompt engineering, context engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, evaluation and model deployment
  • Experience with AWS and related services (e.g. EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, CloudFront)
  • Exposure to Python and Golang
Education & Qualifications

BSc/MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline OR equivalent practical experience

Remuneration
  • Highly competitive package, dependent on experience
  • 25 days paid annual leave
  • Hybrid working from our centrally located Dublin office
  • Free inference tokens!

There may be instances where this person is asked to provide coverage along the I-95 corridor between Baltimore and Washington DC, as well as occasional day travel to other areas within the Mid-Atlantic region. This territory includes high-visibility sites serving federal facilities, national monuments, WMATA transit infrastructure, and dense urban environments in both downtown Washington DC and downtown Baltimore, requiring a technician who is comfortable operating in complex, access-controlled environments and responding to elevated-priority situations.

The Field Technician role involves applying technical knowledge to maintain and improve network performance and reliability. It involves providing technical assistance, managing smaller projects, and contributing to operational process improvements. The role requires understanding of radio access networks, backhaul, signaling, disaster recovery, data services, and location-based services. Success is measured by effective technical support, timely project updates, and identification of process improvements. The work directly impacts network stability and service quality for organizational and customer needs.

Main responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support to resolve network performance issues and contribute to outage resolution efforts
  • Manage smaller projects or project segments, delivering accurate status and progress updates as required
  • Identify and recommend process improvements related to maintenance and repair activities to senior staff and management
  • Assist in developing job aids, scopes of work, and procedural documentation in collaboration with senior technicians
  • Complete required training to maintain current knowledge of systems, products, and organizational standards
  • Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed

Education and Work Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent (Required)
    • Acceptable areas of study include Vocational/Technical Training or related field (Preferred)
  • 2-4 years - Working experience in Field Operations and maintenance.
  • 2-4 years - Wireless telecommunications or other related experience.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Electronics (Required)
    • Basic operational knowledge and theory of all interconnecting circuits to include but not limited to RF transmitters, antenna systems, AAV, fiber, microwave radio and AC-DC power systems, and AI.
  • Radio Access Network (RAN) – Practical knowledge of RAN architecture, components, and operations, with the ability to support deployment, maintenance, and optimization activities. (Required)
    • Experience with Ericsson RAN technology is a plus.
  • Wireless Backhaul – Understanding of wireless backhaul technologies and configurations used to connect cell sites to the core network, including microwave and fiber-based solutions. (Required)
    • Licensed Microwave and millimeter-wave wireless transport technology – Ceragon and Ericsson experience is a plus
  • 5G New Radio (NR) – Demonstrated experience with, or the ability to learn, Radio Access Network (RAN) equipment and 5G NR standards as they apply to field operations. (Required)
  • Base Station – Working knowledge of base station equipment, installation, configuration, and maintenance as it relates to network performance and reliability. (Required)
  • Continuous Development – Candidates are expected to actively grow their skills through ongoing training, certifications, and hands-on experience in an ever-evolving telecommunications landscape. (Required)
  • Disaster Recovery Planning – Familiarity with disaster recovery protocols and the ability to implement contingency plans to restore network services with minimal disruption. (Required)
  • Network Troubleshooting – Ability to systematically identify, diagnose, and resolve network issues across a range of hardware and software systems in both planned and emergency scenarios. (Required)
  • Project Management – Ability to plan, coordinate, and complete field assignments efficiently, managing time, resources, and priorities to meet deadlines and service commitments. (Required)
  • Technical Support – Ability to provide hands-on technical assistance and field-level support to internal teams and partners, ensuring timely resolution of equipment and network issues. (Required)
  • Attention To Detail (Required)
  • Problem Solving / Troubleshooting - Solves problems using creativity and innovation. (Required)
  • Computer Fluency – Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and similar productivity tools. Includes an understanding of Internet Protocol and a willingness to incorporate AI-driven tools when preparing and triaging solutions for logical network components. (Required)
  • Ability to use fiber test, line and antenna test equipment. (Preferred)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. (Preferred)
  • Self-motivated; exhibits initiative in achieving company goals and objectives. (Preferred)
  • Basic leadership skills and ability to prioritize and complete multiple tasks. (Preferred)

description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at . Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.


Business Unit Overview:

Blackstone is a global leader in real estate investing. Blackstone’s real estate business was founded in 1991 and has US $314 billion of investor capital under management. Blackstone is the largest owner of commercial real estate globally, owning and operating assets across every major geography and sector, including logistics, data centers, residential, office and hospitality. Our opportunistic funds seek to acquire undermanaged, well-located assets across the world. Blackstone’s Core+ business invests in substantially stabilized real estate assets globally, through both institutional strategies and strategies tailored for income-focused individual investors including Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. (BREIT). Blackstone Real Estate also operates one of the leading global real estate debt businesses, providing comprehensive financing solutions across the capital structure and risk spectrum, including management of Blackstone Mortgage Trust (NYSE: BXMT).


Job Title: Associate


Job Description:

This professional will be responsible for strategic support of the valuations effort and its related functions globally across Blackstone’s opportunistic and core+ strategies. The Associate will play a key role in Blackstone Real Estate’s valuations effort. This will involve a) coordination of the execution and outcomes of U.S. valuations, b) consolidation and analysis of global valuations outcomes, and c) execution of summary valuation-related materials and analysis. The role will involve partnership in coordinating key internal and external processes, consolidating and analyzing outcomes and metrics as well as delivering supporting documentation and materials to internal and external stakeholders. This professional will work closely with members asset management, finance, fund-specific and portfolio company teams to execute and enhance the overall valuation process and deliverables globally.


Responsibilities:

  • Product and Investment Knowledge: Become proficient in Blackstone Real Estate’s global funds and investments, with particular focus on valuation practices.

  • Valuation Outcomes and Assumptions: Work collaboratively across teams and vehicles to analyze and present valuation outcomes produced from a discounted cash flow approach by property, investment, market and/or sector, globally, to drive thematic monthly or quarterly valuation results.

  • Valuations Process: Partner with asset management, finance and portfolio companies to coordinate and deliver monthly and / or quarterly internal valuations. Assist with the proper closure of key third-party processes, including appraisal, independent valuation advisor and audit.

  • Internal Reporting: Oversee and execute quarterly valuation materials and supporting analysis to present results, requiring the aggregation and synthesis of large sets of data both internally and externally.
  • Special Projects: Support global special projects relating to valuation strategies and process, new products, appraisals and third-party service providers.

Qualifications:

Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who are highly motivated, and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors. In addition to strong analytical and quantitative skills, the successful candidate should have:

  • 2+ years; Strong technical background in valuations-related role (preferably in execution of DCF valuations)
  • Experience executing files and presentations in fast moving and dynamic environment
  • Inquisitive /critical thinker
  • Collaborative approach, with confidence engaging directly with Asset Management and other stakeholders on behalf of the Valuations team to drive outcomes
  • Strong organizational skills, with sound judgment in managing competing priorities
  • Can take notes and distill to senior leaders in crisp and clear format
  • Team player, excellent interpersonal skill

title: Lead, GTM Analytics & Applied AI
description:
**About Owner**

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

**Product philosophy**

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

**Our vision**

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

**Our traction**

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an [Owner.com](http://Owner.com) website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

**Our team**

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

**Where we work**

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

### Why we are looking for you

We're building the most data-driven GTM organization in SMB technology space, and we need dedicated analytics and applied AI leads to support our Sales and Marketing engines.

At Owner, the Business Operations team doesn't just analyze the business. We build products and systems that drive it. Our GTM analytics team has already built ML-powered lead scoring that 2x'd our LTV:CAC ratio, automated account research that doubled rep output, and intelligent routing systems that optimize pipeline for hundreds of reps. And we're just getting started.

Sales and Marketing are at an inflection point. We're expanding into new product verticals and AI-led offerings, scaling new acquisition channels, and standing up entirely new GTM motions. This role will be at the center of designing, measuring, and optimizing them.

As a Lead, GTM Analytics & Applied AI, you'll be a senior contributor who drives analytics and strategy end-to-end for either our Sales or Marketing org. You'll work directly with the CRO or CMO and their leadership team to identify the highest-impact opportunities, then build the analyses, tools, and AI-powered systems that turn them into results.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the US or Canada.

### You should definitely apply if you…

- Have felt torn about whether to pursue a business vs. technical/analytical career path (at Owner we believe these must merge)

- Get more energy from building and shipping than from analyzing and presenting

- Are excited about applied AI: building AI-powered products, and using AI to change how analytics and building gets done

- Get energized by new frontiers — defining the next version of our GTM strategy, not just optimizing existing playbooks

- When solving problems, dive deep to understand root causes and become a subject matter expert. You don't stop at surface-level insights

- Aren't afraid to pick up new tools and skills, from Claude Code to custom machine learning pipelines, whatever the problem requires

- Want to build lasting systems and products, not one-off analyses

- Thrive in ambiguity and don't need a playbook to figure out what to work on next


### The impact you will have

- **Own GTM analytics for your function:** Build the visibility into performance metrics across the funnel that Sales or Marketing run on. Power the weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews with the analyses and metrics that matter

- **Strategize across the funnel:** Work directly with the CRO or CMO to support spend allocation decisions, shape our GTM motion, and bring rigor and a point of view to the biggest strategic questions

- **Direct the pod:** Set the priorities and direction for the analytics and applied AI work supporting your function. Guide the work happening in your pod, partnering with Associates to shape analyses and recommendations

- **Build AI-powered tools that drive incremental value:** Ship things like automated outbound campaigns, intelligent engagement cadences, and other AI-powered workflows to engage customers more efficiently and effectively

- **Experiment with new channels:** Stand up new channels and motions, then build playbooks for repeatable experimentation so wins compound over time

- **Accelerate impact with AI:** Establish how your function and the broader BizOps team uses AI to multiply output across analytics and operating workflows


### Who you'll work with

**Reporting Structure:** This role reports to Meera Singh, Director of GTM Analytics and Applied AI

**Cross-functional Partners:** You'll partner most closely with leadership in your function — either Sales (CRO, Sales leadership, RevOps) or Marketing (CMO, Growth, Lifecycle, Brand) — and collaborate across the broader GTM org on shared initiatives.

**Technical Collaboration:** You will collaborate with Analytics Engineers on all technical aspects, including data modeling, data quality, and the use of tools like DBT and Snowflake.

**Executive Visibility:** This work directly drives GTM strategy, which means regular exposure to senior and executive leadership, including the CRO and CMO.

### What we're looking for

- 7+ years in analytics, strategy, or ops - whether that's management consulting, startup ops & analytics, or a hybrid path that's hard to label

- You've personally shipped data products, models, or AI-powered systems into production — not just delivered insights

- Excellent numerical skills, with additional technical background or education strongly preferred. Claude is a must and SQL/Python skills are a plus!

- Familiarity with how Sales or Marketing teams actually operate. Deep functional pedigree not required, but you should be able to come up to speed quickly

- You've worked in the messy middle between business strategy and technical execution. Consulting, startup analytics, BizOps, or a hybrid path that's hard to label

- Self-sufficient operator. You can run an end-to-end workstream without needing scaffolding

- Have managed a team of analysts before, or are excited about the opportunity to do so — you take satisfaction in helping others do their best work

- Comfortable with ambiguity — you don't need a playbook to figure out what to work on next

- Experience with marketplaces, AI software, and/or high-growth startups preferred

- Restaurant industry experience is a plus!


### Compensation & Benefits

The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $190,000 - $210,000 USD per year, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package.

Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO, plus extra fun perks!

At Ubisoft, the _Online services - player identity_ team is looking for experienced software developers to contribute to the design and evolution of the services that manage player identity across Ubisoft’s games and online experiences.

As these services support several strategic initiatives within Ubisoft, you will contribute to the design and development of robust, scalable, and secure solutions. You will tackle complex technical challenges and participate in creating simple and effective solutions in a distributed systems environment.

In this role, you will work with modern technologies and development practices, including:

- .NET Core
- Docker
- AWS (Aurora RDS, ElastiCache Redis)
- AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
- CI/CD pipelines (GitLab)
- SonarQube
- Grafana
- Kibana
- React

Experience with C++ is a significant asset, as part of the role could involve contributing to the development of our SDK. Experience with React is also valuable for the development and maintenance of internal web-based administrative tools that interact with our services.

If you enjoy designing RESTful APIs, working with microservices on AWS, solving large-scale technical challenges, and collaborating in a DevOps culture, we would like to meet you.

**Responsibilities**

- Participate in all phases of software development, including analysis, design, implementation, testing, integration, debugging, deployment, and support of online services.
- Estimate development efforts and contribute to release planning.
- Provide high-quality support for production systems and operational services.
- Collaborate closely with team members and cross-functional partners.
- Ensure proper integration of account services with other platform systems.
- Evaluate technical risks and measure the impacts of architectural and implementation decisions.
- Stay up to date with new technologies and best practices related to online services, video games, cloud computing, and web development.

#### Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
- Significant professional experience in software development, including the design, development, and support of production systems.
- Solid experience with C# and .NET Core.
- Experience in the design and development of RESTful APIs and distributed systems based on a microservices architecture.
- Experience with cloud services and modern infrastructure technologies, ideally with AWS.
- Experience with containerized applications and technologies like Docker.
- Experience with modern software development practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality tools, and version control systems.
- Excellent understanding of software architecture principles, scalability, reliability, performance, and security.
- Experience in troubleshooting and supporting production systems in a live services environment.
- Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs, risks, and impacts during design and implementation decisions.
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with demonstrated experience working within multidisciplinary teams.
- Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of technical initiatives, and lead solutions from design to delivery.
- Curiosity and a willingness to stay abreast of new technologies, development practices, and industry trends.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience with C++ and SDK development.
- Experience with React and modern web application development.
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
- Experience with AWS services such as Aurora RDS and ElastiCache Redis.
- Experience with DevOps practices and operational service responsibility.
- Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana, and SonarQube.
- Experience with AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot or Claude Code.
- Experience with large-scale online platforms, SaaS solutions, or video game-related services.

title: Engineers & Technical Professionals – Naval Defense Programs
description:
Engineers & Technical Professionals – Naval Defense Programs

Location: NSWC- Crane, IN
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: Primarily On-Site
Clearance: Secret clearance or ability to obtain and maintain one

Position Overview

Created Solutions is seeking talented engineers, technical professionals, and program leaders to support current and anticipated defense programs in Crane, Indiana. These positions support advanced technologies and mission-critical capabilities for the U.S. Navy and Department of Defense.

We are interested in connecting with professionals across a broad range of technical disciplines and experience levels. Opportunities may support engineering design and development, systems integration, modeling and simulation, test and evaluation, technology maturation, manufacturing, program execution, and other specialized technical areas.

Areas of interest include:

  • Electrical and electronics engineering
  • Mechanical and aerospace engineering
  • Systems engineering and integration
  • Software and embedded systems
  • RF, electronic warfare, sensors, and communications
  • Hardware design and development
  • Modeling and simulation
  • Test and evaluation
  • Manufacturing and production engineering
  • Cybersecurity and information systems
  • Program and technical management
  • Logistics and lifecycle support
  • Other defense-related engineering and technical disciplines


Don't see your specialty listed? We still want to hear from you. Created Solutions is building long-term technical capability in the Crane defense community and welcomes qualified professionals whose experience may not fit neatly within a single traditional job description.

What You’ll Be Doing

Responsibilities will vary based on program needs and technical discipline and may include:

  • Support the design, development, integration, testing, and sustainment of advanced defense systems and technologies.
  • Perform engineering analyses, trade studies, modeling, simulation, or technical assessments.
  • Support laboratory, field, qualification, and developmental test activities.
  • Develop and evaluate hardware, software, systems, components, or technical solutions.
  • Analyze test data, troubleshoot technical issues, and develop recommendations.
  • Prepare engineering documentation, reports, technical presentations, and briefings.
  • Collaborate with government customers, engineering teams, laboratories, contractors, and other mission partners.
  • Support technical reviews, program milestones, and technology transition activities.
  • Provide technical leadership or program support commensurate with experience.
  • Support classified programs and activities as required.

What Required Skills You’ll Bring

  • U.S. Citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physical science, or another relevant technical discipline for engineering positions; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered for other technical roles.
  • Relevant professional experience within an applicable engineering, technical, scientific, or program discipline.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability and willingness to work primarily on-site in Crane, Indiana.
  • Active DoD Secret clearance or ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.

Highly Desired Qualifications

  • Active DoD security clearance.
  • Previous experience supporting U.S. Navy or Department of Defense programs.
  • Experience supporting Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane Division or other Navy warfare centers, laboratories, or DoD organizations.
  • Experience developing, integrating, testing, or sustaining complex defense systems.
  • Experience working directly with government customers.
  • Advanced technical degree, professional certification, or specialized expertise applicable to defense programs.


Culture & Values

At Created Solutions, our motto, “Consider it done,” is more than a slogan—it reflects our commitment to innovation, excellence, and integrity. We seek team members who:

  • Thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Bring a problem-solving mindset and a strong work ethic.
  • Value collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Are committed to making a positive impact—both in their work and in their community.


Our company believes that all people are created equal for a purpose. We hold ourselves accountable to high standards in our work and in our mission to support our community through Created Outreach, our 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

About Created Solutions

Founded in 2024 in Huntsville, AL, Created Solutions is a fast-growing small business delivering advanced engineering solutions to the DoD and NASA. We provide expert government support services in flight vehicle design, electrical and mechanical systems, material science, manufacturing, and hypersonic technologies—helping solve some of the nation's most complex and critical defense challenges.

Join us and be part of a team where purpose and excellence come together.

title: Welcome Office Agent - Night (Nattreceptionist) - Clarion Hotel Örebro
description:
About Clarion Hotel: Clarion Hotel® is not just a hotel chain; it's an immersive experience that combines Scandinavian hospitality with a touch of premium. Our team members are not merely employees; they are an integral part of the Clarion experience. We pride ourselves on delivering on personality, passion, and we always strive for perfection. Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! Clarion Hotel® is part of Strawberry.

Är du vår nya stjärna när staden sover?

Vi söker en trygg och serviceinriktad nattreceptionist till Clarion Hotel Örebro.

Brinner du för mötet med människor och vill vara vårt varma ansikte utåt när resten av världen sover? Som nattreceptionist hos oss blir du hotellets viktigaste ankare under natten – tryggheten som ser till att våra gäster alltid känner sig välkomna, sedda och omhändertagna.

Om rollen

Som nattreceptionist är du spindeln i nätet och vår tryggaste punkt under dygnets sena timmar. Du är en del av vårt Welcome Office-team och möter gästerna med samma sprudlande servicekänsla, oavsett om de checkar in sent eller behöver hjälp mitt i natten.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:

  • Varmt välkomnande: Hantera in- och utcheckning, bokningsförfrågningar och telefonsamtal med hög servicekänsla.

  • Säkerhet & ansvar: Du har det yttersta ansvaret för hotellets säkerhetsrutiner och gästernas trygghet nattetid. Du agerar även serveringsansvarig under ditt skift.

  • Driv & merförsäljning: Du arbetar aktivt med merförsäljning och bidrar till avdelningens gemensamma mål.

  • Laganda: Du ställer gärna upp och stöttar övriga avdelningar vid behov.

Vem är du?

Du är en genuint trygg nattuggla med en positiv inställning och stort engagemang. Du har en naturlig känsla för service, är initiativrik och behåller lugnet även när tempot stiger.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Är stresstålig, flexibel och har en stark ansvarskänsla.

  • Är en lagspelare som trivs med att ta eget ansvar.

  • Talar och skriver obehindrat på både svenska och engelska.

  • Har tidigare erfarenhet av receptionsarbete (erfarenhet av bokningssystemet Mews är ett stort plus!).

  • Ålder: Du har fyllt 20 år, vilket är ett krav då rollen innefattar serveringsansvar enligt alkohollagen.

Vi erbjuder dig:

  • Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning på 80 % som inleds med en provanställning.

  • Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse, men senast 1/12.

  • Arbetstider: Nattpass (22.00–07.15) förlagt på vardagar, helger och röda dagar. Dagskift kan förekomma vid behov.

  • Lön: Enligt kollektivavtal

Låter det här som din nästa utmaning?

Vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan! Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag (10/11).

Har du frågor om tjänsten?

Kontakta gärna Natalie Norberg på natalie.norberg@strawberry.se.

### THE CITY

Culver City is a Charter City incorporated in 1917 and is a destination filled with outdoor cafes, unique shops, and galleries opening onto pedestrian-friendly boulevards. Culver City has a dedicated staff of approximately 800+ employees with an overall operating budget of over $368 million. The City provides a full range of municipal services including Fire, Police, Housing and Human Services, Planning & Development, Public Works, Parks, Recreation, and Community Services (PRCS), and Transportation.

### THE POSITION

***Applications will be accepted beginning 8:30 am, Monday, October 12, 2026***

*** _*Only the first 75 applications submitted will be considered.  Please note the job posting may close without prior notice. **_**

[The Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Department (PRCS)](https://www.culvercity.gov/City-Hall/City-Departments/Parks-Recreation-Community-Services)

The PRCS Department consists of different programs and divisions including the Recreation Division and Senior & Social Services. These divisions provide a variety of programs for children, young adults, seniors, and residents with disabilities. Program activities include Youth Sports Programs, homework assistance, computer lab, crafts and games, special events, and more.

**General Duties:** The Recreation Specialist is the highest level of part-time employees within the department. As such, this position works with the Recreation Coordinators and supervisors to plan, organize, and implement a variety of recreational and social services programs, classes, and activities, such as Youth Sports Programs, and is responsible for the oversight of the safe day-to-day operation of designated programs and facilities. Specialists help train, provide leadership, and supervise the work of subordinate employees and volunteers. Other major responsibilities include coordination, scheduling, and oversight of reservations at City facilities; assisting with marketing and social media; evaluating and making recommendations to improve programs and processes; teaching or facilitating group activities; and regular communication with staff, volunteers, parents, patrons, and participants. Successful candidates will also be expected to learn registration and other computer software necessary to successfully manage facilities, registrations, and programs.

**Work Schedule:** Part-time hours working approximately up to 28 hours a week. Schedules will vary depending on the needs of the department.

**Training and Experience:** Any combination equivalent to training and experience that could likely provide the required knowledge, skills, and abilities would be qualifying. A typical way to obtain the knowledge, skills, and abilities would be: an Associate's Degree or equivalent semester units and two years of experience in the parks, recreation, and community services industry. The two years of required work experience may be substituted if the education degree is met.  _Please note required experience must be fully met at the time of application._

**Licenses and Certificates:** Possession of a valid California Class "C" driver license. Must possess certificates in First Aid and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and Automated External Defibrillator (AED) within six months of employment.

### EXAMINATION PROCEDURES

Suitability for the position will be evaluated by an application review. This evaluation will be qualifying, i.e., it will determine who will be invited to an Oral Appraisal Interview with the department. The Oral Appraisal Interview will evaluate training, experience, and personal qualifications.

### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

**The provisions of this job posting do not constitute a contract, express or implied, and any provisions in this posting may be modified or revoked without notice.**

Continuation in the examination process and subsequent placement on the eligible list of a person convicted of a crime depends upon the nature of the conviction and the conduct of the applicant subsequent to the offense. Convictions will be evaluated on a job-related basis and will not automatically disqualify someone from further consideration.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

The City of Culver City is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against employees or applicants on the basis of race, sex, age, disability, veteran status, national origin, religion, political affiliation, or sexual orientation/identification.

**Conditions of Employment:**

- Background/ Reference Check: Upon a conditional job offer, a live scan finger printing must be completed with acceptable results. Your fingerprints will be sent to the California Department of Justice (DOJ) and the Federal Bureau of Investigations (FBI). Having a conviction history does not automatically preclude you from a job with the City. If you are selected as a finalist, you will be contacted to schedule a fingerprinting appointment. Upon hire, the employee is subject to further reporting from DOJ via subsequent arrest notification.
- Pre-placement medical evaluation including drug screen (select positions).
- E-Verify: Proof of U.S. citizenship, alien residency, or authorization to work in the U.S. will be required at the time of appointment.

If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet.

The University of Miami Health System (“UHealth”) IT Department has an exciting opportunity for a full-time Epic Senior Analyst - Optime/Anesthesia.

The Epic Senior Analyst - Optime/Anesthesia initiates the implementation, builds, and modifies complex applications, and collaborates with key stakeholders, end-users, and application team members to optimize the application’s configuration, function, and access. The incumbent supports junior staff members in day-to-day operations and resolving application issues.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Collaborates with key stakeholders, end-users, and application team members to optimize the application’s configuration, function, and access.

  • Serves as a primary support contact for application end‐users.

  • Initiates the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of the application.

  • Initiates all phases of testing and the documentation of workflow design.

  • Performs the analysis of information technology in clinical work processes and validates the impacts to the workflow.

  • Initiates the identification of issues and guides the work to resolve them.

  • Supports junior staff members in the evaluation and resolution of service tickets, identification and implementation of application changes, retrieval of requested data, and execution of day-to-day operations.

  • Collaborates with trainers on application changes and new features to develop documentation and training strategies.

  • Works with stakeholders, the business community, and end users to ensure the application meets UHealth's business/clinical needs.

  • Participates in on-call rotations and support and attend and participatesin, applicable committees.

  • Maintains regular communication with team members, including participating in weekly project team meetings.

  • Reviews the status of projects and issues on an ongoing basis with leadership.

  • Remains knowledgeable about UHealth’s policies, procedures, and business operations.

  • Adheres to University and unit-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets.

Department Specific Functions:

The Epic Senior Analyst – OpTime/Anesthesia serves as a senior-level subject matter expert responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, support, and ongoing maintenance of Epic OpTime and Anesthesia applications.

  • Leads the design, configuration, implementation, optimization, and maintenance of Epic OpTime and Anesthesia applications to align with organizational, regulatory, and clinical requirements.

  • Serves as a primary escalation point and application support resource for end users, resolving complex issues and ensuring timely service restoration.

  • Conducts workflow analysis and assesses the impact of application changes on clinical and operational processes to ensure alignment with best practices.

  • Leads application upgrades, enhancements, integrations, and optimization efforts, including planning, build, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support.

  • Develops and maintains system design documentation, workflow diagrams, testing scripts, change records, and other project-related artifacts.

  • Oversees and executes all phases of testing, including functional, application, integrated, regression, and user acceptance testing, while ensuring accurate documentation of test results.

  • Identifies system issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement and drives resolution through collaboration with internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders.

  • Provides guidance and mentorship to junior analysts by supporting ticket resolution, build activities, workflow analysis, data requests, and operational responsibilities.

  • Partners with training and operational teams to develop educational materials, communication plans, and training strategies related to new functionality and system enhancements.

  • Ensures applications comply with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, security standards, and best practice recommendations.

  • Participates in project planning, governance activities, committees, and workgroups as a subject matter expert representing the OpTime and Anesthesia applications.

  • Maintains effective communication with team members, project stakeholders, leadership, and operational partners regarding project status, risks, issues, and priorities.

  • Participates in on-call support rotations and provides after-hours support for critical incidents, upgrades, go-lives, and maintenance activities as required.

  • Remains current on Epic functionality, healthcare industry trends, regulatory requirements, and emerging technologies to promote continuous improvement and innovation.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, Business Administration, Clinical Discipline, or a related field.

  • Epic Optime/Anesthesia Certification

  • Additional Epic certifications/proficiencies in other clinical module, but not limited to Ambulatory, ClinDoc, Orders, and Radiant, are preferred.

  • Minimum 5years of progressive experience supporting Epic applications,preferably in healthcare or healthcare-related organization

  • Demonstrated expertise in Epic application design, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and optimization preferred.

  • Ability to work evenings, nights, and weekends as necessary.

  • Proficiency in computer software (i.e. Microsoft Office).

  • Ability to recognize, analyze, and solve a variety of problems.

  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form.

  • Ability to lead, motivate, develop and train others.

Any appropriate combination of relevant education, experience and/or certifications may be considered.

The University of Miami offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, tuition remission and more.

UHealth-University of Miami Health System, South Florida's only university-based health system, provides leading-edge patient care powered by the ground breaking research and medical education at the Miller School of Medicine. As an academic medical center, we are proud to serve South Florida, Latin America and the Caribbean. Our physicians represent more than 100 specialties and sub-specialties, and have more than one million patient encounters each year. Our tradition of excellence has earned worldwide recognition for outstanding teaching, research and patient care. We're the challenge you've been looking for.

The University of Miami is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are protected from discrimination based on certain categories protected by Federal law.

title: Broadcast Video Director
description:
Job Title: Broadcast Video Director

Ministry/Department: Production

Reports to: Worship Experience Pastor

Status: Full-time, exempt

Supervisory Role: No

Objective

This role is responsible for leading the production and delivery of Eleven22 Online live experiences and in-room video; maintaining and improving campuswide video infrastructure at the main campus and overseeing video planning and execution for weekly services, major events and online conferences. The role coordinates the people and systems needed for these productions, including Planning Center Online and develops supporting digital content to create excellent experiences for remote audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain an authentic and growing walk with Jesus Christ through the ongoing spiritual disciplines of Bible reading, prayer, personal worship, fasting, confession and fellowship
  • Lead the planning and delivery of live online services and large-scale online and in-person events, ensuring a high-quality, consistent and timely experience
  • Maintain and support the video infrastructure across the campus, including displays, projectors, cameras, switchers, routing and playback systems, ensuring all gear is service-ready and performing reliably
  • Provide strategic and creative ownership of the full online experience, leading cross-functional teams to deliver a cohesive, high-quality digital ministry
  • Direct the creation and production of digital content that enhances and extends live events, including transitional elements and graphics for online playback
  • Curate and create content resources specifically for online and remote audiences to be used during live streaming
  • Coordinate Planning Center Online plans, schedules and dates with online content and service run-of-show
  • Partner with production teams to align in-room and online experiences, communicating each event’s vision, outline and expectations
  • Partner with the Technical Director on evaluation, procurement and stewardship of equipment and tools to support and continually improve the online live experience
  • Partner with the Eleven22 Online team to ensure prerecorded and live host moments meet qualitative standards for the online broadcast
  • Participate in monthly planning meetings with online staff to curate upcoming online-specific events and content
  • Build, develop and lead the broadcast video team, including staff and serve staff, to support current needs and future growth
  • Lead in discipling the camera operator serve staff team, empowering high-level serve staff to partner in discipling the team
  • Provide video production support for campus ministry events, including celebrations of life, weddings, baptisms, conferences, meetings and other gatherings hosted on campus
  • Other duties as assigned

Competencies

  • Model The Church of Eleven22® mission, vision and core values
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality
  • Ability to adapt to change
  • Strong, proactive communication skills
  • Knowledge of live production and online broadcast workflows
  • Strong project management, planning and follow-through
  • Communicate proactively and collaborate effectively across teams
  • Ability to curate content and tell stories with remote audiences in mind
  • Technical aptitude with streaming tools, cameras and related production equipment
  • Ability to coordinate schedules and production systems, including Planning Center Online

Education and Experience

  • Three to five years of experience in live video production, streaming or digital content production
  • Experience directing or producing live broadcasts
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred

Expected Hours of Work

Work Hours Expectations: 40 hours or more.

Schedule Expectations: Sunday through Thursday (hours may vary based on church needs, to include working full weekends).

The church has several big events (“All-Skates”) throughout the year to help further the mission of The Church of Eleven22. These events are mandatory for all staff to be in attendance and may vary, depending on the vision cast for the current year.

Our entire staff family is called to action so that we can continue to be a movement for all people to discover and deepen a relationship with Jesus Christ.

Work Environment/Physical Demands

Work is performed in office, production, live-event and occasional outdoor environments. Duties may involve prolonged periods of sitting, standing or walking; working in low light or high audio settings and sustained attention to video monitors, cameras and production activity. The role may require carrying, lifting and setting up equipment weighing up to 25 pounds, as well as bending, reaching and moving equipment through production spaces. The role requires evening and weekend availability for services and events, occasional travel for production and filming and the ability to communicate, stay focused and respond effectively as conditions change during live broadcasts.

Ministerial Exception

The ministerial exception furthers the purposes of the Free Exercise and Establishment Clauses of the First Amendment by barring legal claims against church bodies by staff members who perform religious functions. All church pastors are subject to the exception, but a formal ministerial credential is not required. While there is no rigid formula to determine other church staff members who qualify, various factors are considered to determine which staff members are subject to the ministerial exception (please see the handbook).

Staff members who qualify under the ministerial exception are not covered by federal and state employment and anti-discrimination laws. Please see the Human Resources Ministry team if you have questions on whether you are subject to the ministerial exception.

Code of Conduct

  1. We live authenticity
  2. We are gospel-centered and mission-focused
  3. We are family
  4. We are lifelong learners
  5. We aim for excellence in the experience with zero excess
  6. We choose to trust
  7. We pray 1st and decide 2nd
  8. We glorify God by honoring others
  9. Our team unites under clear vision
  10. We walk in humble confidence

EEO Statement

The Church of Eleven22 provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. The Church of Eleven22 reserves the right to discriminate on the basis of religion to the full extent permitted by law.

title: General Utility - The Ridge Environmental Ed. Center
description:
Compensation Amount:

16.50 USD Hourly

Job Summary:

The General Utility is responsible for cleaning all dishes, glasses, utensils, pots and pans and related food preparation/serving items and equipment, as well as the service and dining areas. The General Utility performs skilled and routine maintenance, grounds, and housekeeping tasks necessary to maintain the cleanliness and sanitation of the facility.

Job Description:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Wash dishes, utensils, trays, and cooking supplies using proper sanitation procedures.
  • Pull trash from trash receptacles. Replace trash bags as needed. Clear trash from tables and floors/grounds.
  • Clean floor area of any spillage of water, detergent and/or food stuffs per safety and sanitation guidelines.
  • Fill condiments, utensils, and other supplies with stock as needed.
  • Loading and unloading of inventory from trucks. Stocking storeroom.
  • Maintain the kitchen, serving, and dining areas in clean and orderly condition at all times by sweeping, mopping, emptying trash, wiping counters and equipment and organizing shelves in order to maintain a sanitary work station and to meet mandated health compliance requirements.
  • Maintain awareness of safety issues, and report them immediately to your manager.

SKILL AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS INCLUDE

  • Partial High School education; High School Diploma/G.E.D. equivalent preferred.
  • Strong sanitation habits.
  • Strong customer service abilities; actively looks for ways to assist customers and coworkers.
  • Ability to recognize when a problem has occurred and communicate it to management.
  • Physical and Mental Requirements
  • Moving about on foot to accomplish tasks, particularly frequent movements from place to place within the unit. Bend, lift, carry, reach/extend arms and hands above shoulder height frequently, or otherwise move in a constantly changing environment.
  • Lifting, carrying, and pushing up to 30 lbs. regularly, 40 lbs. frequently, and up to 50 lbs. occasionally.
  • Ability to stand for the entire work day.
  • Works in wet and slippery conditions. Frequently works in a hot and damp environment.
  • Frequently immerses hands in water.
  • Climbing steps regularly.
  • Withstanding temperature extremes in freezer, refrigerator walk-in and grill areas. Ability to work in indoor and outdoor environments.
  • Reading and writing work-related documents in English.
  • Speech recognition and clarity, including the ability to understand the speech of customers and co-workers and the ability to speak clearly so that you can be understood by customers and co-workers in English.
  • Constantly communicates and receives verbal communication with other employees in fast-paced kitchen.
  • Physical presence at the job site is essential to perform job duties.

EQUIPMENT USED

  • Standard commercial automatic dishwashing equipment.
  • Cleaning Supplies (including detergents, chemicals, mops, brooms, scourers, hand towels, etc.).

title: Principal, Quality Engineering – Artificial Intelligence (AI) Lead
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**_Job Title: Principal, Quality Engineering – Artificial Intelligence (AI) Lead_**

**_Job Code: 45762_**

**_Job Location: Remote or Onsite at Huntsville, AL; Orange, VA; Camden, AR; Canoga Park, CA; Amityville, NY; Mason, OH; or Richardson, TX_**

**_Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days- totaling 80 hours worked- and have every other Friday off_**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris Missile Solutions is seeking a Leader for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) Quality to develop and execute the segment’s strategy for AI/ML governance, verification, and validation. Reporting to the Director of Quality Engineering, this role defines quality frameworks ensuring AI/ML models, computer vision systems, and automated inspection technologies meet mission-critical requirements. The position partners closely with Executive Leadership, Data Science, Software Engineering, Operations, and site Quality teams to support the safe deployment and lifecycle management of AI-enabled tools. The ideal candidate brings experience implementing quality processes for software-intensive or AI-driven systems and leading cross-functional technical initiatives.

**Essential Functions:**

• Develop and implement AI/ML quality strategies and validation frameworks to assess model and software behavior across Missile Solutions applications.

• Establish and maintain data governance practices, including data quality controls, labeling accuracy, drift monitoring, and bias prevention.

• Define measurable performance metrics and acceptance criteria for AI applied to mission-critical or defect-detection systems.

• Lead verification and validation (V&V) activities for AI/ML models, including adversarial testing, stress testing, and edge-case simulation.

• Adapt traditional quality and risk tools to intelligent systems, including FMEA development and mitigation planning for machine-learning-specific failure modes.

• Oversee quality frameworks for automated inspection systems, including validation of sensor calibration, metrology data ingestion, and synthetic data pipelines.

• Govern post-deployment quality practices such as regression testing, drift thresholds, and monitoring/retraining workflows.

• Align internal AI engineering practices with emerging standards (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF).

• Ensure compliance with AS9100, internal quality systems, and customer-specific quality requirements.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance.

• Up to 30% travel may be required.

**Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or related technical field with 12 years of prior relevant experience; OR Graduate Degree with 10 years of prior related experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 16 years of related experience.

• Minimum 3 years of experience leading technical projects, cross-functional initiatives, or engineering teams.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in verification, validation, testing, or quality management of software-intensive systems, AI/ML models, or analytics pipelines.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

• Experience in manufacturing or quality in defense, aerospace, automotive, or similar industries.

• Ability to work independently and adapt to changing priorities.

• ASQ CSQE or CQE certification.

• Training or certification in AI governance or trustworthy AI frameworks.

• Experience with data validation frameworks for drift and anomaly detection.

• Familiarity with quality flow-down requirements for prime defense contractors.

• Understanding of APQP, manufacturing risk management, Six Sigma, and LEAN principles.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Washington, and the Greater D.C. area, Denver, or NYC areas is $139,500 – $259,500. The salary range for this role in Colorado state, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Minnesota, New York state, Cleveland Ohio, Vermont and Virginia is $121,500 – $225,500. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location.
