title: Project Manager
description:
Job Summary:

The CDW Project Manager is a trusted consultant, providing project management expertise across multiple technology stacks and services. Projects are typically of low to medium complexity and incorporate mainstream, legacy and emerging technologies. The Project Manager may independently manage projects, or work within a large program under the guidance of Program Managers. The successful candidate balances scope, schedules, budget and understands how to leverage PMO tools and templates to drive successful business outcomes for the customer. This position works with mixed teams consisting of CDW engineers, CDW sales, other members of CDW cross functional business areas, customer staff, and third-party consultants. The CDW Project Manager is a project advocate and relationship builder. They drive successful engagements through negotiation, concise communication, crucial conversations, and leadership abilities.


What you will do:


  • Use experience, skillset, and methodologies to understand the client’s end goals and provide a consultative approach to ensure that the solution provided is appropriate for the client’s desired overall outcome and strategy.
  • Be a trusted consultant to your project team in all matters related to project delivery, CDW processes, and project management with best practices and delivery. Build relationships with all project stakeholders.
  • Creates and maintains presence with all project stakeholders, acting as a CDW steward for quality. Dedicated to meeting or exceeding stakeholder expectations. Identifies success criteria and ensures that it is met by involving the stakeholders in key decisions and linking project outcomes to strategic business initiatives.
  • Recognizes the need for negotiations, gathers relevant information, and seeks advice from sales and management when needed. Negotiates changes (cost, scope, effort, schedule of solution, resource commitment, etc.) to agreeable results. Effective negotiation of changes that achieve stakeholder satisfaction and drive positive project results.
  • Works with team members to gather information and determine impacts to the project, document mitigation steps taken in troubleshooting, and communicate these to the team and client.
  • Independently manages medium to large sized projects requiring complex cross functional collaboration and management, adhering to CDW’s project management processes and methodologies.
  • Accountable for project profitability. Track project budgets and resources and manage actuals vs. planned hours against the resource allocation and budget. Timely reporting of project financials and budgets to stakeholders. Ties project outcomes to clients’ business strategies, helping to generate new business.
  • Ensures that time, expenses, and invoices are accurately tracked and approved against the project in a timely manner.
  • Validates initial project scope and estimates. Determine the need for a new Statement of Work versus a Change Order. Makes sellers aware of new opportunities for additional services opportunities uncovered during project delivery.
  • Ensures all items defined in CDW Statement of Work are delivered and perform quality assurance throughout the lifecycle of the project.
  • Establishes, monitors, adjusts and communicates tasks and associated schedules to the project team and modifies when necessary. Build project schedules in conjunction with our engineering teams and partner resources.
  • Aids in identifying proper resources and optimizing billable schedules, monitors and adjusts assignments as necessary to drive client satisfaction and project profitability.
  • Identify, documents, tracks, and communicate project risks and issues. Strategizes potential resolution and drives desired course of action to bring issues to timely resolution.
  • Manages equipment, software, licensing and outside services procurement and delivery schedules.
  • Documents, outcomes, lessons learned and shared appropriately with colleagues. Leverage expertise to help drive business process improvements within the CDW Services PMO.
  • Take accountability for project results and hold all project team members accountable for their scope of work and schedule commitments. Is fiscally responsible to the client, the project and to CDW.
  • Instills trust with our clients by building strong relationships with stakeholders.
  • Uses political savviness, business acumen, and relevant personnel along with CDW experience to establish credibility.
  • Demonstrates the ability to diffuse uncomfortable situations with client and/or project team.
  • Leads teams to consistently meet project success factors and exceed client expectations.
  • Inspects delegated tasks to ensure timely and accurate completion. Coach and mentor Associate Project Managers.
  • Stays abreast of industry best practices through research, conferences, training seminars and participation in professional associations. Shares information across the Services PMO.
  • Determines the appropriate documentation (communication plans, schedules/timelines, status reports, quality plan, closure summary, budget, risk plan, etc.) for projects. Manages the quality and delivery of documentation to clients.
  • Has a clear and concise communication style, leads and facilitates both live and virtual meetings. Keeps meetings on track, on topic and summarizes, assigns and publishes follow up items in a timely manner.
  • Adapts communication style and medium to the audience's needs. Recognizes when communication efforts are ineffective and adapts tactics and/or medium as necessary.
  • Effectively prepares and delivers difficult information. Can credibly communicate complex topics to stakeholders and build consensus.
  • Anticipates client or project needs, communicates potential solutions. Conveys CDW experiences and positive outcomes to build client confidence and trust.
  • Develop and manage a detailed schedule and work plan.


What we expect from you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and 4 years of experience in project management or four years of CDW Services experience OR 8 years of experience in project management or 8 years of CDW Services experience
  • Two or more years of experience in leading small to medium scale projects in a professional services organization.
  • Project management or agile consulting experience as it pertains to advising clients of delivery best practices across multiple technology stacks (e.g., Cloud, Security, Infrastructure)
  • Ability to support presales activities and look for new sales opportunities to help the client achieve organizational goals while growing CDW’s portfolio of work.
  • Participate productively in virtual teams in order to improve Project Management processes.
  • Experience Project Managing projects with several technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to take accountability for projects and their results, be fiscally responsible and lead teams to meet project success factors.
  • Working knowledge of one or more formal project management methodologies, proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Project/Office.
  • Excellent written, presentation, and verbal communication skills including demonstrated experience presenting technology recommendations from a business perspective.
  • Applies discretion when dealing with sensitive/confidential information.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities simultaneously and adapt to the changing needs of the business while meeting deadlines.
  • Ability to work weekends and/or off hours as necessary to meet clients' needs.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% or as needed to other CDW locations, meetings and client sites.
  • Ability to understand, remember, and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information. Ability to organize thoughts and ideas into understandable terminology. Ability to multi-task, organize and prioritize. Ability to apply common sense in performing job. Ability to understand and follow basic instructions and guidelines.
  • PMP and/or Agile Certification(s), a plus
  • Experience using both Waterfall and Agile methods (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) to manage projects, a plus
  • Pay range: $77,725 - $108,265 depending on experience and skill set
    Annual bonus target of 10% subject to terms and conditions of plan
    Benefits overview: https://cdw.benefit-info.com/
    Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials.

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

title: Director of Product Management – Open USD
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Job Description: Director of Product Management – Open USD Compliance and Onboarding Feature Owner

Visa’s Stablecoin team is building cutting-edge onchain infrastructure to change the way money moves. While onchain solutions began as niche and speculative, they are now transforming how value moves across the global financial ecosystem.

Visa is at the forefront of this transition. We are rapidly expanding our stablecoin and tokenized money infrastructure to enhance our network and develop solutions for partners around the world. Visa brings trust, scale, and security to the evolving onchain ecosystem, creating the opportunity for generational impact in payments and beyond.

We are seeking a Director of Product Management – Open USD Compliance and Onboarding to set the strategy and lead delivery of scalable capabilities for partner onboarding, Know Your Business (KYB), compliance, and partner data management. This leader will define the global product vision and operating model, establish roadmap priorities, and guide the development of workflows, platforms, controls, and automation required to expand Open USD responsibly across markets and partner segments.

This is a senior, highly cross-functional leadership role at the intersection of stablecoins, regulatory strategy, financial crime compliance, onboarding operations, data governance, and enterprise-scale financial infrastructure. The ideal candidate combines strategic product leadership with strong execution discipline, can influence executive stakeholders, and can translate complex global and local requirements into a cohesive platform strategy and measurable business outcomes.

In this role, you will lead across compliance, legal, risk, operations, engineering, data, sales, client-facing teams, and regional stakeholders to define and deliver the capabilities required to scale Open USD globally. You will own the compliance and onboarding product portfolio, including regional expansion of KYB and related controls based on local regulatory, licensing, data, documentation, and risk requirements. You will align global platform standards with market-specific needs while avoiding unnecessary fragmentation.

This role requires an enterprise product leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, make informed trade-offs across growth, risk, control, and client experience, and mobilize cross-functional teams to deliver capabilities that are controlled, auditable, scalable, and commercially practical. The Director will establish governance, communicate decisions and dependencies to senior leadership, and ensure the portfolio is positioned for sustainable global growth.

title: Senior HW Engineer – PCB Analog Design
description:
The Opportunity

At the centre of an optical computer sits a set of circuits that have to read, drive and hold steady some very small, very fast signals: photodetector front ends, laser and modulator drives, precision converter interfaces, and the quiet power and references underneath them. This role owns them, at board level, from the optical requirement through to the production build.

The Role

You will design the board-level analog and mixed-signal circuits that connect our electronics to light, and take them the whole way: specification, simulation, layout guidance, lab bring-up, characterisation and production. You will agree the optical requirements - optical power budgets, bandwidth, noise, linearity - with the photonics and system teams, and turn them into analog architectures and circuit specifications.

What is genuinely hard about it is working at the boundary between optics, mixed-signal and high-speed digital, where noise budgets are tight and the measurement is as demanding as the design. A microvolt-level front end does not care that the same board carries high-current switching rails; getting both right on one stackup is the job.

By month six, you will have characterised at least one full analog subsystem on the bench, correlated it with simulation across corners, and put the layout constraints and test procedures in place that other engineers can follow.

What You'll Do

  • Design board-level analog and mixed-signal circuits: photodiode front ends, TIAs, ADC/DAC driver and reconstruction stages, laser drivers, modulator drivers and bias networks.

  • Translate photonic system requirements into analog specifications and architectures with the photonics and system teams.

  • Design low-noise power delivery for sensitive circuits: LDO post-regulation, filtering, precision voltage and current references, grounding and partitioning schemes.

  • Design control loops and precision circuits for photonic components: TEC and temperature control, laser current control, monitor photodiode readout and heater drivers.

  • Run circuit simulation and analysis (SPICE, noise, stability, worst-case, Monte Carlo) and confirm designs meet performance across corners.

  • Give placement, routing and grounding guidance to the layout engineer, review layouts for analog integrity, and select and qualify analog components through to production.

  • Lead lab bring-up and characterisation of analog circuits - noise, bandwidth, linearity, stability, crosstalk - and correlate the results with simulation.

  • Work with the ASIC team on chip-to-board analog interfaces, including on-chip versus off-chip analog partitioning.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • A degree in electronic engineering or a related discipline, plus extensive experience designing analog and mixed-signal circuits at board level for products that reached production.

  • Strong analog fundamentals covering op-amp and amplifier design, feedback and stability, noise analysis, filtering and precision circuit design.

  • Hands-on experience designing TIAs or other low-noise, high-bandwidth amplifier front ends.

  • Experience interfacing high-performance ADCs and DACs, including driver design, anti-aliasing and reconstruction filtering, clocking sensitivity and reference design.

  • Solid knowledge of low-noise power supply design, grounding, shielding and mixed-signal partitioning.

Strong preference for

  • SPICE-based simulation (LTspice, Cadence PSpice/Spectre, TINA or equivalent) and schematic capture in Cadence OrCAD/Allegro or Altium.

  • Bench characterisation with oscilloscopes, spectrum and network analysers and precision source-measure equipment, and low-noise measurement technique.

  • Writing layout constraints for sensitive analog circuits and reviewing layouts critically.

  • Photonic or optoelectronic systems: photodetector receivers, laser diode drivers, optical modulator drivers or optical transceivers.

  • Mentoring other engineers in analog design practice.

About Lumai

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched Iris Nova, the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time, using up to 90% less energy than conventional GPU-based systems. Iris Nova, the first server in the family, is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Aura and Tetra will follow.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

Equal Opportunity

Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you.

description:
On behalf of the CPS we are looking for a Cyber Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Specialist (Inside IR35) for a 4 month contract. Hybrid working with occasional travel to London.

Please note: An active SC Clearance is an essential requirement for this role, as a minimum you must be willing & eligible to undergo checks. (Please note, due to the exceptional requirements of this position (short-term nature of this role and speed at which we require a postholder in situ) preference may be given to candidates who meet all of the essential criteria and hold active security clearance.)

The Cyber DLP Specialist will provide the specialist technical and advisory capability required to implement the outstanding GovAssure and Purple Team recommendations relating to data mapping, data discovery, data governance, classification, retention and Data Loss Prevention. The role will help the organisation establish the information and governance foundations needed to allow effective technical DLP controls to be designed, deployed and evidenced.

Working jointly with CKIM, Cyber Security, Operational Security, Data Protection, Information Management, service owners and technical teams, the specialist will assess the current position, define requirements, support data mapping and classification, implement and tune Microsoft Purview and related controls, strengthen detections on network shares and SharePoint, restrict unauthorised cloud-storage routes, and produce the evidence needed to close the recommendations

As a Cyber Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Specialist your main responsibilities will be:

. Review GovAssure, Purple Team and DLP recommendations, existing plans and progress to date.
. Develop a single remediation roadmap with defined owners, milestones, risks, dependencies and evidence requirements.
. Identify quick wins and provide regular progress reporting to the Head of CKIM and Head of Cyber Security.
. Support delivery of the organisation-wide data mapping and governance activities.
. Identify, classify and validate sensitive information, ownership, access, retention and disposal requirements.
. Advise on data discovery tooling and establish sustainable governance arrangements.
. Finalise and implement the organisation classification and sensitivity labelling framework.
. Configure Microsoft Purview labels, classifiers and policies.
. Manage testing, deployment, governance and resolution of business or technical impacts.
. Validate DLP requirements and implement Microsoft Purview DLP controls across key the organisation platforms and services.
. Configure, test and optimise policies, alerts and reporting to reduce data loss risk.
. Integrate DLP monitoring with SOC, SIEM, ITSM and incident management processes.
. Define operational processes, playbooks, escalation routes and response procedures.

title: Staff Engineer / AI Builder
description:
We’re looking for a Staff AI Builder to lead the design and delivery of AI/ML systems. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who thrives on architectural decisions, can confidently own systems end-to-end, and contributes to technical leadership across the team.

In this role, you will work as a key technical leader on a cross-functional team, defining AI architecture, leading model development and optimization, and solving challenging integration problems. You’ll be joining real, in-flight work where reliability, security, and scalability are critical. You’ll establish engineering standards, raise the bar on how we build AI systems, and contribute to the technical decisions that shape how our AI work scales over time.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You'll Do

Agentic & GenAI Engineering

  • Design and build agentic workflows — reasoning loops, tool/function calling, and orchestration across single- and multi-agent architectures — with clear judgment on which pattern fits the problem and which doesn't
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines: chunking strategy, embeddings, vector search (OpenSearch), re-ranking, and staleness/refresh handling for dynamic knowledge sources
  • Integrate with AWS Bedrock and Agent Core, including MCP-based tool design — writing tool descriptions precise enough that an orchestrator routes correctly every time
  • Write and iterate on production system prompts — structured role framing, output constraints, and few-shot design — not just prompt tinkering
  • Build eval and observability into every agent you ship: golden datasets, RAGAS-style metrics, LLM-as-judge (as both a runtime guardrail and an offline eval), and tracing via LangFuse/LangSmith or equivalent
  • Design for LLM failure, not just LLM success: retries with backoff and jitter, circuit breakers, fallback models, and a clear user-facing story when something upstream degrades

Full-Stack & Platform Engineering

  • Build backend services in Python and Node.js, including serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) that support agentic workflows
  • Design DynamoDB single-table schemas — composite keys, transactional writes — for conversation state, agent memory, and session history
  • Support event-driven orchestration (Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge) for asynchronous agent operations, with an eye toward reliability and clean error handling
  • Contribute to frontend integration points so agentic features land cleanly for end users, and write clean, well-tested code across the stack
  • Support deployment, monitoring, and production troubleshooting in cloud-native environments (AWS, Docker), with guidance from senior engineers where needed

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Bring informed technical judgment to architecture discussions — naming the real trade-offs of a pattern (e.g., gateway centralization vs. latency, single- vs multi-agent design) rather than defaulting to what's familiar
  • Partner with product, design, and delivery leads across global teams to scope and ship features end-to-end
  • Mentor other engineers on the pod and help raise the bar on agentic engineering practices, including AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code
  • Own assigned features and releases end-to-end — including the unglamorous parts: debugging, hardening, and keeping production systems trustworthy

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful time shipping GenAI/LLM-powered systems in production — not just prototypes
  • Real, hands-on depth in agentic AI: reasoning loops, tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration, and a considered point of view on when single-agent design beats multi-agent, and why
  • Practical RAG expertise: chunking strategies, embeddings, vector databases (OpenSearch or similar), cosine similarity search, and re-ranking — you can explain the mechanism, not just the terminology
  • Experience building evaluation and observability for LLM systems: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, RAGAS or comparable metrics, and tracing tools like LangFuse/LangSmith
  • Strong prompt engineering skills — you can write a production system prompt with real structure and constraints on request, not just describe the concept
  • Hands-on experience with the AWS GenAI stack: Bedrock, Agent Core, Lambda, DynamoDB (single-table design), S3, SQS, EventBridge, Step Functions
  • Strong Python and Node.js skills, with experience building full-stack applications and RESTful APIs
  • Solid understanding of production reliability patterns for LLM-backed systems: retries/backoff, circuit breakers, fallback models — as a bundle, not a single tactic
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud-native deployment
  • Comfort owning ambiguous, integration-heavy problems, and the ability to go a level deeper when someone pushes on your answer instead of staying abstract

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Direct experience with Amazon Bedrock Agent Core — agent registration, MCP tool wiring, memory/session management, gateway provisioning
  • Experience in a regulated or high-stakes domain (education, healthcare, financial services) where evaluation rigor and reliability carry real consequences
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Step Functions, Sequencer, or similar state-machine-based systems
  • A point of view on LLM observability tooling, gained from actually running it in production rather than reading about it

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the role

As a Data Engineer, you’ll bring a well-rounded understanding of data-driven practices to support senior team members and stakeholders in enhancing regulatory processes. From uncovering insights through data profiling and analytics to building robust models and engineering solutions, you’ll play a key role in how data is governed, interpreted, and transformed into actionable intelligence.

Key responsibilities of this role are:

  • Collaborate within a high-performing Scrum team to deliver BAU work and Project Roadmap milestones that support the Data Science and Analytics Strategy. This includes interpreting requirements, estimating effort, and raising risks and impediments early.
  • Interpret business requirements, estimate workloads, prioritise tasks, and manage time in the delivery of quality solutions to meet deadlines.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines in Databricks using Python, PySpark, and Spark SQL, primarily within our metadata-driven ingestion and transformation framework.
  • Develop and operate Databricks notebooks and jobs on classic compute. Optimize performance and cost through cluster configuration, cluster policies, and Spark and Delta Lake tuning.
  • Extend and improve the framework's configuration, patterns, and reusable components so that new data sources can be onboarded quickly and consistently.
  • Contribute to the platform's evolution toward Lakeflow declarative pipelines and modern Databricks capabilities.
  • Deliver changes through modern CI/CD practices, including source control, automated testing, peer code review, and CAB-approved releases.
  • Support, maintain, and upgrade existing workflows, deployment pipelines, and environments across the full application lifecycle.
  • Implement and manage data security with Unity Catalog, including catalog, schema, and table permissions, row filters, column masks, service principals, and secrets management.
  • Identify, classify, and protect sensitive and personal (PII) data. Apply tagging, masking, and access controls in line with privacy obligations and organizational policy.
  • Participate in a rotating incident management roster. This includes troubleshooting and resolving issues, performing root cause analyses, configuring monitoring and alerting, and writing troubleshooting guides.
  • Proactively remediate and document operational incidents, project risks, and impediments where possible or otherwise surface these items as appropriate to project managers and senior team members.

NHVR’s Data & Technology teams are currently undertaking growth and considerable transformation, and this is an exciting time to join the organisation.

To learn more, the position description can be found on the NHVR Careers site - https://careers.nhvr.gov.au/jobs/search

About You

You’ll have at least four years of data engineering experience, including significant hands-on work with Databricks or equivalent cloud data platform. A bachelor's degree in a relevant field is desirable. You’ll also be experienced with Agile Scrum, the SDLC, and data lifecycle processes.

Your toolkit for success:

  • Hands-on Databricks experience, including notebooks, Jobs/Workflows, cluster configuration on classic compute, and Spark performance tuning.
  • Strong Python and PySpark data pipeline development skills, with advanced SQL (Spark SQL and T-SQL or similar).
  • Practical experience with Delta Lake, including MERGE and upserts, schema evolution, OPTIMIZE and VACUUM, and partitioning or clustering strategies.
  • Experience building or working within metadata-driven or configuration-driven pipeline frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of Unity Catalog security and governance, including the securable model, grants and ownership, external locations, storage credentials, and lineage.
  • Experience identifying and handling sensitive and PII data, including classification, masking, and least-privilege access.
  • Solid data modelling knowledge (relational, dimensional, and medallion architecture) and an understanding of RDBMS concepts.
  • Software engineering discipline, including modular and reusable code, unit testing, Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and debugging.
  • Experience with Azure data services such as ADLS Gen2, and Key Vault.
  • Understanding of batch and streaming data concepts, structured and unstructured data, and data governance

Ideally you will have:

  • Experience with Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables), Lakeflow Connect, Auto Loader, and data quality expectations.
  • Relevant certifications including Professional or Associate Databricks Data Engineer, and Azure Certification.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Microsoft PowerBI, Tableau.
  • Familiarity with supporting machine learning workloads, such as MLflow.

Why join us?

The National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR) commenced operations in 2013 as the national entity responsible for regulating all vehicles in Australia over 4.5 tonnes gross vehicle mass. The NHVR minimises the compliance burden on the heavy vehicle transport industry, reduces duplication and inconsistences across state and territory borders, and ultimately for the heavy vehicle business with government in Australia.

We are headquartered in Brisbane and employ more than 1000 people across the ACT, New South Wales, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania and Victoria.

We offer

  • Salary package of $135,995.90 + superannuation
  • Monthly RDO and paid leave over Christmas closure.
  • Hybrid working environment – up to 2 days from home.
  • Up to15.25% superannuation through a co-contribution scheme
  • Leave loading 17.5%
  • Wellbeing programs – discounted fitness through Fitness Passport, Discount health insurance, flu vaccine, financial programs including discounted banking products, finance information sessions.
  • Salary packaging options including novated lease.
  • Discounted IT products including Microsoft and free family password security plan.
  • Ongoing training and professional development support
  • Professional membership

Successful applicants will be required to complete standard pre-employment checks including a national police and work rights check.

We are committed to being an inclusive, diverse and flexible workplace where differences are valued.We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experience and abilities.

title: Carelink Skærmede Boliger søger afdelingsleder til afdeling for psykiatri og selvskade
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for en fagligt stærk medarbejdergruppe og være med til at sikre trygge, strukturerede og individuelt tilrettelagte rammer for børn og voksne med psykiske udfordringer og selvskadende adfærd? Så er det dig vi søger.

Carelink Skærmede Boliger

Carelink Skærmede Boliger består af flere afdelinger, der tilbyder særligt tilrettelagte botilbud til børn, unge og voksne med behov for omfattende støtte, jf. Barnets Lov § 43 og Servicelovens §§ 107 og 108. Hver afdeling er specialiseret indenfor hver deres målgruppe.

Afdelingen for psykiatri og selvskade er for målgruppen af børn og voksne i alderen 10 – 40 år. De er kendetegnet med udfordringer som følge af angst, Personlighedsforstyrrelse, Tilknytningsforstyrrelse eller opmærksomhedsforstyrrelse, og med en selvskadende og indadreagerende adfærd.

Afdelingen består 2 selvstændige lejligheder, hvor den enkelte borger bor alene i et skærmet miljø. Omkring hver borger er der tilknyttet en fast gruppe af pædagogisk og sundhedsfagligt personale med en normering på enten 1:1 eller 2:1, afhængigt af borgerens behov.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en erfaren afdelingsleder til vores afdeling for psykiatri og selvskade på Fyn.

Du får det daglige personaleansvar for 20-25 dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere med høj faglig viden og ekspertise inden for området.

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at lede, motivere og udvikle medarbejdergruppen samt sikre en ensartet, metodisk og pædagogisk tilgang til den enkelte borger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Daglig personaleledelse, motivation og medarbejderudvikling.
  • Vagtplanlægning og håndtering af ansættelsesforhold.
  • Nærværende ledelse med fokus på trivsel, faglighed og samarbejde.
  • Sikring af høj kvalitet i den pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige indsats.
  • Individuel og fælles kompetenceudvikling i medarbejdergruppen.
  • Implementering og fastholdelse af fælles metoder, tilgange og procedurer.
  • Sikring af fyldestgørende dokumentation, herunder statusrapporter til myndighederne.
  • Ansvar for den daglige drift og kvaliteten i afdelingen.
  • Tæt samarbejde med kommunale myndigheder, anbringende kommuner, Socialtilsynet og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere.
  • Kan skabe sammenhæng mellem den daglige praksis, den faglige kvalitet og den skriftlige dokumentation. Samtidig skal du sikre et konstruktivt samarbejde med både medarbejdere, kommuner, pårørende og øvrige aktører omkring den enkelte borger.

Kørekort og egen bil er en forudsætning for at kunne varetage stillingen.

Din profil

Vi søger dig, der har solid ledelseserfaring og praktisk erfaring med målgruppen.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en socialfaglig eller pædagogisk uddannelse.
  • Har erfaring med personaleledelse og faglig udvikling.
  • Har praksiserfaring med borgere med psykiatriske udfordringer og selvskadende adfærd.
  • Gerne har erfaring fra botilbudsområdet.
  • Er god til at skabe følgeskab, motivere medarbejdere og sætte en tydelig faglig retning.
  • Kan omsætte faglige metoder og procedurer til praksis i hverdagen.
  • Har stærke skriftlige og mundtlige kommunikationsevner.
  • Arbejder systematisk og har blik for kvalitet i dokumentationen.
  • Trives med et tæt samarbejde med kommunale rådgivere og andre fagpersoner.
  • Har forståelse for betydningen af et godt samarbejde med borgernes pårørende
  • Er en tydelig og nærværende leder, der kan skabe overblik i en kompleks hverdag og samtidig bevare fokus på både medarbejdernes trivsel og borgernes individuelle behov.

Vi tilbyder

Hos Carelink Skærmede Boliger bliver du en del af en organisation i udvikling, hvor faglighed, ordentlighed og engagement er centrale værdier.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En arbejdsplads med dygtige og engagerede kolleger på alle niveauer.
  • Et fagligt stærkt miljø med høje ambitioner.
  • Mulighed for faglig supervision og løbende kompetenceudvikling.
  • Et tværfagligt lederfællesskab med mulighed for sparring og samarbejde.
  • En varieret hverdag med faglige og ledelsesmæssige udfordringer.
  • Et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du er med til at skabe de bedst mulige betingelser for de borgere, vi har ansvar for.

Om Carelink Skærmede Boliger

Carelink Skærmede Boliger er en del af Carelink Gruppen, der leverer velfærdsydelser inden for blandt andet sundhed, beskæftigelse, socialområdet og ældrepleje.

Carelink Skærmede Boliger er en del af Carelink Bosteder, som driver tilsynsgodkendte botilbud til børn, unge og voksne.

Vores menneskesyn bygger på, at alle mennesker har værdi og ressourcer, men at vejen til at udvikle og bringe disse i spil er individuel.

Vores værdier er:

  • Vi har respekt for hinanden og opgaven.
  • Vi finder løsninger.
  • Vi gør det ordentligt.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Kan du se dig selv i stillingen, og motiveres du af at skabe faglig kvalitet, stabil drift og gode rammer for både medarbejdere og borgere? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, og stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Jeppe Hassel-Pflugh, områdechef

E-mail: jepf@carelink.dk

Telefon: 28 70 23 83

title: Data Engineer
description:
This recruitment is carried out anonymously.

Metsä Group is looking for a

DATA ENGINEER

to join our Digital & AI function in Espoo, Finland.

What is the job that awaits you?

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in building and developing Metsä Group’s Azure Databricks-based data platform and AI-ready data foundations. You will design, develop and maintain scalable data pipelines, data models and reusable data products that enable analytics, reporting, AI and other data-driven solutions across Metsä Group.

Data modelling is an essential part of your role. You will transform technical source data into business-ready data products by applying modern data modelling practices and Metsä Group’s medallion architecture. You will work across the Raw, Harmonized and Business Layers, ensuring that data is structured, traceable, secure and reusable for different business areas and use cases.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Data Architects, Information and Solution Architects, Analytics professionals, AI developers and other IT teams. Together, you will translate business concepts and data requirements into maintainable technical solutions and make data accessible, understandable and ready for use.

As part of the Data team, you will contribute to the development of our engineering practices, platform capabilities and development standards, while collaborating with external partners to ensure high-quality deliveries.

This is a permanent position and you will report to Development Manager, Data.

What we are expecting of you?

To succeed in this role, you have solid hands‑on experience in data engineering and developing solutions on modern cloud-based data platforms. You have strong practical experience with Azure Databricks and related Azure data technologies and are comfortable taking ownership of data solutions from source ingestion to business‑ready data products.

You have experience designing and implementing data models and reusable data products for analytics and AI. You enjoy solving complex data challenges and collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders to create sustainable, scalable solutions.

In Addition, We Expect You To Have

  • Strong hands‑on experience with Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory and modern cloud‑based data engineering technologies
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing business‑oriented data models and reusable data products
  • Experience applying medallion architecture and developing Raw, Harmonized and Business Layer data solutions
  • Experience designing, developing and maintaining reliable and scalable data integration pipelines
  • Strong SQL and Python programming skills
  • Experience working with structured and unstructured data from multiple internal and external data sources
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing, data integration and modern data architecture principles
  • Understanding of how AI‑ready data foundations and data products are built and governed
  • Experience implementing data quality, metadata, lineage, security and access‑control requirements in data solutions
  • Experience with automated testing, version control, CI/CD and DevOps practices in data engineering
  • The ability to document data models, data pipelines, business rules and technical solutions clearly
  • Strong collaboration, analytical and problem‑solving skills
  • The ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, architects, analytics professionals, AI developers and external development partners

The Following Are Considered An Advantage

  • Experience with SAP‑based data sources
  • Experience with real‑time, streaming or IoT data solutions
  • Familiarity with data governance, metadata management and data quality practices

Most importantly, you are passionate about data and enjoy building high‑quality data foundations that enable future analytics and AI capabilities across Metsä Group.

Career in the new era at Metsä Group

An international growth business – build a successful career At Metsä Group. The forest industry is a prime example of the bioeconomy and circular economy, and shows the way to the future. Megatrends such as urbanisation and rising living standards are driving Metsä Group’s business and the shift to renewable fossil free raw materials. With us, you’ll get to develop future skills, business and products with a long‑term perspective, together with our top professionals. Our big company offers a wide range of career opportunities and many interesting challenges.

Metsä Group has a responsible corporate culture that creates a safe working environment for all of us. We value good leadership and support for personal career development. We encourage you to display your competence and will provide you with opportunities to use it.

Anonymous Recruitment - This Is How It Works

This is an anonymous recruitment process. The gender and date of birth of the applicant are not asked for on the application form. title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Your future starts here. You'll join a close-knit agile DevOps team based in Bern Worblaufen, where spending time together on site is part of how we collaborate. The team has developed and operated an inventory system for many years, and you'll help to make it more reliable, scalable and easier to maintain.

You'll work across application development and operations, improving CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring and patch management. You'll also help modernise the platform using Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code, while decoupling parts of the existing system to make deployments more flexible. As we explore a move from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, you'll contribute to the technical direction of the platform. Automate CI/CD pipelines, testing, infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, patching and dependency management to improve software delivery and operations. Develop and operate cloud-native applications using Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code, and evaluate tools and architectural approaches for the evolving platform. Plan and implement the transition from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, building the platform's public cloud capabilities along the way. Decouple and modernise the inventory system's existing functional components to improve scalability, maintainability and deployment flexibility. Keep the application stable and secure across environments by improving monitoring, incident handling, and operational automation with AI capabilities support.

Your skills

  • A degree in computer science (university, ETH or university of applied sciences), or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience developing Java applications and working with Linux and scripting languages such as Bash.
  • You’ve worked on evolving legacy systems towards a microservices architecture and have experience operating cloud-native services and databases, particularly PostgreSQL.
  • Strong command of version control, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
  • You’re also familiar with dependency management, the software lifecycle and monitoring in a DevOps environment.
  • Hands-on experience with automation including practical uses of AI in operations and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Ansible, alongside networking concepts including firewalls, load balancing and reverse proxies.
  • You bring depth in your area of expertise, share and document what you know, and are willing to build skills beyond your main specialism.
  • You take ownership of complex problems, investigate root causes and balance modernisation goals with the realities of running a production system.
  • You contribute constructively to an agile team, support colleagues and stay open to new approaches.
  • You communicate technical topics clearly and work effectively with others in very good English and good German.

title: Chemist -100094
description:
Manufacturing Sciences Corporation
Build. Learn. Grow. Do Work That Matters.

Why Join MSC?

Manufacturing Sciences Corporation (MSC) isn’t just another manufacturer—we’re one of a kind. With more than 35 years of specialized experience working with depleted uranium, MSC is the only commercial organization in the world capable of casting, rolling, and machining depleted uranium products.

Our work supports critical industries, and we do it in an environmentally responsible, safety-first, and highly controlled facility. Just as important, we believe our people are the foundation of our success. We believe our team has Unparalleled Performance and Unmatched Dedication. Many of our employees stay with us for years—even decades—because they’re respected, supported, and challenged to grow.

If you’re looking for a hands-on role where your work truly matters and where you can build a long-term career, MSC may be the place for you.


The Opportunity: Chemist

Bring your skills to a hands-on laboratory role supporting the testing of depleted uranium, natural uranium, oxides, and other non-ferrous metals. As our Chemist, you will help deliver reliable, traceable results by preparing and analyzing samples, supporting method validation and implementation, maintaining instruments, applying quality controls, and promoting safe laboratory practices. This is an opportunity to solve technical problems, improve laboratory processes, and collaborate with colleagues across engineering and applied uranium technologies.


What you’ll do

  • Prepare, interpret, document, and communicate accurate, traceable analytical results.
  • Collaborate with the Analytical Chemist and Chemical Engineer to improve or adapt test methods, formulas, and laboratory processes.
  • Prepare and safely handle solutions, compounds, reagents, and samples in line with storage, quality, and safety requirements.
  • Complete routine and non-routine analyses using appropriate technical equipment and instruments.
  • Clean and calibrate instruments, perform basic troubleshooting, and apply contamination controls that keep laboratory operations dependable.
  • Communicate priorities, technical issues, and findings clearly across the team.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Analytical testing and sample preparation
  • Prepare samples, test solutions, compounds, and reagents; conduct routine and non-routine analyses; interpret and report results.
  • Utilize laboratory methods and validation
  • Support the development, validation, implementation, and improvement of chemical testing methods and protocols.
  • Instrument operation and care
  • Use appropriate analytical equipment; perform cleaning, calibration, general maintenance, and first-line troubleshooting.
  • Quality control and contamination prevention
  • Apply quality-control checks and handling practices that help prevent contamination of compounds, samples, and equipment.
  • Consistently follow laboratory safety procedures and protocols and help maintain safe lab operations.
  • Utilize your problem-solving and judgment skills
  • Investigate testing or workflow issues, evaluate information, and make sound decisions within the scope of the role.
  • Planning, accuracy, and prioritization
  • Organize work, manage competing priorities, multitask when needed, and maintain strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Work cross-functionally, coordinate priorities, solve problems with others, and communicate findings effectively in writing and verbally.
  • Use Microsoft 365 applications and collaboration tools to document, communicate, and coordinate work.

What you’ll bring

We value capability gained through education, training, and relevant experience. We encourage you to apply if your background demonstrates the skills needed to succeed in this work, including through an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Working knowledge of chemistry or a related scientific field, demonstrated through a bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to prepare samples and reagents and perform analytical laboratory work with accuracy.
  • Working knowledge of laboratory safety procedures and protocols.
  • Ability to organize work, manage competing priorities, take initiative, and work independently when needed.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across functions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and collaboration tools.

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting laboratory or quality activities in a metal fabrication environment.
  • Familiarity with government contract requirements and compliance.

Additional responsibilities

As business and laboratory needs evolve, you may take on other duties that are reasonably related to the role.


Ready to put your chemistry expertise to work? Apply to join our Oak Ridge team and help strengthen the quality, safety, and reliability of our laboratory operations.

description:
Seeking a Lead Data Engineer with at least 5 years’ experience working as a data engineer.

Job details

The Department is looking for a Data Engineer to join its Enterprise Analytics and Technology Services (EATS) section to work across its data and analytics platforms. We are seeking candidates with strong experience in developing Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) processes, and /or the development of data products and complex data visualisations.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
description:
Job Description

About Empyrean

Empyrean Solutions is the fastest growing financial risk management and performance solutions platform, specifically designed for banks and credit unions. Since 2008, we've been trusted by financial institutions across the globe to deliver cutting-edge ALM, budgeting, profitability analysis, and compliance tools through our unified Empyrean Dataverse® platform. Our solutions emphasize speed, accuracy, and ease of use to help financial institutions make faster, more informed decisions.

At Empyrean Solutions, you won't just have a seat at the table - you'll help build it. Every person here has a direct, visible impact on where we go next. You'll work alongside a genuinely collaborative team, backed by AI tools available to every employee from day one.

The role

The Data Platform will be the home of all Empyrean data. Some products already run on it, others are moving over now, and new products, including our AI and reporting products, will be built on it from the start. The services, interfaces and patterns you build now are the ones they'll all run on. Over the next two to three years, volume per customer grows from a few million rows a month to more than 100 million rows a day.

We're hiring a senior software engineer to build that platform the way you'd build any enterprise SaaS backend, with services that load each record exactly once, contracts that don't break the products downstream, and tenants that can't see each other's data. You don't need a data engineering background. You do need to have shipped and run production backend systems, and you need to care whether the data is correct.

You'll join a platform team of four to five engineers and test automation engineers, working with a data architect who sets platform direction.

The role is hybrid requiring three 3 days a week in our office in Cork, Ireland.

What you'll work on

  • Event-driven ingestion services. Build the services that bring customer data onto the platform, delivering exactly-once results over at-least-once delivery. You know how they behave when things fail: retries, redelivery, reordering and late changes.

  • Versioned contracts and APIs. Build the interfaces, shared SDKs and data feeds that Empyrean products, and later our customers, use to read platform data. Keep them versioned, tested in CI and safe to evolve, so a platform change never surprises a team downstream.

  • Correct, reproducible results. Build point-in-time history and exact decimal arithmetic into the platform's types, tests and interfaces, so every product gets them by default, and any result can be reproduced exactly as it was on any past date.

  • Scale without runaway cost. Grow services and storage by orders of magnitude while keeping queries fast and costs rising more slowly than volume. Measure first, and back changes with load tests and cost data.

  • Self-service onboarding. Build the control-plane services and tooling that bring a new product or a new customer onto the platform in days, not months, within our multi-tenant model.

  • Data ready for AI and ML. Make customer data usable by models and AI features, with the same contracts, tenant separation and reproducibility as everything else on the platform.

  • Operability built in. Ship SLOs, alerting and CI gates with every service, and take part in incident response for what you own. Each incident ends with a fix that stops it recurring.

What you bring

  • 5+ years building software professionally, including backend services you designed, deployed and ran in production. We care more about what you've built and operated than about the count.

  • Production experience in Python, C#/.NET, Java or a similar backend language. Our platform services are mostly Python, and our shared data SDK and the products that use it are .NET. We use AI tooling heavily, so if you come from Java or another language, you'll pick up Python and C# quickly.

  • Instincts for distributed systems: idempotency, ordering, concurrency, retries, and what "exactly once" costs.

  • Testing as a habit: unit tests, integration tests against real dependencies, and CI that fails when it should.

  • Experience evolving APIs and schemas: versioning, backward compatibility, and moving consumers over without a big-bang cutover.

  • Strong SQL, and a working understanding of how a cloud data warehouse executes and bills a query.

  • You understand how multi-tenant software keeps each customer's data separate, and you build within that model: scoped service identities, least-privilege access, and no shortcuts.

  • You mentor through code review and pairing, and you leave behind patterns and docs that others can follow without you.

  • You write clearly. You measure before you propose a design, and your PRs say what changed, why, how you tested it and what could go wrong.

Nice to have

  • Experience with systems where exact numbers and audit history matter, such as payments, billing, ledgers or accounting.

Our stack

Python and C#/.NET, Snowflake, dbt, Terraform, Azure (Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus), GitHub Actions. Beyond a strong backend language, you don't need experience with any of these. You'll pick them up here.

How we work

  • Small team, high autonomy. You know how your area is designed, built and run in production. Our data architect owns the overall platform direction, and you bring evidence to those decisions.

  • AI-first. Claude Code and Cursor are part of how we build. We expect you to use them well, and to review what they produce as hard as you review your own work.

  • Significant decisions go through written RFCs with measured evidence.

  • Someone other than the author verifies every change, and code reviews have substance.

This probably isn't the role for you if

  • Your production experience is mostly notebooks or scheduled SQL, with no service you've had to keep running.

  • You'd rather deduplicate in a downstream query than fix why the duplicates arrive.

  • You work best from fully specified tickets.

title: Senior HW Engineer – Signal and Power Integrity
description:
The Opportunity

Every board Lumai builds has to run multi-gigabit links and feed high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. Getting those right before the board is fabricated is the difference between a working system and a respin cycle. This role owns the modelling, the stackups, the materials and the design rules that make it work, and has a direct say in the decisions that prevent the respin.

The Role

You will own signal and power integrity across our boards and packages. That means pre-layout channel studies that set routing topologies, stackups, materials and constraints; post-layout analysis of critical channels, including insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis with IBIS-AMI models; optimisation of vias, breakouts, connector launches and the transitions into our optical engines; and PDN impedance targets, decoupling strategies and DC drop analysis for high-current rails.

What is genuinely hard is that the channels cross boundaries - chip, package, interposer, board and optical engine - and a model is only as good as its weakest corner. You will spend as much time at the bench as in the tool, correlating what you predicted against what the hardware does, and feeding that back into design rules.

By month six, you will have signed off the critical channels on at least one board, built the model libraries and design guidelines the team reuses, and be the person whose analysis decides when a layout is ready to release.

What You'll Do

  • Run pre-layout channel studies to set routing topologies, stackups, materials and design constraints for high-speed interfaces.

  • Carry out post-layout SI analysis of critical channels: insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis using IBIS-AMI models.

  • Design and optimise vias, breakouts, connector launches, and the transitions into optical engines and co-packaged components.

  • Set PDN impedance targets, design decoupling strategies, and run DC drop and AC PDN analysis for high-current ASIC and FPGA rails.

  • Support package, interposer and board co-simulation with the ASIC team to keep channel and power integrity sound end to end.

  • Correlate simulation with lab measurements using TDRs, VNAs and oscilloscopes, and feed the results back into models and design rules.

  • Evaluate and characterise PCB materials, connectors and cable assemblies with suppliers and fabricators.

  • Build up our SI/PI methodology, model libraries and design guidelines so they can be reused across projects.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • A degree in electronic engineering, physics or a related discipline, plus proven SI/PI experience on high-speed PCB and/or package designs.

  • Proficiency with at least one major EM and circuit simulation suite, such as Ansys HFSS/SIwave, Keysight ADS or Cadence Sigrity/Clarity.

  • Strong understanding of transmission line theory, S-parameters, crosstalk, loss mechanisms and channel compliance metrics such as eye diagrams and COM.

  • Experience with IBIS and IBIS-AMI models for SerDes and memory interface simulation.

  • Solid knowledge of PDN design, including impedance targeting, decoupling optimisation and DC IR drop analysis.

Strong preference for

  • Hands-on measurement with VNAs, TDRs and high-speed oscilloscopes, and the ability to correlate measurements with simulation.

  • 56G/112G PAM4 channels, or PCIe Gen5/6 compliance.

  • Package and interposer co-simulation, including chip-package-board analysis.

  • Low-loss PCB materials and fabrication tolerances and their effect on high-speed performance.

  • Scripting (Python, MATLAB) to automate simulation and post-processing.

About Lumai

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched Iris Nova, the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time, using up to 90% less energy than conventional GPU-based systems. Iris Nova, the first server in the family, is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Aura and Tetra will follow.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

Equal Opportunity

Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you.

We are hiring three Senior Full-Stack Engineers to join our cross-functional team pillars (which include Commercial Optimization, Product Innovation, and Tech Scale). Please note that specific pillar placement is not guaranteed and may vary from time to time based on business needs.

We are advertising broadly for full-stack developers, but are actively seeking candidates with distinct front-end or back-end specialisms to fulfill three specific profiles:

  1. Balanced Full-Stack Developer. Comfortable splitting impact 50/50 across C#/.NET and modern TypeScript / React
  2. Back-end focused Senior Developer. Deep C#/.NET and Azure SQL expertise with front-end awareness
  3. Front-end focused Senior Developer. Strong Modern React/TypeScript specialization to lead UI architecture and frontend modernization while collaborating with backend systems. Migrating legacy patterns through TypeScript into component-driven React

During the application review, we will evaluate your individual background against all three specialist tracks to find the best fit for your technical strengths.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Technical depth and delivery. Deliver high-quality features across the full stack (or front-end/back-end focus areas). Make independent technical decisions, consider architectural knock-on effects, and write clean, thoroughly tested code
  • Migration and modernization. Help steer key initiatives—whether migrating C# services to .NET 8, optimizing Azure SQL performance, or converting legacy UI modules into scalable React components
  • Technical debt and architecture. Identify and raise technical debt, author technical proposals on complex tickets, and champion quality standards
  • PR reviews and mentorship. Provide constructive code reviews, pair with mid-level engineers, unblock colleagues proactively, and guide standard methodologies
  • Collaboration and strategic AI. Work closely with PMs, Designers, and Marketing to shape what gets built, not just how. Strategically utilize and critically evaluate AI tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality

Requirements

REQUIRED

  • Minimum 5 years of progressive, professional software development experience
  • Technical core:
    • Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem, OR
    • Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS (with web accessibility/WCAG experience for FE-focused candidates), OR
    • Broad comfort working across the full stack and adapting to where team focus is required
  • Data and cloud. Experience with relational databases (SQL Server / Azure SQL preferred)
  • Engineering standards. Proven experience conducting thorough PR reviews, mentoring mid-level engineers, and working within Agile/SDLC frameworks
  • Education. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • Remote setup. Candidates must have an existing and suitable remote workstation setup

NICE-TO-HAVES

  • Experience with React component library design systems or component-driven migration
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Ecosystem (App Services, Azure SQL, Azure DevOps)
  • Experience with Entity Framework Core or backend performance optimization
  • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, front-end performance monitoring, or testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright)
  • Prior experience in the EdTech sector

Benefits

  • 30 days' holiday per year (inclusive of UK bank holidays)
  • 100% remote working
  • Social events and annual meet ups

ABOUT WORDWALL

Wordwall empowers educators to create interactive, customisable teaching materials in minutes - turning static lessons into dynamic, student-centred learning experiences. With just a few simple inputs, teachers can generate a variety of gamified activities, from quizzes and flashcards to arcade-style challenges, making learning more engaging and effective.

We're flipping the script on traditional educational publishing by putting powerful creation tools directly into teachers' hands. Our platform fuels a bottom-up content ecosystem - scalable, shareable, and deeply attuned to real classroom needs - powered by a global community of educators. With millions of active users, strong organic traction, and a product that's beloved by teachers worldwide, Wordwall is entering an exciting new chapter.

We're focused on building upon an already great product and increasing our impact and reach in key markets like the U.S. and Europe, deepening engagement with our paid user base, and driving innovation through emerging technologies such as AI. We're a lean, mission-driven, remote team building for long-term impact - and we're looking for sharp, strategic technical thinkers to help us scale both our product and our purpose.
