title: Data Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As a Data Engineer for Agentic AI & ML, you will be the architectural bridge between raw data and customer-facing intelligence. You will collaborate deeply with our Data and Platform teams to influence upstream pipelines, ensuring high-fidelity data is ready to power our scheduling and planning software. You will be responsible for extracting, preparing, and optimizing complex datasets to fuel prototyping and production-grade ML solutions. By building custom pipelines for agentic systems, you will enable our users to work faster, better, and better informed, directly enhancing the user experience in Planday through intelligent, autonomous workforce management.

**What You’ll Do

**

  • Collaborate with Data and Platform teams to advocate for and influence the design of upstream data pipelines to support AI/ML requirements.
  • Extract and transform large-scale datasets from various sources specifically for AI/ML prototyping and model training.
  • Design and deploy custom, production-ready data pipelines that power agentic AI workflows and real-time ML inference.
  • Implement robust data validation and monitoring for ML-specific features, ensuring data quality and lineage for production models.

**Success looks like

**

  • Strong working relationships with the Data and Platform teams that result in AI-ready data infrastructure.
  • Reduced time-to-market for AI prototypes through efficient data extraction and preparation workflows.
  • High-availability production pipelines supporting live ML models and agentic workflows with minimal data latency.
  • Consistent delivery of high-quality, feature-rich datasets that directly improve model performance and agent reliability.
  • Proactive identification of data gaps and the successful implementation of new data sources for advanced AI capabilities.

**What You’ll Bring With You

**

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in data engineering with a focus on supporting ML/AI systems in production.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python for building complex ETL/ELT pipelines and data manipulation for ML.

title: Field Technician – Western Idaho & Oregon Highlands
description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

T-Mobile is searching for an impactful Field Technician in the Western Idaho & Oregon Highlands to join us in taking the next big leap forward!

You should possess a balance of wireless industry exposure, coupled with the ability to be independent and cover a wide area of sites in our market. You will be a generalist, encompassing aspects of technical support, project management, and operational support while being a responsible teammate.

We are a team that encourages innovation and advocates an agile and open approach, truly working and playing in the Un-carrier way!

T-Mobile is seeking a motivated and skilled Field Technician to support our Engineering & Operations team across the Boise metro area and including western Idaho, extending east into the Magic Valley and west into eastern Oregon.

This territory covers roughly 200 sites. They run from the Treasure Valley north through the West Central Mountains and east along the Snake River Plain, and across the border into Baker, Malheur, and Union counties in Oregon. Most sites are in the Treasure Valley, so expect a mix of urban and suburban work along with long rural drives. I-84 serves as the primary travel corridor connecting much of the territory. The role calls for travel across mountain passes, high desert, and farmland in all seasons, and the eastern Oregon counties — particularly remote areas of Malheur — involve significant drive times on open desert highways. Winter mountain driving in the McCall, Cascade, and Council, Idaho areas are common.

The Field Technician role involves applying technical knowledge to maintain and improve network performance and reliability. It involves providing technical assistance, managing smaller projects, and contributing to operational process improvements. The role requires understanding of radio access networks, backhaul, signaling, disaster recovery, data services, and location-based services. Success is measured by effective technical support, timely project updates, and identification of process improvements. The work directly impacts network stability and service quality for organizational and customer needs.

Main responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support to resolve network performance issues and contribute to outage resolution efforts
  • Manage smaller projects or project segments, delivering accurate status and progress updates as required
  • Identify and recommend process improvements related to maintenance and repair activities to senior staff and management
  • Assist in developing job aids, scopes of work, and procedural documentation in collaboration with senior technicians
  • Complete required training to maintain current knowledge of systems, products, and organizational standards
  • Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed

Education and Work Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent (Required)
    • Acceptable areas of study include Vocational/Technical Training or related field (Preferred)
  • 2-4 years - Working experience in Field Operations and maintenance.
  • 2-4 years - Wireless telecommunications or other related experience.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Electronics (Required)
    • Basic operational knowledge and theory of all interconnecting circuits to include but not limited to RF transmitters, antenna systems, AAV, fiber, microwave radio and AC-DC power systems, and AI. Experience with backup power systems including generators, battery plants, and rectifiers is a plus, given the wide geographic coverage and remote site access in this territory.
  • Radio Access Network (RAN) – Practical knowledge of RAN architecture, components, and operations, with the ability to support deployment, maintenance, and optimization activities. (Required)
    • Experience with Ericsson RAN technology is a plus.
  • Wireless Backhaul – Understanding of wireless backhaul technologies and configurations used to connect cell sites to the core network, including microwave and fiber-based solutions. (Required)
    • Licensed Microwave and millimeter-wave wireless transport technology – Ceragon and Ericsson experience is a plus
    • Experience with Nokia cell site routers and IP backhaul configuration is a plus.

title: Managing Director, Strategic Accounts, Project & Development Services
description:
Job Title

Managing Director, Strategic Accounts, Project & Development Services

Job Description Summary

This role is responsible for the day-to-day relationship management, growth, and financial performance of a portfolio of Sector client relationships. The Managing Director serves as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring consistent, high-quality service delivery while identifying and pursuing opportunities to expand each relationship.
The Managing Director owns P&L accountability for their portfolio, leads contract and staffing changes in partnership with Sector leaders, and builds the reporting cadence, governance, and account management frameworks that keep each relationship well-run and positioned for growth. This individual plays a critical role in strengthening Cushman & Wakefield's Sector client relationships and driving consistent delivery standards across assigned clients.
Beyond managing existing clients, the Managing Director supports new client pursuits and serves as a subject matter expert (SME) resource for markets and other execution teams, helping shape solutions and staffing approaches before and during client engagements. The role is also expected to drive consistent delivery across assigned clients and sectors, so clients experience the same standard of service regardless of geography or service line.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities


Client Relationship Management

  • Assume responsibility for relationship management of multiple Sector clients, serving as the primary day-to-day point of contact.
  • Cultivate each client relationship, establishing C&W as the clients trusted real estate partner.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for the client, ensuring client issues are addressed quickly and resolved to a satisfactory outcome.
  • Attend weekly and monthly client meetings, representing C&W and driving the agenda, follow-ups, and action items for each account.
  • Act as a client evangelist — championing the client within C&W, driving service excellence, and striving for constant improvement across the relationship.
  • Operate effectively across matrixed client and internal C&W environments, serving as a single, consistent point of contact across multiple stakeholders, business units, and workstreams.
  • As an experienced real estate professional, support clients as they navigate relationships between client business units with real estate operations teams, ensuring alignment between corporate real estate strategy and day-to-day execution.

Growth & Financial Ownership

  • Drive client growth year over year, identifying and executing opportunities to deepen and broaden each relationship.
  • Hold full P&L ownership of assigned clients, managing revenue, margin, and overall financial performance.
  • Expand relationships beyond the existing scope of services, working with sector and service line leadership to bring additional C&W capabilities to the client.
  • Support new business pursuits outside of core account responsibilities, partnering with business development as needed.

Contract & Staffing Leadership

  • Lead any contract changes for assigned clients in partnership with Sector leaders, including amendments, scope changes, and staff increases.
  • Serve as the liaison to C&W leadership for staffing changes, ensuring the right resources are aligned to account needs.
  • Assume leadership of multiple client relationships (approx. 4–5), depending on account size and complexity.

Reporting & Governance

  • Prepare all client reporting documents, including project tracking reports, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), monthly reports, and ad hoc reports as needed.
  • Develop a standard account management framework — including playbooks, SOPs, and KPIs — to drive consistency and repeatability across assigned clients and sectors.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Real Estate, Business, or a related field; advanced degree or professional certifications (PMP, LEED, etc.) preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in account management, project management, construction management, real estate, or professional services.
  • Demonstrated experience owning key client relationships and managing multiple concurrent clients or business units.
  • Strong background in client relationship management, account P&L ownership, and contract administration.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional delivery teams and operate effectively within matrixed client and internal C&W organizations.
  • Deep understanding of project delivery models, staffing strategies, commercial structures, and risk management.
  • Experience working with Sector-specific clients is a plus.

Key Skills & Attributes

  • Executive-level presence with the ability to build trust and influence senior client stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial acumen with proven growth and P&L management capability.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both client-facing and internal.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple client relationships simultaneously.
  • Strategic thinker with disciplined execution and strong operational judgment.
  • Collaborative mindset with a focus on service excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Success Measures (What Good Looks Like)

  • Year-over-year growth in assigned client revenue and scope.
  • High client satisfaction, retention, and expansion of services.
  • Effective account governance, with clear playbooks, SOPs, and KPIs in place.
  • Strong P&L performance across the assigned client portfolio.
  • Timely, high-quality client reporting and a consistent client meeting cadence.
  • Timely resolution of client escalations.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
About 3Y Health

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into other specialties.

About the role

Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.

What you'll do

  • Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation

  • Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile

  • Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version

  • Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code

  • Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response

  • Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship

  • Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes

  • Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex

Our stack

  • Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go

  • Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native

  • Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake

  • Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf

  • Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly

  • AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of experience building and shipping production software

  • A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on

  • Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure

  • Comfort working in a large, established codebase

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)

  • Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit.

  • Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library

  • High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to

  • Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)

  • Temporal or another durable workflow engine

  • React Native

  • Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production

  • Building your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent

  • Open-source work, side projects or internal tools that other people use

If you meet most of the requirements and the role interests you, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.

  • 2+ years of experience in technical sales, applications engineering, project development, or related roles within solar PV, BESS, EV charging, power systems, or distributed energy resources (DERs)
  • Ability to interpret RFPs, technical specifications, engineering drawings, utility requirements, and interconnection documentation
  • Understanding of solar PV systems, battery energy storage systems, DC fast charging infrastructure, and associated electrical equipment
  • Knowledge of electrical distribution systems, power conversion equipment, and energy management concepts
  • Strong communication, presentation, and customer-facing skills with the ability to convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders
  • Must have and maintain a clean driving record to meet company insurability standards

Hotellet drivs av HKC Hotels – en stolt hotellkoncern som även omfattar Hotell Kung Carl (Stockholm), Hotel Noble House (Malmö), Åby Hotell (Göteborg) och Hus57 (Ängelholm).

Om rollen

Som receptionist är du hotellets hjärta och ansikte utåt. Du möter våra gäster med ett leende, säkerställer att deras vistelse blir över förväntan och ser till att driften i receptionen och lobbyn flyter på smidigt.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:

  • Gästservice & värdskap: Ta hand om våra gäster före, under och efter deras vistelse samt hantera frågor och önskemål med hög servicekänsla.

  • Receptionsarbete: Hantera in- och utcheckning, telefonsamtal, mejl, bokningar och fakturering.

  • Försäljning & bar: Sköta försäljning i receptionens shop samt viss barförsäljning under överenskomna tider.

  • Kvalitet & ordning: Hålla ordning i receptions- och lobbyområdet samt följa våra policys, rutiner och checklistor.

  • Teamwork: Ställa upp för kollegor på andra avdelningar vid behov och delta aktivt på avdelnings- och informationsmöten.

Vem är du?

Du är en noggrann, kommunikativ och ordningssam person med mycket energi. Du tycker att god service är genuint roligt och bidrar till en härlig stämning i teamet – för vi tror på att ha kul tillsammans på jobbet!

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har tidigare erfarenhet från hotellreception.

  • Har god vana av hotellbokningssystem (erfarenhet av Mews är meriterande!).

  • Talar och skriver flytande svenska samt har goda kunskaper i engelska.

  • Har fyllt 20 år (ett krav då tjänsten innefattar barförsäljning och serveringsansvar enligt alkohollagen).

Vi erbjuder dig:

  • Omfattning: 80 % med start omgående.

  • Arbetstider: Skiftarbete förlagt till dag- och kvällstid på vardagar, helger och röda dagar (nattskift kan förekomma vid behov).

  • Utveckling: För rätt person finns det goda möjligheter att växa i rollen och på sikt ta klivet till Shiftleader.

Låter det här som din nästa utmaning?

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag (10/11). Tveka därför inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Har du frågor om tjänsten?

Kontakta gärna Natalie Norberg på natalie.norberg@strawberry.se

A Farm Family Territory Leader is responsible for driving profitable P&C growth in a designated territory. This role will market, manage, and expand all P&C lines of business insurance through select distribution partners, driving profit and premium to meet financial objectives. The role also partners with the Annuity Distribution team to achieve annuity production targets with the territory.


In partnership with the Regional Distribution Leaders, the Territory Leader recommend product, pricing, marketing plans, and is the liaison for distribution partner experience to support achieving the goals of the territory.

  • Identify and target P&C distribution partnerships within the assigned territory, formalizing new relationships through a structured contracting and appointment process.

Relationship Management

  • Conduct partner visits and business review sessions to assess progress, discuss performance trends, and strengthen collaboration.

Establish and Compete for Market Share

  • Establish the company as the preferred provider for agribusiness, and commercial lines products in the territory, while communicating product changes, company objectives to agency partners.

Business Planning

  • Develop and implement strategic, data-driven business plans to achieve production and profitability goals, continuously monitoring KPIs to refine and optimize plans.
  • Lead the creation and execution of territory sales and marketing strategies to drive growth and profitability, ensuring alignment with underwriting standards and performance expectations.

Enhance Distribution Partner Experience & Effectiveness

  • Consult with field and internal partners to define needs, develop business solutions, and provide industry insights, focusing on sales/marketing activities, risk management, and profitability.
  • Primary point of contact for all distribution partners within the assigned territory.

Company Representation

  • Represent Farm Family at industry forums, conferences, and associations to elevate visibility and reinforce strategic alignment.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree.

Staff

Dallas College is seeking a strategic and collaborative Assistant Director of Financial Services to lead and enhance the institution's external billing, accounts receivable, collections, and revenue cycle operations.

This leadership role is responsible for driving financial performance by improving collections, reducing receivable aging, strengthening cash flow, and optimizing end-to-end revenue cycle processes. The Assistant Director will lead a team of financial professionals, leverage data and analytics to inform decision-making, and partner with departments across the college to improve operational effectiveness and customer service.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced finance leader who is passionate about process improvement, team development, technology optimization, and creating measurable business impact within a mission-driven organization.


What You'll Do

Lead Revenue Cycle & Financial Operations

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for external billing, sponsored billing, collections, and accounts receivable functions.
  • Oversee the full lifecycle of institutional receivables, ensuring effective processes from invoicing through payment and account resolution.
  • Develop and execute strategies that improve collections performance, reduce aging, strengthen cash flow, and minimize financial risk.
  • Ensure revenue cycle operations are efficient, compliant, and aligned with institutional goals.

Drive Financial Performance & Analytics

  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop executive dashboards, performance metrics, and reports that provide actionable insights to leadership.
  • Forecast receivable performance and recommend strategies that improve collection outcomes.

Improve Processes & Technology

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, efficiency, and customer experience.
  • Partner with stakeholders to optimize Workday and other financial systems supporting billing and collections functions.
  • Drive process redesign efforts that improve service levels, reporting capabilities, and operational performance.
  • Establish and maintain strong internal controls and financial accountability measures.

Build Relationships & Foster Collaboration

  • Ensure timely and accurate communication regarding billing requirements, payment concerns, and compliance-related matters.

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

  • Oversee performance management, succession planning, employee engagement, and professional development initiatives.
  • Empower staff to identify innovative solutions and deliver exceptional results.





Position / Job Summary

The purpose of this position is to support the mission and strategic goals of Dallas College by supporting the day-to-day operations of External Billing and Accounts, specifically overseeing areas of sponsored billing, outside billing, and collections functions, and for developing strategies to accelerate collections, strengthen aging management, and optimize revenue cycle performance through process improvement, automation, analytics, and performance management. This role provides leadership and training to staff, supports daily operations with a focus on exceptional customer service, and promotes continuous improvement in accounting processes and ERP utilization.



Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership and direction for day-to-day operations to support Dallas College and financial compliance.
  • Directly supervise assigned staff, possibly at multiple locations, including hiring recommendations, training, performance management, year-end evaluations, and daily personnel oversight.
  • Serve as the operational owner of the institution's accounts receivable revenue cycle by directing and continuously improving all activities associated with the lifecycle of institutional receivables.
  • Develop and administer strategies to maximize recovery, strengthen aging management, and optimize revenue cycle performance through process improvement, automation, analytics, and performance management.
  • Oversee activities related to cash receipt and account reconciliation to ensure all payments are accurately recorded and reconciled in accordance with regulations and institutional policies.
  • Ensure invoices comply with sponsor requirements, are timely, accurate, contractually compliant, and supported by appropriate documentation.
  • Manage sponsor communications regarding invoice corrections, payment delays, and compliance issues.
  • Collaborate effectively and efficiently with many departments, both on campus and college-wide and within the finance and accounts receivable departments to resolve complex financial issues and ensure the successful execution of revenue cycle operations.
  • Provide strategic recommendations that improve financial performance and strengthen cash flow.
  • Ensure internal controls are established, documented, and consistently followed.
  • Ensure the effective utilization and ongoing improvement of the College’s ERP system.
  • Prepare and present executive reports that evaluate operational and financial performance.
  • Develop executive dashboards that monitor collection effectiveness and provide actionable insights into receivable performance.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the efficiency and effectiveness of the revenue cycle.
  • Manage and drive high performance through coaching, performance management, succession planning, professional development, and implementing initiatives that enhance employee engagement, motivation, and retention.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, customer service, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Minimum of three (3) years of supervisory experience.
  • Five to seven years of progressively responsible experience in accounts receivable, billing, collections, revenue cycle management, or financial operations.

Preferred Qualifications for Role (necessary or mandatory)

  • Master's degree in a related discipline.
  • Higher education finance experience.
  • Bilingual or multilingual preferred.

  • Knowledge of accounts receivable operations
  • Knowledge of contract and third-party billing methodologies
  • Knowledge of collections and recovery strategies
  • Knowledge of cash application and reconciliation

title: Senior Enterprise Data Analyst
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Enterprise Data Analyst to lead the design, development, and governance of enterprise reporting across a complex Wealth Management ecosystem. This role is responsible for ensuring data integrity, consistency, and transparency across multiple reporting systems while enabling actionable insights for executive decision-making.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in data modeling, data reconciliation, and reporting architecture, along with a strong understanding of data flows across custodians, clearing firms, portfolio accounting platforms, and CRM systems. This role will partner closely with business leaders, technology teams, and data stakeholders to standardize reporting and drive data-driven decision making.

Key Responsibilities

Data Modeling & Architecture

  • Design and maintain scalable data models to support enterprise reporting across KPI, AUM/AUA, revenue, and advisor performance metrics
  • Define and standardize data structures, relationships, and hierarchies across multiple reporting systems
  • Partner with IT and data engineering teams to ensure optimal data pipelines and reporting architecture

Data Integrity & Governance

  • Establish and enforce data governance standards, including definitions, lineage, and validation processes
  • Lead reconciliation of data across multiple systems (custodians, clearing firms, CRM, portfolio accounting) to ensure accuracy and completeness
  • Identify and resolve data discrepancies, proactively improving data quality and controls
  • Document data sources, transformations, and reporting logic to ensure transparency and auditability

Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and enhance enterprise reporting frameworks for KPIs, AUM/AUA, revenue, net flows, business performance, and data governance
  • Build dynamic dashboards and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI, Excel data models, or similar platforms
  • Standardize KPI definitions and reporting outputs to ensure consistency across business units and leadership reporting
  • Deliver both recurring and ad hoc reporting with a focus on clarity, accuracy, and timeliness

Insights & Decision Support

  • Analyze financial and operational trends (e.g., net new assets, retention, revenue growth) to generate actionable insights
  • Partner with senior leadership to translate data into strategic recommendations and business actions
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, automation, and scalability

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a key liaison between Business, Technology, Operations, and Finance teams
  • Support enterprise initiatives (e.g., platform transitions, mergers, reporting transformations) by aligning data and reporting requirements
  • Drive adoption of standardized reporting practices across the organization

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business analytics, reporting, or data management (preferably in Wealth Management or Financial Services)
  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel (data modeling, Power Query, PivotTables)
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts (star schema, relational data, normalization)
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets across multiple systems
  • Familiarity with SQL or other data querying tools strongly preferred

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on data accuracy
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data integrity
  • Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, executive-level insights
  • Strong communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and automation

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience in Wealth Management, RIAs, asset management, or broker-dealer environments
  • Knowledge of data flows across custodians, clearing firms, portfolio accounting platforms, and CRM systems
  • Experience supporting enterprise reporting transformation or system integrations
  • Exposure to data governance frameworks and controls in regulated environments

Integrity is one of the nation’s leading independent distributors of life, health and wealth insurance products. With a strong insurtech focus, we embrace a broad and innovative approach to serving agents and clients alike. Integrity is driven by a singular purpose: to help people protect their life, health and wealth so they can prepare for the good days ahead.

title: Mexico Growth Associate
description:
About Telepatia

Telepatia AI is a healthtech company on a mission to transform healthcare in Latin America and beyond. Born at Stanford and built by doctors for doctors, our platform introduces AI Healthcare Employees that work invisibly inside clinical workflows: transcribing consultations in real time, generating structured medical records, offering evidence-based decision support, and integrating seamlessly with any current health system, all without disrupting the physician's flow.

Already adopted by thousands of doctors and leading hospitals across the region, Telepatia has demonstrated measurable impact: reducing cognitive load, improving patient experience, and increasing adherence to clinical protocols.

Our vision is bold: to turn scarcity into abundance by empowering healthcare professionals with scalable, trustworthy intelligence, and to pursue nothing less than the first Nobel Prize in Medicine for Latin America since 1984 with an AI Doctor.

About the role

Mexico has some of the largest private health systems in Latin America: hospital groups, insurers and clinic chains serving millions of patients. Telepatia is building its presence in the country account by account. You help decide which institutions we go after and in what order, open the doors, and carry the analytical weight of every deal: stakeholder maps, pilot structures, ROI models built from the client's own numbers, proposals and letters of intent.

This is not a volume prospecting role. You work a focused list of high-value institutions with deep research and thoughtful outreach, join the conversations that matter, and keep the Country Manager and the founders armed before every call. Your north star: qualified pipeline created, and opportunities that move from first conversation to pilot or contract because of your work.

Core skills: (i) Strategic research and prospecting in enterprise healthcare (ii) Business cases a CFO can trust (iii) Process discipline and relentless follow-through.

One requirement: Be hospital-obsessed and data-obsessed (and cool). Languages: Spanish (native), English (fluent).

What you will do

  • Research and prioritize target hospitals, insurers and clinic chains; map decision makers (owners, CEOs, medical directors, CFOs, CIOs).

  • Run targeted outreach (email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, events) and lead first discovery conversations to qualify interest, fit and urgency.

  • Prepare briefing documents for key meetings: account context, stakeholder map, past interactions, strategic angles.

  • Build business cases and ROI models for pilots and proposals: time saved per doctor, documentation quality, claim denials.

  • Draft proposals, letters of intent and pilot KPI sheets; join high-stakes meetings and make sure follow-up happens on time.

  • Keep the CRM impeccable (accounts, contacts, opportunities, stages, next steps) and build the pipeline and forecast views we run on.

  • Document what works (outreach, talk tracks, objection handling, pilot structures) and build the Mexico sales playbook.

What we look for

More than experience, we look for attitude and drive.

  • 2 to 5 years in B2B enterprise sales, strategy or management consulting, investment banking, corporate development or an analytical role in healthcare.

  • Strong analytical skills; you enjoy building models in Excel or Sheets and can explain them to a non-financial audience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Spanish; professional English.

  • Ability to research and understand complex organizations such as hospital groups and insurers.

  • Building relationships comes naturally to you; executive presence in front of senior stakeholders.

  • Obsession with process, follow-up and CRM discipline; grit, ownership and emotional intelligence.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling to or working with hospitals, insurers or large healthcare providers in Mexico.

  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce or a similar CRM.

  • Healthcare or healthtech background.

What we offer

  • Base salary: USD 2,000 to 3,500 per month, depending on experience.

  • Variable: for 100% attainment, uncapped, based on qualified pipeline and revenue impact.

  • Equity participation.

  • Direct mentorship from the Country Manager, the CRO and the founders.

  • Exposure to C-level conversations in Mexico's largest hospitals and insurers.

  • Career progression into Revenue Manager or Revenue Operations as Mexico scales.

  • Onboarding with the Revenue teams in Colombia and Brazil.

How we work

  • We're always on.

  • We own what we do and don't wait for anyone.

  • We move fast and with focus.

  • We play to win.

What this means for you

  • Ask questions. There are no silos; we grow by learning together.

  • Own your work. Don't wait until tomorrow; don't hand over unfinished work.

  • Speak up. Every voice matters, no matter the title.

  • Focus on impact. Prioritize what moves the needle.

  • Leave things better than you found them. Early stages are messy; your job is to make them less so.

Interview process

  1. Motivation and profile fit: 45 minutes with the People team.

  2. Case exercise: 60 minutes: prospecting plus a business case, with the Country Manager.

  3. Culture and values: 30 minutes with a founder.

title: Data Center Project Manager, US-West CPI
description:
The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operation data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.

We are currently seeking an energetic Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system. The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments, and goals.

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think big; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon data centers then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.



A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.


About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Senior UX Researcher - Enterprise AI Adoption & Workforce Transformation
description:
About Infinitive
Infinitive is a data and AI consultancy that enables its clients to modernize, monetize and operationalize their data to create lasting and substantial value. We possess deep industry and technology expertise to drive and sustain adoption of new capabilities. We match our people and personalities to our clients' culture while bringing the right mix of talent and skills to enable high return on investment.

Infinitive has been named “Best Small Firms to Work For” by Consulting Magazine 9 times, most recently in 2026. Infinitive has also been named a Washington Post “Top Workplace”, Washington Business Journal “Best Places to Work”, and Virginia Business “Best Places to Work.”

About the Role

Infinitive is seeking an experienced Senior UX Researcher – Enterprise AI Adoption & Workforce Transformationto support a large U.S. financial institution in accelerating the adoption and effective use of artificial intelligence across its workforce.

This role is focused on understanding how associates actually work, where they encounter friction, and how AI tools can help them become more effective, productive, and confident in their day-to-day responsibilities.

The ideal candidate is a highly curious, hands-on researcher who enjoys observing people in their working environments, asking thoughtful questions, facilitating discussions, and uncovering opportunities that may not be immediately obvious to users or leadership.

Working across multiple Lines of Business (LOBs), functions, and associate skill levels, you will conduct observational studies, interviews, focus groups, and usability assessments to understand how associates interact with existing processes, enterprise applications, and emerging AI capabilities.

You will go beyond collecting feedback. You will translate research findings into clear, prioritized, actionable recommendations that help technology, product, training, and change management teams improve the associate experience and accelerate the adoption of AI.

This is an opportunity to help shape how AI becomes a practical, trusted, and valuable part of everyday work at one of the country's largest financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

Understand How Associates Work

  • Conduct hands-on observational research, including contextual inquiries, workflow shadowing, and task-based studies, to understand how associates perform their daily responsibilities.
  • Identify repetitive activities, manual processes, information discovery challenges, knowledge gaps, and workflow inefficiencies that may present opportunities for AI-enabled improvements.
  • Evaluate how associates currently use AI assistants, copilots, enterprise search, knowledge tools, and other available technologies.
  • Understand variations in workflows, technology proficiency, and AI adoption across different LOBs, teams, and job functions.
  • Distinguish between challenges that can be addressed through improved training, better tool capabilities, workflow redesign, or broader organizational changes.

Lead Focus Groups and User Research

  • Design, organize, and facilitate focus groups, user interviews, workshops, and structured user studies across diverse associate populations.
  • Engage associates ranging from AI beginners to experienced users to understand differences in needs, confidence, behaviors, and expectations.
  • Create a comfortable, productive research environment that encourages candid feedback and surfaces unmet needs, frustrations, and practical opportunities.
  • Conduct usability testing and task-based evaluations of AI tools, prototypes, and existing enterprise workflows.
  • Develop surveys and qualitative research instruments to measure adoption barriers, associate sentiment, usability, confidence, and perceived value.
  • Partner with LOB leaders and program stakeholders to identify research participants and ensure appropriate representation across teams and roles.

Identify AI Adoption Opportunities and Barriers

  • Analyze associate workflows to identify where AI can help reduce effort, improve quality, accelerate information discovery, and support better decision-making.
  • Identify obstacles to adoption, including limited AI knowledge, unclear use cases, lack of trust, ineffective prompting practices, difficult user experiences, or workflow integration challenges.
  • Observe how associates formulate questions and prompts, evaluate AI-generated responses, and incorporate AI outputs into their work.
  • Identify opportunities to improve AI proficiency through targeted coaching, practical examples, reusable prompts, and role-specific training.
  • Recommend ways to make AI capabilities more accessible, intuitive, relevant, and useful within existing business processes.
  • Recognize where human judgment, oversight, data protection, and established banking controls remain essential.

Turn Research Into Actionable Insights

  • Synthesize observational findings, interviews, focus groups, surveys, and available usage analytics into clear, evidence-based insights.
  • Translate research into practical recommendations for product enhancements, AI use cases, associate enablement, workflow improvements, and adoption strategies.
  • Prioritize findings based on associate impact, business value, adoption potential, feasibility, and implementation effort.
  • Create workflow maps, user journeys, associate personas, opportunity assessments, and concise research summaries.
  • Identify quick wins that can improve the associate experience immediately, alongside longer-term opportunities for AI-enabled transformation.
  • Partner with technology, product, training, and change management teams to turn recommendations into measurable actions.
  • Follow up on implemented improvements to assess whether they address the original associate challenges.

Measure Adoption and Productivity Impact

  • Establish research approaches and baseline measures to understand current workflows, AI proficiency, and adoption maturity.
  • Combine qualitative findings with available quantitative measures, including tool usage, task completion time, user satisfaction, friction points, and self-reported productivity.
  • Identify opportunities to evaluate time savings, reduced manual effort, improved task quality, and increased associate confidence.
  • Conduct follow-up studies to evaluate changes in behavior and effectiveness following training, product improvements, or process changes.
  • Help identify differences between tool availability, actual adoption, effective usage, and measurable business value.
  • Develop practical insights that enable program leadership to understand where AI adoption is working, where additional support is needed, and what to prioritize next.

Collaborate Across the Enterprise

  • Work closely with AI adoption leaders, LOB stakeholders, product managers, UX designers, technology teams, learning and development, and change management partners.
  • Present research findings and recommendations to business sponsors and senior leaders in concise, actionable formats.
  • Facilitate working sessions to align stakeholders around research findings, priorities, and next steps.
  • Establish repeatable methods for gathering feedback and identifying emerging associate needs as AI capabilities evolve.
  • Maintain appropriate research documentation, participant consent, confidentiality, and compliance with enterprise policies for employee information and sensitive banking data.

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in UX research, user research, human factors, design research, organizational research, or a closely related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and conducting observational research, contextual inquiries, workflow studies, interviews, and usability assessments in enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience designing and facilitating focus groups, workshops, and qualitative user studies involving diverse participant groups.
  • Proven ability to uncover underlying problems, distinguish symptoms from root causes, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience studying how employees interact with enterprise applications, technology-enabled workflows, or digital workplace tools.
  • Strong qualitative research skills, complemented by practical experience with surveys, basic quantitative analysis, and behavioral data.
  • Ability to work across multiple business functions, stakeholder groups, and organizational levels.
  • Excellent facilitation, active listening, critical thinking, synthesis, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience developing clear research deliverables such as journey maps, workflow assessments, usability findings, opportunity maps, and prioritized recommendations.
  • Ability to operate independently, manage multiple research initiatives, and adapt to changing program priorities.
  • Understanding of research ethics, confidentiality, informed consent, and responsible handling of employee information.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Anthropology, Sociology, Design, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience researching enterprise AI adoption, generative AI assistants, copilots, or AI-enabled productivity tools.
  • Experience supporting technology adoption or workforce transformation initiatives within a large financial institution or other highly regulated enterprise.
  • Familiarity with how generative AI can support knowledge work, document analysis, information retrieval, writing, summarization, research, and process improvement.
  • Understanding of AI-related user behaviors, including trust, confidence, prompt effectiveness, output validation, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Experience with organizational change management, associate enablement, learning programs, or digital transformation.
  • Experience conducting research across multiple Lines of Business or large, geographically distributed employee populations.
  • Familiarity with research and collaboration platforms such as Dovetail, UserTesting, Qualtrics, Microsoft Forms, Miro, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Ability to analyze available enterprise AI usage telemetry and combine behavioral data with direct research observations.
  • Consulting experience, particularly in client-facing roles requiring strong stakeholder engagement and executive communication.

title: Director, VSP Payment Orchestration
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Job Summary

Visa's Crypto Product Team identifies and scales product opportunities across the emerging crypto, stablecoin, and blockchain network landscape. The team defines Visa's participation in the ecosystem and delivers capabilities that translate strategy into durable client and network value. We are looking for an experienced Director to lead the VSP Payment Orchestration product domain—the capability that routes, sequences, and settles stablecoin-based payments across Visa's network and connected exchange partners. This leader will help drive the vision, strategy, investment priorities, and business outcomes for the orchestration layer connecting VSP to the stablecoin ecosystem


The ideal candidate combines enterprise product strategy, commercial judgment, and technical fluency to shape platform architecture and integration choices at a functional level. This role will partner with senior client, ecosystem, and internal leaders to define scalable solutions, establish a multi-year product and investment roadmap, and align global teams around measurable outcomes. The Director will lead the full product lifecycle across a portfolio of initiatives, from market discovery and prioritization through technical integration, launch, commercialization, and post-launch optimization.


This role requires exceptional product judgment, disciplined portfolio execution, and the ability to lead through influence across product, engineering, design, operations, legal, risk, compliance, treasury, finance, sales, and regional teams. The successful candidate will be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making and escalating complex tradeoffs, presenting investment and product recommendations to executives, and establishing strong governance across multiple delivery teams. The Director will develop product talent, raise the quality of product management practices, and ensure AI tools are embedded responsibly in day-to-day work with appropriate human oversight, security, and quality controls.


Essential Functions

title: OIPA Configurator III
description:
At Globe Life, we are committed to empowering our employees with the support and opportunities they need to succeed at every stage of their career. We take pride in fostering a caring and innovative culture that enables us to collectively grow and overcome challenges in a connected, collaborative, and mutually respectful environment that calls us to help Make Tomorrow Better.

Role Overview:

Could you be our next OIPA Configurator III? Globe Life is looking for an OIPA Configurator III to join the team!

This role is responsible for configuring and maintaining the Oracle Insurance Policy Administration (OIPA) system in support of life and accident insurance products. The position partners with business and technical stakeholders to evaluate complex requirements and deliver OIPA configuration solutions across new implementations, enhancements, and production support. It directs the application of configuration principles, guides the development of new policies and best practices, and advises others on complex matters while leading configurators during key project phases.

This is a Remote position

What You Will Do:

  • Review and interpret architectural and technical design documents to independently develop complex OIPA transactions and processes, applying best practice configuration techniques with full autonomy and extensive latitude for judgment.
  • Evaluate specifications for complex business requirements and processes (new, enhancements, and maintenance) and develop technical solutions and supporting documentation using advanced, wide-ranging OIPA expertise.
  • Develop AsFile, Real-time, and Push integration services; research and evaluate system capabilities for integrating product, service, and technical solutions to enable business partners.
  • Perform functional gap analysis, review and contribute to design documentation, and participate in design reviews, exercising independent judgment in selecting and adapting complex configuration techniques.
  • Design logical queries to facilitate calculations, reporting, and complex formulas using entity-based logical modeling and data throughput optimization.
  • Develop Technical Design Documents and prepare complex design diagrams, directing the application of existing principles and guiding the development of new configuration policies and standards.
  • Lead other configurators during select phases of projects and production support, providing tactical guidance and being accountable through the team for delivery of business targets.
  • Perform code reviews and work with peers across disciplines to identify standardization opportunities, adapting style and using persuasion to deliver messages aligned to wider business objectives.
  • Train and mentor other team members, frequently advising on complex configuration matters to build team capability and consistency.
  • Research, identify, and correct defects, ensuring defects attributed to assigned tasks do not exceed 15% of the original work completed.

What You Can Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent experience.
  • Bachelor's degree with at least 8 years of OIPA configuration experience; or a Master's with 6 years; or a PhD with 3 years — subject to department review.
  • A minimum of 8,000 hours (~4 years) of hands-on OIPA configuration experience on life or health insurance products using OIPA V10 or V11.
  • Strong knowledge of life and health insurance products across individual, group, and worksite markets, including core business functions such as underwriting, policy issue, billing, payment processing, claims, nonforfeiture, lapse, disbursements, state reporting, and policy servicing.
  • LOMA certification preferred.
  • Advanced XSLT and OIPA configuration expertise, including deep knowledge of OIPA database schema, relational objects, entity-based logical modeling, data throughput optimization, and REST services.
  • Knowledge of OIPA interface configuration and Oracle SOA/BPM across cross-disciplinary technical relationships — Oracle SOA/BPM experience is a plus.
  • Ability to independently define methods on new assignments and contribute to configuration policies and best practices.
  • Effective collaborator across teams; aligns business intent with system behavior.
  • Comfortable in Agile environments; provides accurate estimates, meets deadlines, maintains project artifacts, and proactively communicates risks to project and program management.

Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

  • Reliable and predictable attendance of your assigned shift.

  • Ability to work full time and/or part time based on the position specifications.

How Globe Life Will Support You:

Looking to continue your career in an environment that values your contribution and invests in your growth? We've curated a benefits package that helps to ensure that you don’t just work, but thrive at Globe Life:

  • Competitive compensation designed to reflect your expertise and contribution.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans because your well-being is fundamental to your performance.

  • Robust life insurance benefits and retirement plans, including company-matched 401k and pension plan.

  • Paid holidays and time off to support a healthy work-life balance.

  • Parental leave to help our employees welcome their new additions.

  • Subsidized all-in-one subscriptions to support your fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep goals.

  • Company-paid counseling for assistance with mental health, stress management, and work-life balance.

  • Continued education reimbursement eligibility and company-paid FLMI and ICA courses to grow your career.

  • Discounted Texas Rangers tickets for a proud visit to Globe Life Field.

Opportunity awaits! Invest in your professional legacy, realize your path, and see the direct impact you can make in a workplace that celebrates and harnesses your unique talents and perspectives to their fullest potential. At Globe Life, your voice matters.

title: Senior Project Manager, eDiscovery Services
description:
Job Description

As an early adopter of advanced eDiscovery technology and methodologies, the Firm's Global eDiscovery Services Department provides strategic services to our disputes lawyers and clients. Working alongside other talented professionals, you'll be surrounded by an open and collaborative culture that embraces recognition and professional development.


The Sr. Project Manager, eDiscovery Services serves as a trusted advisor to legal teams and clients, independently leading complex eDiscovery matters and developing defensible strategies that leverage technology across the discovery lifecycle. The role manages scope, cost, risk, quality and delivery, requiring sophisticated knowledge of eDiscovery technology, corporate information systems, emerging data sources and the ability to translate technical issues into practical recommendations.

  • Develop strategies for data reduction, search, analytics and AI review, including search term calibration, conceptual analytics, continuous active learning/TAR, statistical sampling and validation.
  • Manage review workflows for responsiveness, privilege, confidentiality, quality control, productivity and reporting.
  • Develop budgets, forecasts, work plans and resource requirements; monitor scope, costs, vendor spend and delivery risks.
  • Oversee vendors providing forensic collection, processing, hosting and managed review services.
  • Prepare matter metrics and reporting on data volumes, review progress, quality, costs and timelines.
  • Maintain defensible documentation of key decisions, methodologies, assumptions, validations and quality control activities.
  • Escalate and resolve complex issues involving projects, technology, vendors and client service.
  • Mentor Project Managers and Project Analysts through coaching, delegation, review of work product and guidance on active matters.
  • Contribute to standards, playbooks, technology evaluation, process improvement and professional development initiatives.
  • Monitor eDiscovery case law, industry standards and emerging technologies and apply relevant developments to matter strategy and team practices.

Other duties

Please note this job description does not cover or contain all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

This position is remote and can therefore be located in any city where we have a US office. Flexibility to visit the office for training or meetings is required.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required.

  • Experience managing budgets, forecasts, resources, delivery risks and outside providers.
  • Extensive experience with analytics and technology assisted review (TAR) workflows, including continuous active learning, conceptual analytics and validation; experience with AI or generative AI review tools preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency with Relativity/RelativityOne or comparable enterprise eDiscovery platforms required; Relativity Certified Administrator (RCA) certification preferred but not required.
  • Strong knowledge of corporate IT systems and client IT collaboration for identification, preservation and collection strategies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to legal teams, clients and stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects independently and consistently deliver quality results.
  • Ability to train, mentor, delegate to and review the work of Project Analysts and Project Managers while remaining engaged in matter delivery.
  • Ability to work effectively under rigorous deadlines and exercise sound judgment in sensitive situations or under pressure.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Flexibility to support urgent matters and global stakeholders, including early mornings, evenings and occasional weekends.

Employees can also access pre-tax benefits such as health savings and flexible spending accounts. Company Description

Showtime Consulting is a leading provider of Shielded Cloud and Digital Solutions across Australia and New Zealand. We specialise in delivering secure, enterprise-scale technology solutions across cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, business applications, data, and digital transformation programs.

We partner with government and enterprise organisations to build high-performing technology teams that deliver scalable, secure, and future-ready business solutions.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and support enterprise-scale data platforms and data integration solutions within Microsoft Azure environments.

This role is suited to a hands-on data professional with strong experience across data engineering, data warehousing, cloud-based analytics platforms, and modern data architectures. You will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, analysts, and development teams to deliver high-quality, trusted, and scalable data solutions that support reporting, analytics, and business decision-making.

You will play a key role in designing and optimising data pipelines, improving data quality, implementing governance controls, and driving best practices across the data ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Build and support Azure-based data platforms and enterprise data solutions.
  • Develop data integration frameworks to ingest, transform, and deliver data from multiple source systems.
  • Implement and support solutions using Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure SQL.
  • Design and optimise data warehouse and lakehouse architectures.
  • Develop data transformation logic using Python, PySpark, and SQL.
  • Create and maintain reusable data engineering frameworks, pipelines, and automation processes.
  • Perform data modelling activities to support reporting, analytics, and operational requirements.
  • Manage large-scale structured and unstructured datasets across cloud platforms.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise data pipelines to ensure performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and resolve complex data-related issues.
  • Implement data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance processes.
  • Develop monitoring and alerting mechanisms to proactively identify data issues.
  • Support data migration and modernisation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to gather and analyse requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and data models.
  • Implement and maintain data governance, security, and compliance controls.
  • Ensure adherence to enterprise standards, privacy requirements, and data management policies.
  • Produce technical documentation, data dictionaries, solution designs, and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and cloud data platform best practices.
  • Work within Agile delivery teams and participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

What You'll Need

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or a related data-focused role.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and integration solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with the Microsoft Azure Data Platform, including:
    • Azure Data Factory (ADF)
    • Azure Databricks
    • Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)
    • Azure Synapse Analytics
    • Azure SQL
  • Strong experience with SQL development, performance tuning, database optimisation, and query troubleshooting.
  • Proven experience in data modelling for enterprise data platforms and analytics solutions.
  • Strong understanding of ETL/ELT methodologies and modern cloud-based data architectures.
  • Experience developing solutions using Python, PySpark, and/or Scala.
  • Experience managing data quality, validation, monitoring, reconciliation, and issue resolution processes.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets in enterprise environments.
  • Ability to produce high-quality technical documentation and solution designs.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Experience working within Agile and cross-functional delivery teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience designing modern cloud-native data platforms and lakehouse architectures.
  • Knowledge of data governance frameworks, master data management, and metadata management practices.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives.
  • Exposure to government, regulated, or highly secure environments is highly regarded.

Why Join Us?

  • Deliver large-scale Azure data and analytics transformation programs.
  • Work with leading cloud technologies including Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, and Data Factory.
  • Partner with architects, data specialists, and business leaders on strategic initiatives.
  • Contribute to modern data platform, governance, and analytics uplift programs.
  • Join a consulting culture focused on innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Access exciting projects across government and enterprise organisations throughout Australia and New Zealand.

We Are Always Looking For Top Talent In Cybersecurity, Cloud, And Defence Tech.

Build solutions that protect defence, national security, and enterprise clients.

At Showtime Consulting, We Hire And Develop The Best Minds In Cybersecurity.

Our Values Shape Everything We Do

Security

Critical for building trust with stakeholders and maintaining ethical standards in all operations, especially in such sensitive sectors.

Necessary for staying ahead of technological advancements and threats, ensuring solutions are cutting-edge and effective.

Demonstrates dedication to the mission, the safety and security of clients' data, and the success of their operations.

Important for providing reliable and consistent service, which is crucial for defense and intelligence operations that depend on continuity and dependability.

Fuels the drive to excel, innovate, and overcome challenges. It's the emotional investment in the mission and the work, which can inspire teams and lead to exceptional outcomes.

description:
Job Description Summary

Using advanced data management tools and techniques, provide professional and lean execution of Data Management products and milestones with respect to cost, quality and timelines for all assigned trials within Clinical Data Acquisition and Management.   • Generates the study status reports for use at Clinical trial team meetings.
  • Supports and assists Junior staff for assigned trials -Provides effective input into DM initiatives and innovations for quality, efficiency and continuous improvement in scientific and operational excellence -Leads /Coordinates synonym review activities and dictionary version upgrade activities at trial /Program level.
  • Serves as primary study lead ensuring timely and quality deliverables by establishing and maintaining strong working relationships with study teams, and functional lines.
  • Acts as a technical consultant as required.

Minimum Requirements

  • Ability to work under pressure demonstrating agility through effective and innovative team leadership
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and proven ability to operate effectively in a global environment. Ability to influence and communicate across functions and to external stakeholder
  • Proven ability to interrogate and view data though various programming/GUI techniques
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Ideally 4 years’ experience in Drug Development with at least 3 years in Clinical Data Management
  • Excellent verbal and written skills


Skills Desired

Clinical Data Management, Data Governance, Data Integrity, Data Management, Data Quality, Data Science, Waterfall Model

title: Member Experience Guide
description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.
