title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - South Bank, QLD
description:
Job Description Senior Full Stack Engineer - South Bank, QLD

Job no: 532742

Brand: Product and Technology

Work type: Full time

Location: Queensland

Categories: Digital and Technology

At Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) our purpose is to 'open up the world for those who want to see'. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to experience something amazing, travel!

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help us build and scale a travel platform relied on by some of Australia's largest corporate operators. It's a full stack role for someone who genuinely enjoys the hard problems: complex, high availability systems that process high volume travel booking at scale, end to end, from backend services through to the interfaces people rely on every day.

You’ll be a key technical contributor on capabilities that matter, the kind of work that shapes how thousands of travellers experience booking, changing, and managing their trips. You won't be maintaining someone else's legacy code in isolation; you'll be designing and building new capability from the ground up, including change and cancellation support, waitlist management, and deep policy engine integration, then owning it end to end in production. This is a chance to make decisions that stick: the architecture you choose, the standards you set, and the patterns you introduce will shape how the platform evolves for years to come.

Day to day: Core Backend Development
  • Design, build, and own complex backend services and APIs using C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core), with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and correctness
  • Deliver new modules including: change and cancellation processing, waitlist capability, and policy engine integration across the travel platform
  • Implement and consume RESTful APIs and SOAP/Web Services that integrate with airline GDS systems, internal booking engines, and third party travel platforms
  • Build robust, fault tolerant service components capable of handling high volume, time critical travel booking
Frontend Development
  • Design and build responsive, accessible user interfaces in React that give travel bookers and administrators a clear, reliable view into complex processes
  • Own end to end feature delivery: from API design through to the React components and state management that consume them
  • Work with component libraries and design systems to keep the UI consistent, maintainable, and easy to extend
  • Optimise frontend performance (load times, rendering, bundle size) for users working in time critical, high pressure booking scenarios
System Reliability & Observability
  • Ensure the platform maintains high uptime, this is a mission critical system for travel operations; downtime has direct operational impact
  • Instrument services with Datadog, including APM tracing, custom metrics, log correlation, and dashboard creation to provide full observability across the travel booking stack, frontend and backend
  • Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs, respond to incidents, and lead post incident reviews to drive continuous reliability improvement
  • Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, memory issues, and degradation patterns before they impact customers
Architecture & Technical Leadership
  • Lead technical design for new capabilities, producing clear architecture and API design documentation before implementation
  • Conduct rigorous code reviews and hold the team to high standards for API design, exception handling, test coverage, component quality, and service contract quality
  • Identify and reduce technical debt, particularly around legacy integration patterns, file based data exchange, and monolithic components
  • Mentor and support junior and mid level engineers, particularly on C# best practices, .NET internals, React patterns, and API design
DevOps & Delivery
  • Champion DevOps practices across the team: CI/CD pipeline ownership, automated testing (unit, integration, contract, and frontend), and deployment hygiene
  • Collaborate with platform and cloud engineering on Azure based infrastructure, ensuring services are containerised, scalable, and maintainable
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and business stakeholders to translate complex travel booking requirements into clean, maintainable full stack solutions
  • Participate actively in agile delivery processes, sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives and drive continuous improvement
You will be perfect for the role if you have:
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with deep, hands on expertise across both C# / .NET (.NET 6+, ideally .NET 8) and React, comfortable owning features end to end rather than favouring one side of the stack
  • Proficient with AI coding tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot) and able to critically evaluate AI generated code in production contexts
  • Expert level knowledge of the .NET ecosystem: ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, .NET Identity, and integration frameworks such as MassTransit or NServiceBus
  • Expert level experience with React, including hooks, component driven architecture, state management, and building maintainable, well tested frontend applications
  • Strong track record designing and building complex REST APIs and Web Services (SOAP/WSDL); including versioning, contract design, and error handling at scale
  • Proven ability to instrument and operate production systems using Datadog: APM, dashboards, monitors, log pipelines, and AI powered anomaly detection and forecasting features
  • Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Sybase) including complex query optimisation and schema design
Highly Regarded
  • Experience in travel technology GDS systems (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo), NDC, PNR management, travel platforms
  • Background in resource scheduling and logistics
  • Familiarity with API gateways, service mesh, microservices strategies
  • Azure cloud experience: App Services, AKS, Service Bus, Application Insights
  • Experience with design systems, component libraries, or accessibility (WCAG) standards
Tech Stack
  • .NET 6 / 8, ASP.NET Core, C#
  • React, JavaScript, HTML/CSS

  • Entity Framework Core, .NET Identity, MassTransit or NServiceBus

  • Azure (App Services, AKS, Service Bus, Storage)
  • GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, automated CI/CD pipelines
  • xUnit / NUnit, Moq, Jest / React Testing Library, integration and contract testing
What you will enjoy:

description:

  • Acompañar activaciones, eventos, KOLs y sesiones con distribuidores.

  • Garantizar que toda la formación esté alineada a lineamientos regulatorios y clínicos.
  • Reporte y seguimiento de casos, quejas clínicas o farmacovigilancia cuando aplique.
  • Mantener estándares de bioseguridad y documentación de entrenamientos.

5. Reporting y Gestión Operativa

  • Gestionar el uso de plataformas LMS / CRM para registrar capacitaciones.

Restauradora

  • Adhesión: manejo de esmalte/dentina, técnicas universal / total-etch / self-etch.
  • Resinas compuestas: técnicas incremental y bulk-fill, control de contracción y fotocurado.
  • Sistemas de matrices, cuñas, anillos y anclajes.
  • Cementación adhesiva y convencional para diferentes materiales restaurativos.
  • Acabado, pulido y protocolos de brillo.

  • Acceso, anatomía de cámara y localización de canales.
  • Glide path y conformación con NiTi; conceptos de torque, velocidad y cinemática.
  • Irrigación (NaOCl, EDTA, CHX) y activación.
  • Conometría, obturación (fría y caliente) y retratamiento.
  • Prevención de fractura y gestión de instrumentación.

  • Habilidad pedagógica y claridad en la comunicación.
  • Pensamiento crítico y resolución de problemas clínicos.

  • Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad a diferentes estilos de aprendizaje y audiencias.
  • Comunicación efectiva.
  • Manejo de objeciones clínicas.

Job Requirements:

  • Formación: Cirujano Dentista (indispensable).
  • Deseable: posgrado, diplomado o experiencia en Endodoncia o Restauradora.
  • Experiencia: mínimo 1–3 años impartiendo cursos o entrenamiento clínico.

  • Manejo de Paquete Office Intermedio

title: Sr Product Manager, Internet Wi-Fi Management
description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Contributes to T-Mobile success by strategizing, defining, planning, delivering, and maintaining large and complex products and product enhancements that improve customer experience, deliver growth to the enterprise, drive efficiencies, increase revenue, reduce churn, and scale the business. This role is focused on the end-to-end in-home Wi-Fi customer experience within the Broadband Home Internet division, including managed Wi-Fi capabilities, Wi-Fi performance visibility, and assisted technical support workflows that help customers get reliable connectivity throughout the home. Leads and collaborates effectively with cross-functional business, network, operations, Care, OEM, and software vendor teams to advocate for internal and external customers, uncover opportunities, and implement new solutions. Ultimately accountable and responsible for a specific area of ownership. Individuals with this title within the Broadband organization take on a variety of responsibilities ranging from: partnering with Commercial, Marketing, Care and other teams on customer insight, soliciting and generating product requirements, creating roadmaps, mapping out and communicating the customer experience, planning and driving delivery across all involved stakeholders from end-to-end, proactively identifying and mitigating risks, facilitating team meetings, monitoring and communicating delivery status, and more.

This is a hybrid position required to be working in-office at least 3 days a week.

RESPONSIBILITIES:


Product Vision, Strategy & Analysis

  • Own end-to-end product experience for high-complexity Broadband products, features, or capabilities, with emphasis on in-home Wi-Fi, managed Wi-Fi, gateway/CPE experience, and assisted support — defining and communicating the vision and strategy.
  • Leverage customer and technical insights to guide strategy, roadmap, and priorities.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Commercial, Engineering, UX, Data Analytics, and Frontline teams to identify opportunities, analyze performance, and recommend solutions that support organizational OKRs.
  • Conduct financial and product analysis (e.g., cost-benefit, ROI, NPV) to support prioritization and decision-making.
  • Influence and present recommendations to executive stakeholders (VP/SVP/EVP), using compelling product and experience presentations.
  • Monitor and report on product health and customer experience metrics, including Wi-Fi performance, churn indicators, NPS, support call drivers and support outcomes; keep current with industry trends to inform innovation.
  • Foster a customer-first culture within the team.
  • Align with network, software, hardware, firmware, Care, and operations teams to translate customer and business needs into technical and operational requirements for CPEs, wi-fi telemetry, and managed Wi-Fi solutions.
  • Use Wi-Fi telemetry, Frontline insights, and other operational data to identify experience gaps, prioritize improvements, and shape a roadmap that improves reliability, supportability, and customer confidence in home connectivity.
  • Lead build, buy, or partner evaluations for managed Wi-Fi platforms, CPE software capabilities, telemetry solutions, and support/troubleshooting tools by bringing clear product judgment, customer context, and technical fluency to the decision-making process.

Project Management

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and mobilize teams across the enterprise to plan and deliver solutions.
  • Guide initiatives through agile, waterfall, or hybrid processes as needed.
  • Drive creation of end-to-end delivery schedules and track progress vs plan. Communicate updates, risks, and changes across all levels.
  • Proactively manage risks to scope, timeline, and budget, recommending mitigation strategies.
  • Facilitate team meetings, follow through on action items, and ensure documentation is complete and transferred for operational readiness.
  • Ensure resource/funding approvals and compliance with enterprise processes.
  • Serve as a liaison between product, engineering, network infrastructure, Care, operations, OEMs, and third-party platform stakeholders to ensure successful delivery, operational readiness, and cohesive roadmaps for fixed wireless and managed Wi-Fi capabilities.
  • Coordinate across teams to ensure new Wi-Fi-related capabilities can be tested, launched, supported, monitored, and improved at fleet scale, including appropriate readiness planning for Care and technical support channels.

Product Execution

  • Translate product strategy into detailed requirements across complex systems and teams. Guide engineering and development teams to deliver against those requirements.
  • Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing technical debt, production defects, and customer needs against organizational goals.
  • Collaborate with architecture and development teams to embed long-term tech investments into the roadmap.
  • Provide product clarity and support throughout design, development, and testing phases.
  • Make final scope and experience trade-off decisions during product delivery lifecycle.
  • Translate technical network, gateway, CPE, telemetry, and support requirements into clear product artifacts and agile backlogs for teams building managed Wi-Fi capabilities, monitoring tools, diagnostics, provisioning systems, and support experiences.
  • Partner with engineering, firmware, test, Care enablement, and vendors/OEMs to translate complex Wi-Fi connectivity challenges into prioritized, executable work that improves compatibility, reliability, and customer self-service or assisted support outcomes.

Collaboration & Professional Growth

  • Foster strong relationships across technical and non-technical teams, including vendors and third-party partners.
  • Maintain professional knowledge via workshops, publications, networking, frontline visits, and customer feedback sessions.
  • Serve as a product-oriented Wi-Fi domain expert and bridge across customer care, field and frontline teams, engineering, and business stakeholders, helping translate technical constraints into clear customer and business implications.
  • Mentor peers across teams on best practices, product knowledge, and collaboration.
  • Support other duties/projects as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Backlog Management
  • Business Acumen
  • Customer Experience Design
  • Data Analysis
  • Financial Modeling
  • Go-to-Market Strategies
  • Product Management
  • Product Roadmap
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Strategic Thinking

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Networking, IT or related studies plus 7 years of related work experience, or Advanced degree with 5 years of related experience.
  • 7 years Product Management experience in a software product development environment delivering large business/technology initiatives. Experience in mixed software and hardware environments preferred.
  • Wi-Fi / 802.11 domain experience, including practical familiarity with consumer and/or managed Wi-Fi, mesh networking, and consumer-premise hardware.
  • Familiarity with specific Wi-Fi and networking concepts such as Wi-Fi 6/6E/7, mesh, roaming standards such as 802.11k/v/r, RF environment challenges, RSSI, latency, channel utilization, and band or access point handoffs.
  • Familiarity with CPE software platforms and device management frameworks, such as RDK-B, OpenSync, prplOS, proprietary OEM firmware, TR-069, TR-369 USP, and TR-181. Specific experience with any one platform or standard is beneficial but not required.
  • Experience using telemetry, support data, customer feedback, and product analytics to identify Wi-Fi performance issues, prioritize improvements, and connect technical product health to customer experience outcomes.
  • Experience designing, proposing, or otherwise improving assisted troubleshooting or frontline support workflows for technical connectivity issues is strongly preferred.
  • Experience contributing to vendor, OEM, chipset, or managed Wi-Fi platform evaluations, technical RFPs, SOWs, or build/buy/partner assessments is beneficial.
  • Ability to bridge business and technical goals in a highly cross-functional environment.
  • Communicate with Leadership, while employing a high degree of collaboration and influence.
  • Strong ability to identify/analyze/synthesize product use data.
  • Strong requirements elicitation, and the ability to write concisely and clearly for different audiences.
  • Experience with successful collaboration and facilitation across diverse audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail. Ability to consider, think, and communicate at all levels.
  • Strategic and creative ideation and problem solving.
  • Solid understanding of customer experience, including how connectivity quality, product reliability, supportability, and frontline resolution paths influence customer satisfaction, retention, and cost to serve.
  • Product Owner Certification (CSPO) or Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) beneficial but not required.
  • At least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

Optum intro standard Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

Do you want to impact decisions to help people live healthier lives? Are you an innovative Data Engineer who thrives on developing new solutions to solve tough challenges?

We want to achieve more in our mission of health care, and so we have to be really smart about the business of health care. At Optum, we're changing the landscape of our industry. You will put your Data Engineering skills to work as you empower business partners and team members improve healthcare delivery.

As a Senior Data Engineer , you will be working on developing and maintaining data pipelines that extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into a centralized data storage system, such as a data warehouse or data lake. Ensure the smooth flow of data from source systems to destination systems while adhering to data quality and integrity standards. In addition to having an impact on a great team, you'll also discover the career opportunities you'd expect from an Industry Leader. You will also work closely with the Data Science and Business Intelligence teams to develop a new, cutting-edge big-data analytic platform and that will support advanced solutions to improve health outcomes for our members.

You'll be in the driver's seat on vital projects that have strategic importance to our mission of helping people live healthier lives. Yes, we share a mission that inspires. And we need your organizational talents and business discipline to help fuel that mission.

Primary Responsibilities:
  • Data Integration: Integrate data from multiple sources and systems, including databases, APIs, log files, streaming platforms, and external data providers. Handle data ingestion, transformation, and consolidation to create a unified and reliable data foundation for analysis and reporting
  • Data Transformation and Processing: Develop data transformation routines to clean, normalize, and aggregate data. Apply data processing techniques to handle complex data structures, handle missing or inconsistent data, and prepare the data for analysis, reporting, or machine learning tasks
  • Contribute to common frameworks and best practices in code development, deployment, and automation/orchestration of data pipelines
  • Implement data governance and data de-identification framework in line with company standards
  • Partner with Data Analytics and Product leaders to design best practices and standards for developing and productionising analytic pipelines
  • Partner with Infrastructure leaders on architecture approaches to advance the data and analytics platform, including exploring new tools (including AI) and techniques that leverage the cloud environment (Azure, Snowflake, others)
  • Monitoring and Support: Monitor data pipelines and data systems to detect and resolve issues promptly. Develop monitoring tools, alerts, and automated error handling mechanisms to ensure data integrity and system reliability
Required Qualifications:
  • Proven extensive experience designing data solutions including solid understanding of architectural patterns, system design principles, data modelling, and large-scale solution development
  • Proven extensive hands‑on experience developing data processing jobs (PySpark /SQL) that demonstrate a solid understanding of software engineering principles
  • Proven experience with Azure Databricks and Snowflake
  • Proven experience orchestrating data pipelines using technology like ADF, Airflow, etc.
  • Proven experience working with Spark
  • Demonstrated advanced SQL skills and deep experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server), including optimization, stored procedures, and performance tuning for high-volume applications
  • Proven experience with DevOps tools, Git workflow and building CI/CD pipelines
  • Demonstrated experience applying data governance controls, data masking, and data de‑identification rules within a highly regulated environment
  • Demonstrated excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Proven experience analyzing and improving workflows by evaluating process maps and flowcharts, identifying inefficiencies, and recommending enhancements to workflows, procedures, technology, and tools
  • Demonstrated familiarity with scripting languages like Java or Scala
  • Proven ability to be a motivated self‑starter who excels at managing their own tasks and takes ownership

title: AI Engineer III – Agentic Platform
description:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.

About Amtech

Amtech LLC is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging and manufacturing industries, helping businesses streamline operations, improve productivity, and drive sustainable growth. With a strong focus on innovation and customer success, Amtech continues to expand its global footprint and deliver technology that empowers teams around the world.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:

Purpose

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.

Growth

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.

Culture

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.

Innovation

Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

Role Description

Amtech LLC is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to build and scale the Agentic Platform behind Amtech AI Intelligence — a headless, MCP-native intelligence layer across packaging and labels, and data that is callable by any AI, on any screen. This role takes Amtech's first production agent pattern and turns it into a reusable platform component that extends cleanly to EnCore, LabelTraxx, Siteline, Scorekeeper, and future use cases, rather than building a one-off solution per product. This is a senior, largely self-directed role: you'll set technical direction for the platform, make build-vs-buy calls on agent tooling, and be a technical reference point for the Forward Deployed Engineers embedding it into product pods. Curiosity about emerging agentic AI and LLM tooling, and comfort operating close to production systems and governed customer data, are essential.

Job Description

Headless, MCP-Native Architecture

  • Build business logic that runs independent of any screen — the same capability must work for a person in the UI, an AI agent, or an automated job.
  • Expose Amtech capabilities as MCP-described tools so any AI model can call them.

Orchestration and Agent Execution

  • Build and maintain the LLM orchestration layer that turns model output into safe, governed, tool-using actions.
  • Implement and extend agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Retrieval and Model Integration

  • Build and tune RAG pipelines for grounding agent responses in Amtech's own data.
  • Integrate model-agnostic LLM providers — Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and whatever model leads next — via a common provider abstraction, avoiding vendor lock-in.

Governed On-Prem Data Access (the Data Agent)

  • Build and maintain the Data Agent — new technology that reads EnCore and other customer data directly for inferencing, with no dependency on legacy point-to-point APIs.
  • Ensure every agent action passes governed approval gates before it executes, with a complete, queryable audit trail — customer data stays in the customer's environment while still enabling cloud-LLM reasoning over it.

Building Amtech AI Intelligence Capabilities

  • Extend the platform into concrete delivered capabilities such as Schedule Intelligence (watching schedules, flagging conflicts and trim-loss, proposing re-sequencing), Order & Customer Intelligence (full-context status across specs, history, and dates), Docs & Knowledge (cited, grounded answers with stale-document detection), and Forecast & KPI Intelligence (plain-language questions over throughput, waste, and OTIF).

Plugging Into Amtech's Broader Agent Portfolio

  • Amtech already runs 10+ active agents company-wide — this role's platform work is what lets patterns from those efforts be reused instead of rebuilt.
  • Directly support the Utilization mandate to extend engineering's agent-building cadence to Sales, Support, and Customer Success, so new agents in those functions can be built on the same governed orchestration, RAG, and audit foundation rather than one-off tooling.

Scaling the Platform Pattern Across Product Lines

  • Turn Amtech's first production agent pattern into a reusable platform component that other product pods can adopt without a rebuild.
  • Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers embedded in product pods to validate the platform against real workflows and feed field learnings back into the roadmap.

Deployment, Monitoring, and Cost Control

  • Deploy agents and inference endpoints on AWS (e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, SageMaker) and integrate them into existing APIs and microservices.
  • Set up evals, cost controls, and basic observability to catch regressions, drift, or runaway spend before they reach customers.

Bridging into ML Engineering and MLOps

  • Bring enough classical ML engineering and MLOps fluency (feature stores, model registries, CI/CD for models, drift monitoring) to partner effectively with the Data Science, ML Engineering, and MLOps functions, not just the agentic/LLM side of the platform.
  • As a senior technical voice on the team, weigh in on production practices — deployment, monitoring, retraining — across both agentic and classical ML workloads as the org scales toward a lead role.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
  • 4-6 years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years hands-on building production systems with large language models.
  • Demonstrated experience setting technical direction and reviewing the work of other engineers, even if not a formal people-management role.
  • Strong Python programming skills.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph).
  • Experience integrating at least one major LLM provider API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock).
  • Hands-on AWS experience (e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) deploying and operating production workloads in the cloud.
  • Experience with model inferencing — real-time and batch — including optimizing latency, throughput, and cost for LLM or ML workloads.
  • Experience building or consuming RAG pipelines and working with vector databases.
  • Working knowledge of classical ML engineering and MLOps practices (e.g., feature stores, model registries, MLflow/Kubeflow-style CI/CD for models) — enough to partner with Data Science, ML Engineering, and MLOps, not necessarily hands-on ownership.
  • Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployment.
  • Working knowledge of Git and CI/CD practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-tool integration standards.
  • Experience building governed, read-only data access layers (audit logging, guardrails, least-privilege access).
  • Exposure to Kubernetes and cloud AI/inferencing platforms (AWS Bedrock, AWS SageMaker); AWS certification is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Experience working with ERP, MES, or other industrial/manufacturing data environments.
  • Prior experience embedding directly with a product team or customer-facing engineering effort.
  • Familiarity with performance monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog).

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

title: Web Developer (AI-Led)
description:
Web Developer (AI-Led)

Job Title: Web Developer (AI - Led)

Role Overview

The role

We're after a technical-first developer who also knows good design when they see it. You'll help build the future of Visions, using AI and LLM-powered workflows to design, build and ship smarter. You'll also look after our existing client sites, keeping them secure, fast and happy.

This isn't a job for someone who wants to do things the way they've always been done. We want someone who looks for the smarter way, spots what can be automated and gets genuinely excited about new tools.

If you can write clean code and also tell us when a layout feels off, we want to talk to you.

We work hybrid, with four days at home and one day together in the Warrington and surrounding areas. That weekly get-together is where a lot of our collaboration happens, so you'll need to be able to travel to the area once a week.

What you'll be doing

Building forward

  • Building sites and digital experiences with the design team, turning Figma designs into fast, responsive and accessible builds
  • Using AI and LLM tools to speed up development, automate repetitive jobs and build smarter solutions for clients
  • Exploring new tech and bringing ideas to the table that keep us ahead of the curve
  • Working with integrations like HubSpot, Zapier and Microsoft Clarity

Looking after our existing clients

  • Keeping existing client sites up to date, secure and performing well
  • Finding ways to streamline and automate maintenance so it takes less time and causes fewer headaches
  • Auditing sites and spotting opportunities to improve them, from performance boosts to smarter builds
  • Helping the team have honest, useful conversations with clients about what's next for their site

Across the board

  • Using Bitbucket and DeployHQ to keep our code tidy and deployments smooth
  • Handling bug reports and feedback through Marker.io
  • Working closely with designers, and speaking up when something doesn't look or feel right

What We're Looking For

Technical first

  • Solid front-end skills: HTML, CSS and JavaScript
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and LLMs, and ideally experience using them to build and ship work
  • Experience maintaining, securing and optimising live sites
  • Comfortable with Git-based version control and deployment tools
  • Quick to pick up new platforms and tools
  • A problem-solver who looks for the smarter way, not just the familiar one

A good eye

This is the bit that really matters to us. You don't need to be a designer, but you do need to know what good design looks like. You'll notice when spacing is off, when an animation feels clunky or when a page just isn't working for the person using it.

Design experience of any kind is a big plus. That might be a design qualification, time spent in a creative agency, or a portfolio of builds you're proud of because they look great, not just because they work.

Nice to haves

  • Experience in an agency environment
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive design
  • Some SEO know-how
  • Familiarity with Figma

Where this could go

There's real room to grow here. We're changing how we work and we're looking for the right person could help shape that.

As we move further into AI-led development, there's a clear path into a senior role. That could mean leading our development approach, owning our tech stack decisions or mentoring others as the team grows. We'll back you with training, time to experiment and a say in where we head next.

Who We Are

We're Visions Design, an award-winning creative agency based in Warrington, Cheshire, and clients all over the world. Our mission is simple: to create meaningful digital experiences.

We don't build websites the old-fashioned way. We're leaning hard into AI and LLM technology to design and build faster, smarter and better than the traditional agency model allows. "Less but better" isn't just a Dieter Rams quote on our wall. It's how we work.

We've got a decade of award-winning work behind us. Now we're building what comes next, and we want a developer who's excited to help shape it.

What You Get

We're a registered disability company and we're proud of it. Everyone here goes through diversity and inclusion training, and we take mental health seriously. Neurodivergent? Brilliant. Our founder is dyslexic and autistic, and we build our workplace so everyone can do their best work.

  • Hybrid working
  • Your birthday off
  • Duvet days, (because sometimes you just need one)
  • Charity day
  • Award-winning work for clients like the National Autistic Society, the Financial Times and the Ministry of Defence
  • A team that genuinely gives a shit about good work

Salary

Up to 45,000 per annum

Full Time/Part-time

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
Om os

Hos Communardo Denmark hjælper vi private og offentlige organisationer med at skabe bedre samarbejde, stærkere processer og mere effektive digitale arbejdspladser.

Vi er et specialiseret Atlassian-konsulenthus og Enterprise Platinum Solution Partner. I Danmark arbejder vi tæt sammen med vores nordiske kolleger i Sverige, Norge og Finland, og som en del af Communardo Group er vi samtidig en del af et europæisk fællesskab med omkring 500 Atlassian specialister.

Vores arbejde handler dog om mere end teknologi. Vi tager altid udgangspunkt i de mennesker, der skal bruge løsningen, og i deres behov, arbejdsgange og mål. Derfor arbejder vi både med rådgivning, procesoptimering, implementering og adoption, så løsningerne ikke bare fungerer teknisk, men også skaber en mærkbar værdi i hverdagen.

Samme team, nyt navn

Vi har vores rødder i Aety, som i 2026 blev en del af Communardo Nordics – det nordiske fællesskab i Communardo Group. Frem mod vores fulde overgang i starten af 2027 vil du derfor stadig møde Aety-navnet, men som ny kollega bliver du en del af Communardo Denmark.

Vi har base i København og Aarhus. I Aarhus er vi et mindre team, hvilket betyder, at du får stor indflydelse, ansvar og mulighed for at være med til at præge både hverdagen og kulturen.

Om rollen

Som Solutions Konsulent bliver du bindeleddet mellem kundens forretning og de tekniske muligheder i vores løsninger. Du behøver ikke kende Atlassian-suiten på forhånd – det vigtigste er, at du motiveres af at:

  • forstå kunders behov og processer
  • omsætte forretningsudfordringer til konkrete løsninger
  • opbygge stærke relationer og spotte muligheder for mersalg i de leverancer, du er en del af

Du arbejder både kundevendt med workshops, interviews, behovsafdækning og præsentationer og med teknisk fokus med konfiguration, workflows og dashboards.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

  • Facilitere workshops og afdække kundens behov, processer og mål
  • Rådgive om, hvordan digitale samarbejds- og procesplatforme bedst understøtter arbejdsgange
  • Omsætte krav til konkrete løsninger i Atlassian-platformen og tilhørende PPM-applikationer
  • Være bindeled mellem forretning og udvikling og sikre, at løsningerne skaber værdi
  • Konfigurere løsninger selv og bidrage til større implementeringer
  • Understøtte adoption gennem træning, onboarding og sparring
  • Identificere nye behov og bidrage til mersalg hos eksisterende kunder

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele, men vi forestiller dig, at du:

  • Har relevant erfaring fra lignende roller eller en uddannelsesbaggrund inden for f.eks. IT, digital forretningsudvikling eller teknologi – eksempelvis ITKO, cand.it., Digital Innovation & Management.
  • Har stærk procesforståelse og kan se sammenhænge på tværs af teams, afdelinger og systemer
  • Trives i dialogen med kunder og er god til at opbygge tillid og relationer
  • Kommunikerer klart og kan gøre komplekse problemstillinger forståelige, også for ikke-tekniske interessenter
  • Har teknisk forståelse og lyst til at arbejde hands-on med konfiguration
  • Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, også når du har flere kunder og opgaver i gang

Og hvorfor så blive en del af os?

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt konsulenthus med høj specialisering, hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dig sammen med dygtige kolleger og arbejde med spændende kunder.

Som en del af Communardo Nordics får du samtidig adgang til et større nordisk fagligt fællesskab og mulighed for at samarbejde på tværs af kunder og fagligheder.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Flad organisationsstruktur med indflydelse på din hverdag
  • Højt niveau af ansvar og frihed i opgaveløsningen
  • Fleksible arbejdstider
  • Sundheds- og tandforsikring samt pensionsordning
  • Løbende udvikling gennem kurser og certificeringer
  • Sociale og faglige arrangementer (også de uformelle)

Derudover har vi valgt at placere vores Aarhus-kontor i et kontorfællesskab - og det er ikke tilfældigt. Da Aety startede i København, sad vi i kontorfællesskab, før vi senere flyttede i egne lokaler. Her havde vi rigtig gode erfaringer med at være en del af et fællesskab med andre virksomheder omkring os.

Den tilgang har vi taget med til Aarhus, hvor Haslegården danner rammen. Her får du både arbejdsro, fleksibilitet og et uformelt fællesskab, samtidig med, at du bliver en del af et kontor, der stadig er under opbygning, og hvor du kan være med til at sætte retningen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Kan du se dig selv hjælpe vores kunder med smartere samarbejde og bedre processer – og være med til at bygge Aarhus-kontoret videre op?

Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:
The Opportunity

With Sitetracker’s customer base rapidly expanding, we’re seeing increased demand for scalable solution delivery using out-of-the-box features and advanced declarative customization. The Senior Salesforce Administrator serves as the declarative technical backbone of our team: bridging the gap between OOTB capabilities and full-stack custom code.

This role offers the chance to work in a product-led environment, balancing deep feature development with high-priority support delivery. You’ll operate as a highly hands-on builder, owning projects end-to-end and working directly with customers to design tailored solutions. For high performers, this is an opportunity to stretch your skills across analysis, consulting, and delivery within a collaborative team of Developers, Architects, and QAs.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will lead technical discovery and architecture reviews with enterprise stakeholders, defining clear boundaries and steering them toward declarative best practices. You will take a hands-on approach to building highly scalable data models, robust security architectures, and advanced enterprise-grade Flow frameworks that handle complex orchestration while preventing governor limit issues. Going beyond standard administration, you will actively architect and tune AI systems like Scout to build intelligent automations that drastically reduce end-to-end case delivery times. Furthermore, you will bridge the gap between declarative and programmatic solutions by performing code-level Apex diagnostics, managing order of execution to prevent race conditions, and mapping custom code within Flows, ultimately remediating technical debt and reducing developer overhead.

The Skills You’ll Have

  • Advanced Flow Architecture & AI Execution

Deep mastery of complex automation, Flow design patterns, AI system configuration, and Apex diagnostics. Proven ability to actively monitor AI telemetry and optimize accuracy.

  • Client Advisory & Pushback

Strong consulting experience. Capable of evaluating business needs, confidently pushing back against bad architectural requests, and defending Salesforce best practices.

  • Execution Alignment & Data Architecture

Strong conceptual grasp of enterprise data modeling, complex sharing architecture, and permission set governance. Understands execution order to seamlessly bridge declarative configuration with full-stack custom code and prevent race conditions.

  • High-Velocity Work Management

High autonomy in estimating effort accurately and managing complex workloads. Successfully manages 2-3 high-effort and 4-5 medium-effort projects simultaneously while meeting strict timelines

Within 90 Days, You’ll:

  • Attain 80% billable utilization.

  • Complete deep-dive reviews of existing client Apex frameworks, data models, and flow inventories.

  • Understand the delivery processes Solution Engineering follows and pass Sitetracker Admin training/certification.

Within 180 Days, You’ll:

  • Autonomously drive requirement gathering meetings and design solution blueprints.

  • Build and construct complex sub-flow automation frameworks, integrating with invocable Apex where necessary.

  • Communicate effectively and proactively with customers regarding technical risks and timelines.

Within 365 Days, You’ll:

  • Architect complex, enterprise-ready solutions autonomously end-to-end.

  • Help and collaborate with Developer and QA team members to deliver the best hybrid (code + declarative) solutions.

  • Earn Advanced Sitetracker Certifications.

Job Title

Data & Transformation Project Manager, EMEA

Job Description Summary

Reporting to the Head of Data Operations EMEA, you will contribute to the transformation and enhancement of the Group's real estate data capabilities across Europe.You will lead cross-functional projects involving Research, Business Intelligence, Data Operations, and various Cushman & Wakefield business lines. In a context of innovation and accelerating adoption of artificial intelligence, you will play a key role in improving tools, processes, and data quality across the full data lifecycle — from data entry and capture, through reporting, to how business teams consume and act on data.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead Data projects across the EMEA region, including initiatives leveraging Artificial Intelligence and automation.
  • Lead and deliver innovation and transformation projects, from scoping through to measurable business impact.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to optimize Data tools and processes to enhance business performance and analytics capabilities.
  • Structure and maximize the value of real estate data used by Business, Research, and Transaction Services teams.
  • Improve the end-to-end data lifecycle, from data entry and capture, to reporting, to how Research, Business, and BI teams consume and act on data.
  • Manage and continuously improve data quality, investigating, validating, and resolving issues independently.
  • Support the deployment of new tools and processes across the organization, with structured change management: training, communication plans, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Anticipate and manage resistance to change, adapting rollout approaches to different business lines and levels of data maturity.
  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with Research, Data, Innovation, and Business teams across France and the wider EMEA region.
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders and non-technical audiences, including steering committee reporting.

Knowledge & Experience:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Real Estate, Project Management, Data applied to Business, or a related field.
  • 5 to 10 years of successful experience in commercial real estate, consulting, Data project management, or operational roles, with regular use of AI tools applied to business processes.
  • Experience in leading independently transformation or change management projects, including tool/process adoption across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Solid understanding of data models and structures, with working knowledge of SQL to query, validate, and troubleshoot data independently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical data issues into clear, business-relevant language.
  • Genuine curiosity for automation and AI, with a track record of identifying and piloting practical use cases (e.g., workflow automation, AI-assisted data entry/QA, RPA)
  • Excellent organizational and coordination skills; comfortable managing multiple projects in parallel.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in an international and multicultural environment.
  • Advanced/ Native level French and professional English (B2-C1).
  • Prior experience managing or mentoring junior data/analytics staff.
  • Good understanding of the French commercial real estate market.
  • Familiarity with business intelligence and data analytics tools (i.e Power BI, SQL, Power Automate).
  • Project management certification (Agile, PRINCE2, PMP, or equivalent) is nice to have

  • Great learning and development opportunities
  • 2-4 days Home Office option

  • Central location, excellent public transport

description:
Scan/Imaging AI Technical Program Manager

Description -

We are seeking an innovative and results-driven Technical Program Manager to define and deliver next-generation AI-powered solutions that transform document workflows, business processes, and customer experiences. In this role, you will shape the technology roadmap for intelligent imaging and workflow solutions by leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), AI Agents, Computer Vision, and Edge AI to create differentiated solutions for enterprise customers.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will collaborate closely with product management, imaging and software architects, engineering teams, and development partners to lead the prototyping, development, integration, and deployment of scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will identify emerging technology opportunities, translate customer and business needs into innovative product capabilities, and accelerate the commercialization of AI-enabled imaging and workflow solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership with a solid technical foundation in systems engineering and cross-functional product development. You excel at aligning diverse stakeholders around a common vision, navigating complex technical challenges, and driving execution across multiple disciplines. You are passionate about innovation, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are motivated by delivering transformative solutions that create customer and business value.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Roadmap Leadership

  • Own and maintain the Scan/Imaging AI roadmap across Embedded, Edge, and Cloud solution architectures.

  • Develop and drive software, platform, and solution roadmaps based on customer requirements, technical capabilities, strategic priorities, and business objectives.

  • Lead Strategic Intent (SI) planning activities and investment recommendations for future digital workflow and AI initiatives.

  • Evaluate and prioritize emerging opportunities based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and competitive differentiation.

  • Drive roadmap topics including Hydra/Fabric Flow, NPU strategy, Guided Redaction 2.0/3.0, Intent First Scanning, Scan-to-Email enhancements, intelligent file naming, document summarization, Job Archive, Data Loss Detection, and future AI workflow solutions.

Program Management & Execution

  • Lead portions of the planning and execution of multiple complex technical programs supporting HP's Scan/Imaging AI strategy.

  • Run and facilitate the weekly Scan/Imaging AI PMT, roadmap reviews, defect reviews, and strategic planning sessions.

  • Partner with cross-functional software, firmware, platform, and solutions teams to prioritize, plan, track, and execute AI initiatives.

  • Perform program analysis, manage risks, identify dependencies, and influence required course corrections.

  • Lead technical and business SWAT activities focused on high-priority opportunities and issues.

  • Manage risks and resolve issues affecting scope, schedule, release readiness, quality, and investment decisions.

  • Ensure successful transfer of validated concepts into funded product development programs.

Requirements & Solution Definition

  • Define customer requirements, solution requirements, business cases, and product use cases for AI-enabled scan and imaging experiences.

  • Partner with stakeholders to establish customer-experience strategies that guide investment and prioritization decisions.

  • Develop solution concepts, architecture recommendations, and technical requirements documentation for roadmap initiatives.

  • Ensure alignment between customer needs, business goals, and technology investments.

  • Drive requirements development for both incremental feature improvements and future AI platform capabilities.

Technical Leadership & Innovation

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to ensure solutions meet quality, performance, scalability, security, and usability objectives.

  • Lead evaluations of emerging AI technologies, architectures, models, and deployment strategies.

  • Assess trade-offs between embedded, edge, on-premise, and cloud AI solutions.

  • Influence architecture decisions supporting reusable AI platforms and long-term solution scalability.

  • Encourage innovation and facilitate exploration of new technologies, research initiatives, and industry partnerships.

  • Support university research collaborations and advanced technology investigations that contribute to future roadmap opportunities.

Stakeholder & Customer Engagement

  • Communicate project status, roadmap updates, investment recommendations, and technical strategies through executive reviews and leadership presentations.

  • Conduct customer visits, demonstrations, technology workshops, and innovation lab engagements to identify new customer needs and validate solution concepts.

  • Ensure alignment among stakeholders through continuous communication, review cycles, and collaborative decision-making.

  • Serve as a key advocate for customer-centric AI solution development.

Process & Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously assess and improve the processes used to manage AI solution development and portfolio execution.

  • Establish best practices for AI solution definition, roadmap governance, capability prioritization, and investment planning.

  • Drive improvements in planning, execution, customer validation, and decision-making processes across the Scan/Imaging AI portfolio.

title: Senior Deep Learning Software Engineer, Inference and Model Optimization
description:
NVIDIA is at the forefront of the generative AI revolution! The Algorithmic Model Optimization Team specifically focuses on optimizing generative AI models such as large language models (LLM) and diffusion models for maximal inference efficiency using techniques ranging from neural architecture search and pruning to sparsity, quantization, and automated deployment strategies. Our work includes conducting applied research to improve model efficiency as well as developing an innovative software platform (TRT Model Optimizer). Our software is used both internally across NVIDIA and externally by research and engineering teams alike developing best-in-class AI models.


We are now looking for a Senior Deep Learning Software Engineer to develop and scale up our automated inference and deployment solution. As part of the team, you will be instrumental in pushing the limits of inference efficiency and large-scale, automated deployment. Your work will touch upon fundamental aspects of a typical machine learning stack including working in high-level frameworks like PyTorch and HuggingFace to developing and improving high-performance kernel implementations in CUDA, TRT-LLM, and Triton. This is an exceptional opportunity for passionate software engineers straddling the boundaries of research and engineering, with a strong background in both machine learning fundamentals and software architecture & engineering.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Train, develop, and deploy state-of-the generative AI models like LLMs and diffusion models using NVIDIA's AI software stack.
  • Leverage and build upon the torch 2.0 ecosystem (TorchDynamo, torch.export, torch.compile, etc...) to analyze and extract standardized model graph representation from arbitrary torch models for our automated deployment solution.
  • Develop high-performance optimization techniques for inference, such as automated model sharding techniques (e.g. tensor parallelism, sequence parallelism), efficient attention kernels with kv-caching, and more.
  • Collaborate with teams across NVIDIA to use performant kernel implementations within our automated deployment solution.
  • Analyze and profile GPU kernel-level performance to identify hardware and software optimization opportunities.
  • Continuously innovate on the inference performance to ensure NVIDIA's inference software solutions (TRT, TRT-LLM, TRT Model Optimizer) can maintain and increase its leadership in the market.
  • Play a pivotal role in architecting and designing a modular and scalable software platform to provide an excellent user experience with broad model support and optimization techniques to increase adoption.

What we need to see:

  • Masters, PhD, or equivalent experience in Computer Science, AI, Applied Math, or related field.
  • 8+ years of relevant work or research experience in Deep Learning.
  • Excellent software design skills, including debugging, performance analysis, and test design.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and related ML tools (e.g. HuggingFace).
  • Strong algorithms and programming fundamentals.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Contributions to PyTorch, JAX, or other Machine Learning Frameworks.
  • Knowledge of GPU architecture and compilation stack, and capability of understanding and debugging end-to-end performance.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA's deep learning SDKs such as TensorRT.
  • Prior experience in writing high-performance GPU kernels for machine learning workloads in frameworks such as CUDA, CUTLASS, or Triton.

Increasingly known as “the AI computing company” and widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. Are you creative, motivated, and love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you! Come, join our model optimization group, where you can help build real-time, cost-effective computing platforms driving our success in this exciting and rapidly-growing field.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

title: Director Research
description:
About Us

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Norcross Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with Advanced Recovery Systems.Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org to learn more.

Short Description

The Director of Research is an appointed anesthesiology faculty with responsibility over the Department of Anesthesiology’s research program. The Director of Research reports to the Chairman of the Department of Anesthesiology who provides broad direction for the program ensuring that research activities and processes advance the academic mission of the Department, while maintaining alignment with Cooper’s vision and mission. Administration, teaching, mentoring, and creative activity are expected duties of this position

The research director of The Cooper Neurological Institute will play a key role in developing and carrying out research initiatives and strategies, in collaboration with the Institute’s Leadership and the Research Medical Director. This Directors primary objective is to strengthen the institute and Cooper through research endeavors. The research director will actively support the CNI research team, guiding budgetary considerations, resource procurement and allocation, and strategic planning. Should be comfortable working independently, with the ability to meet project deadlines and balance multiple projects at one time.

Set the overall vision for the research program, develop strategic initiatives, and help identify emerging areas for research focus in collaboration with the Research Medical Director and Institute leaders. This includes establishing research goals and aligning projects with the institutes’ mission. Oversee efforts to secure funding from grants, donors, and industry partnerships. Manage the allocation of research resources, including budget oversight, equipment acquisition, and distribution of research resources. Ensure adherence to regulatory and ethical guidelines, such as IRB (Institutional Review Board) protocols, HIPAA, and other federal and state regulations to protect participants' rights and data privacy.Support the recruitment, development, and retention of research faculty and staff. Support researchers, foster collaboration, and promote a culture of academic excellence.Facilitate the publication and presentation of research findings both in and outside of Cooper. Review Research Billing Review (UB-04 and Form 1500 billing sheets) of patients enrolled in clinical research studies, separating research charges from those considered standard of care and billable to insurance or responsible for second line verification that clinical research personnel meet research billing compliance requirements.

Master's Degree Required

description:
Commissioning & Maintenance Specialist

Position Summary



This position is responsible for commissioning, preventative maintenance troubleshooting, and repair of Plug power products including hydrogen storage infrastructure, electrolyzers, and stationary equipment at various customer sites. As such, this is a heavy travel position (up to 100%). This role requires excellent mechanical aptitude and a high degree of familiarity with industrial hydrogen systems and performance. This position also requires the ability to be on-call and to respond to urgent needs so that customer sites maintain hydrogen production around the clock. The ideal candidate should have the ability to communicate effectively among cross-functional departments with an emphasis on helping to improve electrolyzers system designs and resolve defects based upon field experience and data. This position is also critical to interface with customer stakeholders and exceed their expectations for service thereby furthering Plug Power's reputation as the leader in hydrogen fuel cell power solutions.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

  • Travel as needed to customer sites to perform inspection, troubleshooting, repair, testing and commissioning of Plug power products including hydrogen storage infrastructure, electrolyzers, and stationary.
  • Execute and lead high level service repair projects on existing hydrogen infrastructure, including specialized service procedures including liquid tank repairs and vacuum jacket line repairs, etc.
  • Provide training to first responders, customers, and other Plug service personnel on troubleshooting, maintenance, and service of Hydrogen infrastructure.
  • Support the commissioning and ongoing maintenance and operation of industrial hydrogen infrastructure including but not limited to:
    • Interpreting electrical wiring schematics
    • Conducting Point to Point functionality testing
    • Pressure testing of piping systems per ASME standards
    • Testing and troubleshooting program issues with engineering assistance.
    • Inspecting of process piping systems (pressure ratings, fittings, etc.)
    • Provide documented results from system testing and commissioning at the completion of each project.
    • Create, track, and close out project task lists.
    • Knowledge of environmental impact on equipment function and performance
    • Ability to safely operate and control combustibles.
    • Ability to diagnose system problems and troubleshoot solutions.
    • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and P&IDs.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with customers and external vendors professionally and effectively.
  • Must be able to operate independently with minimal supervision while achieving high quality results in work assignments.
  • Must be able to adapt to changing requirements and meet project commitments/objectives without sacrificing workmanship or quality.
  • Shares ideas about process improvements and other cost saving measures with project team and management.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, and technical specifications.
  • Maintain a focus around safety in all facets of work and ensure that all relevant parties are educated on the safe operation of hydrogen equipment and infrastructure.
  • Represent Plug Power in a professional manner at all times and in all interactions.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned and required within role.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience

  • Three (3) or more years of experience in construction, repair, or maintenance in an electrical, industrial, or mechanical field.

  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of skill with mechanical systems installation, troubleshooting, and repair

The Medical Writing Operations Formatter provides document formatting and Clinical Study Report (CSR) appendix support for clinical and regulatory documents. This role partners with Medical Writers and stakeholders across functions to ensure documents meet established formatting standards, regulatory requirements, and project timelines. The coordinator formats, reviews, and maintains high-quality, submission-ready documents and supports CSR appendix coordination within Regulatory Information Management Systems (RIMS).
  • Define the scope of document formatting or CSR appendix activities with the document author.
  • Process, proofread, verify, and manage clinical regulatory documents to ensure they are submission-ready, accurate, and consistent.
  • Format, import, route, and publish documents in RIMS within required timelines. Ensure electronic document deliverables meet the objectives, quality expectations, and deadlines of assigned word processing projects.
  • Apply RIMS and eSubmissions styles and formatting standards. Confirm consistency with clinical and regulatory templates and ensure Microsoft Word documents render correctly to PDF.

  • Ensure CSR appendices contain complete information and support their coordination, organization, and content.
  • Communicate deliverables, word processing timelines, completion dates, eSubmissions issues, and timeline conflicts to colleagues, stakeholders, and management.
  • Provide ongoing support to Medical Writing, Clinical, and other functional areas. Serve as a liaison between eDocs support and Medical Writing as needed and ensure effective communication among team members.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for the master file system and formatting, report publishing, or CSR appendices for Medical Writing stakeholders.
  • Verify the accuracy of literature citations and perform literature searches.
  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of Medical Writing Operations business processes and participate in process improvement activities.
  • Assist with management of the centralized mailbox, track and maintain metrics, and help prepare and maintain training documents.
  • Maintain current knowledge of formatting standards and complete ongoing training to remain compliant with industry requirements for regulatory submissions, including electronic submission and approval standards.
Qualifications
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Word styles and regulatory document formatting standards, including accurate rendering of Word documents to PDF.
  • Knowledge of CSR and CSR appendix organization and content, including Common Technical Document (CTD) structure.
  • Knowledge of RIMS and eSubmissions styles, document processing, publishing, document properties, and file naming conventions.
  • Bachelor of Science or a bachelor’s degree in English or Communications will be considered.
  • Three to five years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience is desired, including related work in medical writing, quality, regulatory, clinical research, or product support/Research and Development.
  • Strong proofreading and verification skills, with attention to document accuracy, consistency, and submission readiness.
  • Good interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills, including conflict management and the ability to coordinate deliverables and deadlines across functions.

title: Global OpEx Capability & Coaching Lead
description:
**Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

****AAK Location

**This role can be based at either Karlshamn or Aarhus.

**About The Role

**As Global OpEx Capability & Coaching Lead, you will play a key role in building the knowledge, skills and capabilities required to advance AAK’s Operational Excellence journey globally.

You will own AAK’s global Operational Excellence Capability Strategy and act as our Global Master Trainer and strategic owner of the Operational Excellence Learning Academy. This includes developing learning pathways, training programmes, certification, coaching frameworks and capability systems that support AAK’s progression through different levels of OpEx maturity.

Working across Operations, Supply Chain, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Commercial, R&D and other functions, you will create a consistent approach to OpEx capability development and ensure that the right standards, learning materials, coaching tools and deployment packages are in place.

You will work closely with the Global OpEx Deployment Lead, Regional and Local OpEx Leads, plant leadership teams and functional stakeholders. While the Deployment Lead focuses on deployment execution and site implementation, this role focuses on capability building, learning, coaching, certification and organisational readiness.

This is a global role for an experienced Operational Excellence professional who combines strong OpEx expertise with a passion for developing people, sharing best practices and building sustainable improvement capability across AAK.

**Responsibilities

**

  • Own and lead AAK’s global Operational Excellence Capability Strategy, ensuring capability building, learning governance and coaching support the organisation’s maturity ambitions.
  • Act as AAK’s Global Master Trainer, designing, delivering and continuously improving OpEx learning programmes across frontline, technical, functional, leadership and executive audiences.
  • Develop and govern the Operational Excellence Learning Academy, including learning pathways, curricula, digital learning, competency frameworks and coaching programmes.
  • Own the global OpEx certification framework, including Practitioner, Coach, Trainer and Master Trainer pathways, ensuring consistent quality and assessment standards.
  • Ensure OpEx standards, training materials, coaching guides, assessment criteria and deployment packages are developed and ready before each maturity level is deployed.
  • Build Communities of Practice, trainer networks and knowledge-sharing routines to accelerate best-practice sharing and create sustainable OpEx capability across AAK.
  • Provide coaching and capability development to Regional and Local OpEx Leads, plant leadership teams, frontline leaders, trainers and practitioners.
  • Partner closely with the Global OpEx Deployment Lead to align capability readiness with deployment waves and incorporate feedback from the field into learning and standards.
  • Represent the global OpEx capability agenda across regions and functions, ensuring learning, certification and coaching remain aligned with AAK’s transformation priorities.
  • Continuously assess capability gaps and improve learning, coaching and development approaches to strengthen OpEx maturity across the organisation.

**About You

**

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Learning & Development, Organisational Development or a related field; a Master’s degree is an advantage.
  • Extensive Operational Excellence experience, ideally 10+ years, with strong expertise in Lean, TPM, Daily Management Systems, Visual Management and structured problem solving.
  • Proven experience as a Master Trainer or equivalent, with the ability to design and deliver learning programmes for a wide range of audiences.
  • Strong knowledge of adult learning, instructional design, coaching, assessment and certification.
  • Deep knowledge of TRACC or a comparable Operational Excellence system; TRACC certification or equivalent is strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing capability systems such as learning academies, competency frameworks, coaching programmes or trainer networks.
  • Excellent coaching, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across cultures, functions and organisational levels.
  • Strong communication and content development skills, with a practical and structured approach.
  • Fluent in English and comfortable working globally, including regular international travel.

**In return AAK offers

**

  • Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.
  • In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.
  • AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.
  • You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.
  • Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**Contact and information

**For further information about the position, please contact Emily Lumb, Talent Acquisition Specialist: emily.lumb@aak.com

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.
