description:
#### Company Description

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming, with teams across the world creating original and memorable experiences — from Assassin’s Creed and Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe that diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing the boundaries of entertainment, join us on our journey and help create the unknown!

#### Job Description

At Ubisoft, the Online Services – Player Identity team is looking for experienced software developers to help build and evolve the services that power player identity across Ubisoft games and online experiences.

Ubisoft Accounts are a critical component of our online ecosystem and are used across most Ubisoft titles. They play a central role in the player experience by enabling progression, access to services, social interactions, and more.

Our account ecosystem is closely integrated with authentication and profile services, forming the foundation of identity and access management across the Ubisoft platform. The team is responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and scalable account services while ensuring seamless integration with authentication and profile systems. We also develop and operate services that track user actions, helping customer support teams efficiently investigate and resolve player issues.

As these services support several strategic initiatives across Ubisoft, you will contribute to the design and development of robust, scalable, and secure solutions. You'll tackle challenging technical problems and help deliver simple, effective solutions within a complex distributed systems environment.

In this role, you will work with modern technologies and development practices, including:

- .NET Core
- Docker
- AWS (Aurora RDS, ElastiCache Redis)
- AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
- CI/CD pipelines (GitLab)
- SonarQube
- Grafana
- Kibana
- React

Experience with C++ is considered a strong asset, as part of the role may involve contributing to the development of our SDK. Experience with React is also valuable for building and maintaining internal web-based administrative tools that interact with our services.

If you enjoy designing RESTful APIs, working with microservices on AWS, solving large-scale technical challenges, and collaborating within a DevOps culture, we'd love to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

- Participate in all phases of software development, including analysis, design, implementation, testing, integration, debugging, deployment, and support of online services.
- Estimate development effort and contribute to delivery planning.
- Provide high-quality support for production systems and live services.
- Collaborate closely with team members and cross-functional partners.
- Ensure proper integration of account services with related platform systems.
- Assess technical risks and evaluate the impact of architectural and implementation decisions.
- Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in online services, gaming, cloud computing, and web development.

#### Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
- Significant professional experience in software development, including experience designing, developing, and supporting production systems.
- Strong experience with C# and .NET Core.
- Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and distributed systems using a microservices architecture.
- Experience with cloud-based services and modern infrastructure technologies, preferably AWS.
- Experience working with containerized applications and technologies such as Docker.
- Experience with modern software development practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality tools, and version control systems.
- Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, reliability, performance, and security principles.
- Experience troubleshooting and supporting production systems in a live-service environment.
- Ability to assess technical trade-offs, risks, and impacts when making design and implementation decisions.
- Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working effectively in cross-functional teams.
- Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical initiatives, and drive solutions from concept to delivery.
- Curiosity and willingness to stay current with evolving technologies, development practices, and industry trends.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience with C++ and SDK development.
- Experience with React and modern web application development.
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
- Experience with AWS services such as Aurora RDS and ElastiCache Redis.
- Experience with DevOps practices and operational ownership of services.
- Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana, and SonarQube.
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code.
- Experience working on large-scale online platforms, SaaS solutions, or gaming services.

Cut, thread, bend and install raceway (conduit) and cable trays in an industrial setting; Install wire through raceway and cable trays to be tested by MCA; Must be aware and able to follow standards laid out by NECA 101

title: Paediatric Community Speech and Language Therapist
description:
Job Title: Locum Band 5/6 Speech and Language Therapist – Uxbridge, London

Banding: Band 5/6
Location: Beaufort House, Uxbridge (base location, with work across different settings throughout the borough)
Start Date: ASAP
Salary: £20.00–£28.00 per hour
Working Hours: Part-time or full-time
Duration: 3 months

Job Overview

We are currently seeking a dedicated and experienced Speech and Language Therapist (SALT) to join a community-based children's service in Uxbridge. This is an exciting locum opportunity for a Band 5 or Band 6 therapist to support predominantly preschool children presenting with speech, language and communication needs (SLCN).

Based at Beaufort House, the successful candidate will work across a range of community settings, including Children's Centres and community clinics throughout the borough. You will play a key role in the early identification, assessment, diagnosis and treatment of children with communication difficulties, helping to improve their developmental outcomes through early intervention and tailored therapy programmes.

The role involves working closely with parents, carers, educational staff and other professionals to provide practical advice, training and support. You will also contribute to service development, quality governance and the ongoing delivery of high-quality care. Depending on experience, the successful candidate may also support and mentor less experienced therapists, assistants and volunteers.

This opportunity is ideal for a proactive and compassionate Speech and Language Therapist who is passionate about early intervention, safeguarding children and supporting families to develop effective communication strategies.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Provide assessment services for predominantly preschool children with speech, language and communication needs across Children's Centres and community clinics.
  • Assess, diagnose and deliver individualised therapy packages to support children's communication and language development.
  • Provide training and guidance to parents, carers and educational staff to support the implementation of therapy programmes.
  • Promote the early identification of speech, language and communication difficulties and support timely access to appropriate interventions.
  • Offer advice to parents and other professionals on early intervention and prevention strategies, using coaching, modelling and practical demonstrations.
  • Prioritise the safeguarding and welfare of vulnerable children at all times, following relevant policies and procedures.
  • Support the service in achieving key performance indicators (KPIs) and maintaining target activity levels.
  • Participate in quality governance activities, clinical audits and projects to support service improvement.
  • Contribute ideas and feedback regarding potential developments within the team and wider service.
  • Provide mentoring, buddying, support and shadowing opportunities to less experienced Speech and Language Therapists, assistants and volunteers, as requested by the team leader.

Qualifications and Experience

To be considered for this role, you should have:

  • A recognised degree or equivalent qualification in Speech and Language Therapy.
  • Current Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC) registration.
  • Experience assessing and supporting children with speech, language and communication needs, ideally within preschool or community settings.
  • Knowledge of early intervention approaches and strategies to support children's communication and language development.
  • Experience developing and implementing individualised therapy programmes and advising parents, carers and educational staff.
  • An understanding of child safeguarding procedures and a commitment to protecting vulnerable children.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and organisational skills.
  • The ability to work independently across different community settings and manage a varied caseload effectively.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach to multidisciplinary working, service development and continuous professional development.
  • For Band 6 applicants, the ability to support and mentor less experienced colleagues, alongside relevant clinical experience.

O Que Alcançaremos Juntos

Exerce liderança de equipes multidisciplinares e gestores, orientando a estratégia, a priorização de iniciativas para as mudanças necessárias no bioma, a alocação de recursos, o desenho organizacional e o desenvolvimento de capacidades técnicas e gerenciais necessárias para assegurar impacto duradouro da conservação.

Específica

A Diretoria de Conservação da Amazônia Brasileira é a principal responsável por liderar e entregar as ambiciosas metas de conservação da TNC para o bioma, assegurando que os resultados sejam alcançados de forma efetiva, justa, equitativa e durável. Para isso, promove a integração entre estratégias, equipes, parceiros e investimentos, orientando a tomada de decisão e a alocação de recursos para maximizar o impacto da organização na região.

Atuaremos para promover a conservação da Amazônia Brasileira em escala, contribuindo para a proteção da biodiversidade, o combate e adaptação às mudanças climática e a construção de modelos sustentáveis de desenvolvimento para a região.

Para alcançar esses resultados, desenvolveremos e integraremos estratégias, atores, parcerias e soluções capazes de gerar mudanças sistêmicas duradouras, atuando sobre os principais fatores que influenciam a conservação e o uso sustentável dos recursos naturais na Amazônia.

Em estreita colaboração com governos estaduais e federal, consórcios, alianças, organizações representativas de povos indígenas, quilombolas, extrativistas e outras comunidades tradicionais, setor privado, produtores rurais, instituições financeiras, academia e organizações da sociedade civil, promoveremos a construção de agendas comuns, o fortalecimento de capacidades locais e a implementação de iniciativas capazes de gerar impacto de conservação em larga escala.

Também atuaremos para fortalecer políticas públicas, mecanismos financeiros, estruturas de governança e ambientes institucionais favoráveis à conservação, buscando ampliar investimentos, influenciar processos decisórios e criar as condições necessárias para a manutenção de resultados duradouros para as pessoas e a natureza.

Responsabilidades e Escopo

Gerais

Estratégia, Portfólio e Resultados

  • Definir e desdobrar a estratégia de conservação para a área sob sua responsabilidade, em alinhamento às diretrizes institucionais locais, nacionais e globais da TNC.
  • Responder pelos resultados estratégicos, indicadores de impacto e desempenho operacional dos programas e iniciativas de conservação.
  • Orientar prioridades, gerir riscos e tomar decisões estratégicas considerando cenários complexos, ambíguos e de longo prazo.
  • Garantir que ciência, dados, evidências e inovação fundamentem o desenho e a implementação das estratégias de conservação.

Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas

  • Liderar, desenvolver e avaliar gestores, coordenadores e equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo alto desempenho, accountability e desenvolvimento de talentos.
  • Definir estruturas organizacionais, papéis, responsabilidades e capacidades necessárias ao alcance dos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Promover cultura organizacional alinhada aos valores da TNC, incluindo ética, diversidade, equidade, inclusão e respeito a povos e comunidades locais.

Governança, Gestão Institucional e Orçamento

  • Supervisionar a gestão de recursos financeiros e orçamentos programáticos, assegurando uso eficiente, conformidade e sustentabilidade.
  • Garantir governança adequada dos programas, incluindo monitoramento, avaliação, aprendizagem e adaptação contínua.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com outras diretorias, gerências e áreas transversais da organização.

Parcerias, Captação de Recursos e Representação

  • Desenvolver e manter parcerias estratégicas com governos, organizações da sociedade civil, setor privado, academia, comunidades locais e financiadores.
  • Liderar ou apoiar a captação de recursos, incluindo identificação de oportunidades, relacionamento com doadores e negociações institucionais.
  • Representar institucionalmente a TNC em fóruns estratégicos, negociações e espaços de tomada de decisão relevantes.

Contexto Operacional

  • Seguir e promover o Código de Conduta e os procedimentos internos da TNC, assegurando conformidade com valores institucionais, políticas internas, requisitos legais, segurança, uso de recursos e prestação de contas.
  • Garantir a integridade, organização e confidencialidade de informações, assegurando precisão e rastreabilidade dos dados gerados no contexto dos projetos.
  • Realizar viagens nacionais e internacionais conforme necessidade programática e estratégica.
  • As atividades podem ocorrer em condições climáticas e de terreno variadas, incluindo locais remotos e fisicamente desafiadores.

Específicas

  • Liderar a implementação da estratégia e da Teoria da Mudança da Amazônia Brasileira, assegurando o alcance dos resultados e metas de conservação do bioma.
  • Representar institucionalmente a TNC junto a governos, povos indígenas, quilombolas, comunidades tradicionais, setor privado e demais atores estratégicos da região.
  • Influenciar políticas públicas, processos de tomada de decisão e mecanismos de governança relevantes para a conservação e o desenvolvimento sustentável da Amazônia.
  • Promover a articulação entre diferentes setores e parceiros para ampliar a escala, a efetividade e a durabilidade dos resultados de conservação.

O que você trará / Qualificações mínimas

  • Escolaridade mínima: Superior completo e 10 anos de experiência em gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, economia ou áreas afins.Idioma mínimo: Inglês avançado (oral e escrito).
  • Experiência comprovada na liderança de equipes gerenciais, incluindo supervisão de gestores e equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência sólida em definição de estratégias, gestão de portfólio, priorização e tomada de decisão estratégica.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de parcerias com ONGs, setor privado, grupos comunitários e/ou órgãos governamentais, negociações complexas e relacionamento com financiadores.
  • Experiência em negociações complexas.
  • Experiência em gestão financeira e orçamentária de programas de grande porte.
  • Experiência desenhando e liderando a implementação de estratégias em grandes paisagens.
  • Experiência com relações governamentais e na implementação de políticas públicas.


Qualificações desejadas

Buscamos pessoas candidatas que atendam a todas ou a parte das qualificações listadas abaixo. Mesmo que você não reúna todos os requisitos, incentivamos a que se inscreva e apresente como suas habilidades e experiências podem contribuir para esta função.

  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em práticas de desenvolvimento socioeconômico e/ou conservação, ou formação equivalente, por meio da implementação de programas complexos e com resultados de impacto mensuráveis no Brasil, em organizações do terceiro setor, setor privado, governos e/ou agências multi-laterais.
  • Experiência em influência de políticas públicas e articulação multissetorial no bioma Amazônia.
  • Experiência comprovada com finanças estruturadas, corporativas ou mais de 10 anos de atuação direta no setor privado.
  • Capacidade referência de negociações altamente complexas, mediações de conflito e representação institucional de alto nível
  • Talento gerencial comprovado em orçamento, gestão de equipe e desempenho
  • Experiência em captação de recursos.
  • Pessoa energética, criativa, com visão de futuro e altos padrões éticos.
  • Escolaridade desejada: Desejável Pós-gradução em áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma desejado: Desejável inglês fluente e bons conhecimentos em Espanhol (a função exige interações constantes, apresentações e participação ativa em eventos realizados em inglês)

title: Lead Engineering Technician - Fareham
description:
Lead Engineering Technician - Fareham

Introduction

Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training.

What you will be part of

Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe.

Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems.

Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations.

The Role:

Join us in creating the most innovative robotic technology for the harshest environment in the deepest oceans and most turbulent waters.We lead the world with the most advanced engineering, electronics and software systems for pioneering electric underwater technology.

We don't just create products - we are revolutionising the underwater world. So come and be part of an innovative and agile team that is dedicated to smart and inspired technology that is rapidly changing the future of underwater robotics.

The Lead Engineering Technician will oversee daily engineering R&D facility operations, execute complex technical tasks and coordinate the daily work of the technicians to meet operations goals. The role combines hands-on technical execution - such as building test equipment - with planning, task management and ensuring a safe, efficient working environment.

Key accountabilities and responsibilities:

Area Ownership

  • Asset management - maintain equipment ensuring it is fully operational and fit for purpose
  • Safety Lead - Serve as safety lead for assigned area ensuring operations are compliant with company protocols and regulatory safety standards. Including ensuring high quality risk assessments are in place and up to date
  • 5S Standard - Champion 5s workplace optimisation standards throughout assigned area ensuring operations are productive and efficient
  • Management of equipment calibration status in line with the company calibration recall process / calibration register

Practical Tasks

  • Perform practical hands on builds of electro-mechanical hardware as and when required (Jigs / fixtures / wiring harness / etc)
  • Perform Engineering test routines to defined test specifications and document results to assist with Engineering design reviews (Electrical / Mechanical)
  • Perform technical review studies on Engineering samples / sub-assemblies to utilise technical problem solving (first Line support)

Team Coordination

  • Schedule, assign and review daily tasks for the technicians team
  • Train and mentor technicians on technical skills and protocols
  • Serve as a point of contact between engineers, project managers and technicians

Essential Skills:

  • HNC or Degree in a relevant engineering discipline
  • Competent in Electrical and Electronic Engineering environment
  • Previous experience in personnel supervision / management, to coach and mentor staff and manage their workload, and setting priorities
  • Ability to work unsupervised to tight timescales
  • Working knowledge of Mechanical Engineering principles
  • Working knowledge of Software principles in relation to products - embedded and associated tool chains
  • Competent and able to use Microsoft Office to a high level
  • Min 3 years in a test focused role, or within test equipment development
  • Proven experience in data capture and analysis
  • Proven experience working on multi-disciplinary systems (electrical, mechanical, software)
  • Excellent knowledge of test equipment and platforms
  • Data capture - logging
  • Creation of test reports
  • Innovative and creative mind-set with technical awareness
  • Excellent communicator: both written and verbal
  • Enthusiasm, drive and personality!

Desirable:

  • Degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering
  • Formal qualification in Mechanical Engineering or Software
  • Experienced and high level competence with National Instruments LabView and TestStand software tool chains within a test and measurement environment
  • Experienced with creating / modifying software scripts / programs e.g. Python, Visual Basic, C, C++, etc.
  • Expert in the Verification & Validation processes and associated tools and techniques
  • Create high quality test reports
  • Experience in the offshore and/or subsea industry
  • Knowledge of product certification, best-practice and industry standards
  • Expert / advanced user of Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with data archiving / controlled repositories management
  • Previous experience in a customer-facing role

By submitting an application to Saab UK you consent to undertaking workforce screening activities that may include but are not limited to: Baseline Personnel Security checks, National Security Vetting, reference checks, verification of working rights and in all circumstances preferred candidates will be placed through a security interview.

Job Overview
This role is essential for managing the Responsible AI evaluation framework, the evaluation program that applies it, and the AI transparency and disclosure standard as technical products that meet specific business objectives within the organization. It involves owning the product lifecycle, including vision, strategy, the benchmarks and tests AI engineers build and run, and stakeholder collaboration with Legal, Privacy and the approving functions, which make the decisions. The role requires balancing technical feasibility, the regulatory requirements Legal provides, and business goals to prioritize which AI systems are evaluated, when, and against which benchmarks. Success is measured by evaluation coverage, findings closed, and approvers having clear, complete evidence for every AI system they review. The work impacts the organization by enabling cross-functional teams to deliver AI that is fair, safe and transparent for customers and employees.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for the Responsible AI evaluation framework and program, and the AI transparency and disclosure standard, by defining vision, strategy, and roadmap to align with business and technical goals
  • Conduct market and customer research to identify opportunities and inform product decisions based on data analysis and customer feedback, including Responsible AI frameworks and the regulatory requirements Legal provides
  • Translate product strategy into detailed features and user stories, managing the product backlog to support Agile development teams, including the evaluation tests and benchmarks AI engineers build and run
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to coordinate release schedules and ensure timely product delivery, including Legal, Privacy and the Applied AI design authority
  • Monitor product performance and quality in production, addressing defects and driving continuous improvement, and track evaluation findings to closure with system owners
  • Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed

Education and Work Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree plus 5 years of related work experience OR Advanced degree with 3 years of related experience (Required)
  • Acceptable areas of study include Computer Science, Engineering, IT or equivalent experience (Required)
  • 3+ years experience in a hands-on technical role writing production code, solution engineering, or technical architecture in a large-scale company, application or product environment (Required)
  • 5+ years of relevant Product Management experience in an agile software product development environment (Required)

Additional Preferred Education and Work Experience

  • Experience running an evaluation, testing or quality program for AI or machine learning systems (Preferred)
  • Working knowledge of Responsible AI frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework: fairness and bias, explainability, transparency and harmful output (Preferred)
  • Experience with AI used in regulated decision areas such as employment, credit or insurance, working alongside Legal, Privacy or compliance (Preferred)

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Agile SDLC (Required)
  • Analytical Thinking (Required)
  • Backlog Management (Required)
  • Customer-Focused (Required)
  • Product Management (Required)
  • Product Requirements (Required)
  • Product Specifications (Required)
  • Solution Architecture Design (Required)
  • Stakeholder Management (Required)
  • Technical Design Documentation (Required)

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Influencing Skills
  • Technical Writing

Licenses and Certifications:

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) Scrum Product Owner Certification (CSPO) (Preferred)
  • Other Technical Certification Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) (Preferred)
  • At least 18 years of age

title: Chief Technology & Product Officer
description:
About Agentic Defense Solutions Inc

Agentic Defense Solutions exists to solve the real problem in mission-critical AI: not better models, but the operational trust layer that makes AI governable, auditable, and safe to deploy in high-consequence environments.

Our Mission

Most people think the challenge in mission-critical AI is better models. It isn't. The real problem is there is no control plane for how AI reasons, makes decisions, and executes operations in high-consequence environments.

Agentic Defense Solutions builds the ARIA product family: the operational trust layer for AI where decisions have real-world impact. From the ARIA Platform foundation to the ARIA Hermes application, we provide the infrastructure that makes AI governable, auditable, and safe to deploy so that warfighters, analysts, operators, and decision-makers can leverage AI with confidence.

We believe that AI accountability shouldn't be an afterthought. It should be the foundation. ARIA enforces policy, keeps an immutable audit trail, supports human-in-the-loop, and is built for air-gapped and classified deployment from day one.

About the role
Agentic Defense Solutions, Inc. is seeking a Chief Technology & Product Officer (CTO/CPO) to own the technical and product direction of the company as we build the operational trust layer for AI in high-consequence environments.

This is not a traditional executive role where product strategy and engineering execution are delegated several layers down. We are looking for a deeply technical product and engineering leader who can move comfortably between company strategy, product architecture, customer problems, engineering execution, and the code when necessary.

You will own the evolution of the ARIA product family: defining what we build, why we build it, how the platform is architected, and how our engineering organization delivers it.

The central technical challenge is significant. AI systems are rapidly moving from generating information to reasoning, making decisions, invoking tools, and executing actions. In mission-critical environments, those systems need a control plane that determines what AI can do, how it reasons, which data and tools it can access, when humans must intervene, and how every consequential action can be reconstructed and defended.

That is what we are building.

You will work directly with the CEO and founding team to turn that vision into a category-defining product and technical platform.

What you'll do

Product Strategy & Direction

  • Own product strategy and roadmap across the ARIA product family, translating the company's mission and market opportunity into a coherent product portfolio.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our users — analysts, operators, engineers, decision-makers, and mission leaders — and turn their hardest problems into scalable product capabilities.
  • Decide what belongs in the core platform, what belongs in applications, what should be enabled through partners and integrations, and what we should deliberately not build.
  • Establish product discovery and development processes that allow us to move quickly without becoming a collection of customer-specific features.
  • Work directly with customers and prospective customers to understand workflows, validate product direction, and identify capabilities that can become repeatable platform primitives.
  • Define product success metrics and use customer behavior, deployment experience, and market feedback to continuously refine priorities.
  • Maintain a strong point of view about the evolution of enterprise and mission AI, agentic systems, AI infrastructure, and human-machine collaboration.

Technology & Architecture

  • Own the technical architecture and long-term technology strategy for ARIA.
  • Define the architecture for a platform capable of orchestrating AI reasoning, tools, data, policy, human approvals, memory, and execution across complex workflows.
  • Ensure ARIA can operate across cloud, hybrid, disconnected, air-gapped, and classified environments without fragmenting into separate products.
  • Drive architectural decisions around agent orchestration, model abstraction, data and knowledge infrastructure, distributed systems, APIs, security boundaries, observability, policy enforcement, and auditability.
  • Ensure the platform remains model-agnostic and capable of taking advantage of rapid advances in foundation models, open-source models, inference infrastructure, and agent frameworks.
  • Establish technical standards that allow the platform to scale dramatically in customers, workloads, data volume, integrations, and engineering contributors.
  • Make thoughtful build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions and prevent unnecessary technical complexity.
  • Maintain a high bar for reliability, security, performance, developer experience, and maintainability.

AI & Agentic Systems

  • Lead the company's technical strategy for agentic AI and AI-assisted decision systems.
  • Drive how ARIA approaches reasoning, planning, tool use, context management, memory, evaluation, human-in-the-loop control, and multi-agent workflows.
  • Build systems that make probabilistic AI useful inside environments that require deterministic controls and accountable outcomes.
  • Establish rigorous approaches to AI evaluation, testing, observability, failure analysis, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure customers can understand not simply what an AI system produced, but the reasoning context, evidence, policies, tools, approvals, and actions that led to an outcome.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging models, frameworks, research, and infrastructure and determine where advances should materially change our product or architecture.

Engineering Leadership

  • Build and lead a world-class engineering organization capable of moving with startup speed while delivering software suitable for mission-critical environments.
  • Recruit exceptional engineers, technical leaders, product leaders, and designers as the company scales.
  • Establish an engineering culture centered on technical excellence, ownership, velocity, intellectual honesty, and pragmatic execution.
  • Develop engineering leaders and create an organizational structure that can scale without introducing unnecessary management layers or bureaucracy.
  • Own engineering planning, prioritization, quality, technical debt, and delivery.
  • Establish the development practices, architecture review processes, testing standards, release processes, and operational disciplines necessary to maintain velocity as the platform grows.
  • Remain technically engaged. You do not need to be the person writing every feature, but you should be capable of reviewing architecture, challenging implementation decisions, debugging difficult problems, prototyping ideas, and earning the respect of exceptional engineers.

Customer & Mission Engineering

  • Work directly with customers to understand complex operational environments and translate those requirements into scalable product architecture.
  • Participate in technical demonstrations, architecture discussions, design sessions, and strategic customer engagements.
  • Partner with mission and deployment teams to ensure lessons from implementations rapidly influence the core product.
  • Help customers understand how ARIA fits into their existing data, AI, security, and operational ecosystems.
  • Serve as a senior technical voice with government, commercial, technology, and strategic partners.
  • Balance the urgency of solving immediate customer problems with the discipline required to build a repeatable software platform.

Executive Leadership

  • Serve as a core member of the executive team and help shape company strategy beyond the boundaries of product and engineering.
  • Partner directly with the CEO on company strategy, market positioning, product narrative, organizational design, recruiting, partnerships, and capital allocation.
  • Translate complex technology into a compelling vision for customers, employees, partners, investors, and the broader market.
  • Represent the company's technical vision externally with customers, partners, industry leaders, and the technical community.
  • Help define and defend the category ADS intends to create: the operational trust layer for AI in high-consequence environments.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive software engineering, product engineering, or technology leadership experience, with substantial experience building and leading high-performing engineering organizations.
  • Experience serving as a senior engineering or product/technology leader — such as CTO, CPO, VP Engineering, VP Product, Head of Engineering, Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, or equivalent — with meaningful ownership of both technical direction and product outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience taking sophisticated enterprise software products from concept through production and significant customer adoption.
  • Exceptional technical depth in modern software architecture, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, or similarly complex enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI systems, including LLMs, agent architectures, retrieval and context systems, tool use, model evaluation, and the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated ability to make consequential architectural decisions while balancing speed, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience building and managing exceptional engineering teams, including recruiting senior technical talent and developing engineering leaders.
  • Strong product instincts and demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into coherent, scalable products.
  • Experience working directly with sophisticated enterprise customers and navigating the tension between customer requirements and product strategy.
  • Ability to operate effectively in an early-stage environment where strategy, architecture, recruiting, customer conversations, and hands-on problem solving frequently happen in the same day.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A track record of shipping.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI/ML platforms, developer platforms, data infrastructure, security platforms, workflow/orchestration systems, or other technically sophisticated enterprise software.
  • Experience building products that sit between infrastructure and applications and become foundational components of a customer's technology stack.
  • Experience scaling a product and engineering organization through a period of rapid company growth.
  • Experience with security-sensitive, regulated, mission-critical, or high-availability environments.
  • Familiarity with deployment into government, defense, intelligence, critical infrastructure, or other high-consequence environments.
  • Experience with disconnected, edge, on-premises, or air-gapped deployment models.
  • Experience developing platforms or ecosystems that enable third-party developers, partners, or customers to build on top of a core product.
  • Demonstrated technical thought leadership through open-source contributions, patents, publications, speaking, or recognized leadership within a technical community.

Prior national security experience is valuable, but it is not required. We care more about your ability to build exceptional technology, understand difficult customer problems, lead extraordinary engineers, and learn a complex mission domain quickly.

The Person We're Looking For

  • You are probably uncomfortable being described as purely a CTO, purely a CPO, or purely an engineering executive.
  • You have strong opinions about architecture, but you care about whether customers actually use what you build.
  • You can spend the morning debating the architecture of an agent runtime, the afternoon working through a mission workflow with a customer, and the evening helping recruit an exceptional engineer.
  • You understand that great product organizations do not simply implement requirements. They develop a point of view about the problem, identify the primitives underneath individual customer requests, and build systems that become more valuable as more use cases are added.
  • You are excited by the technical possibilities of AI but skeptical of systems that cannot explain, constrain, evaluate, or govern their behavior.
  • Most importantly, you want to build.

title: Value Stream Lead, Athene Programme
description:
**Create alignment, momentum and transparency across one of STARK Group's largest transformation programmes

**If you thrive in complex environments where success depends on bringing many moving parts together, this could be the role for you.

As Value Stream Lead, you will become a key part of the Athene Programme Management Office (PMO), helping ensure that projects within a value stream move in the same direction, at the right pace, and with clear priorities.

Rather than managing a single project, you will own the overall value stream scope, roadmap, and expected outcomes, creating the structure and transparency needed to successfully deliver a portfolio of interconnected projects. You will connect project managers, programme leadership, business stakeholders, and governance forums, ensuring decisions are made based on clear insights, dependencies are managed proactively, and risks are addressed before they become obstacles.

You will join a PMO function that continues to evolve alongside one of the largest digital transformations across Northern Europe. This means you will not only help drive delivery but also influence how governance, planning, and value stream management are developed across the programme.

**Key Responsibilities

**In this role, you will create the structure, alignment, and transparency needed to successfully deliver a portfolio of interconnected projects within a value stream. You will maintain the integrated value stream plan, coordinate priorities across projects and value streams, and ensure dependencies, risks, and delivery challenges are identified and addressed before they impact delivery.

You will facilitate governance forums and decision-making processes across the stream, ensuring stakeholders have the insights needed to make timely and informed decisions. By consolidating inputs from project teams, you will create a clear overview of progress, priorities, delivery confidence, and expected outcomes.

As a central part of the PMO, you will help strengthen governance, planning, and reporting practices across the value stream. You will challenge assumptions, support Project Managers, monitor adherence to agreed ways of working, and drive corrective actions when required.

How You Will Be Successful in the Role

When you create clarity, momentum, and alignment across the value stream, you make a real impact when you:

  • Maintain a clear and integrated view of priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery progress.
  • Ensure projects remain aligned to programme objectives, agreed delivery plans, and expected value stream outcomes.
  • Facilitate governance forums that result in clear decisions, actions, and accountability, while maintaining relevant logs and driving follow-up on agreed actions.
  • Identify delivery risks and dependencies early, including cross-project dependencies within the value stream and dependencies with adjacent value streams, and proactively coordinate mitigation and resolution.
  • Deliver transparent and decision-ready reporting to programme leadership and stream boards.
  • Support Project Managers in adopting effective governance, planning, and reporting practices, monitoring adherence and driving corrective actions where needed.

**What We Offer

**We offer the opportunity to create alignment and delivery in a major digital transformation. In this role, you will help turn strategic ambitions into coordinated execution across a value stream spanning multiple projects, stakeholders, and delivery teams. Your contribution will be reflected in the quality of decisions made, the pace of delivery, and the programme's ability to remain focused on the outcomes that matter most.

You will report to Esther Phipps, Head of PMO, and work closely with the wider Athene PMO team, Project Managers, business stakeholders, and programme leadership across the organisation.

You will join an international environment where collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement are valued, and where your ability to create structure and transparency will have a direct impact on programme success.

**Who We Are Looking For

**We are looking for a proactive and highly organised professional who thrives in fast-paced transformation environments. You enjoy creating structure, driving alignment, and helping teams navigate complexity without losing momentum.

You are comfortable influencing stakeholders at different levels of the organisation without direct authority and can translate complex information into clear recommendations and actions. Most importantly, you are someone who takes ownership, challenges constructively, and helps others succeed.

**Key skills and qualifications include:

**

  • Experience within programme management, project management, PMO, or large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of planning, governance, dependency management, and risk management.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, including the ability to drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Ability to consolidate complex information into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Experience working across multiple projects and stakeholder groups simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with PMO frameworks, reporting practices, and governance processes.
  • Professional certifications such as PRINCE2, PMI, or PMO-related qualifications are a plus.

**Welcome to the Athene PMO – working closely with Group IT

**By joining our Athene PMO team, you will help shape and support the delivery of one of STARK Group's most important transformation programmes.

You will work closely with colleagues across Group IT, Business Transformation, and the wider business organisation to create transparency, alignment, and confidence in programme delivery. Together, we are modernising our technology landscape and building the capabilities needed to support STARK Group's future growth.

As part of this journey, you will have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on how large-scale transformation programmes are governed, coordinated, and delivered across the organisation.

**Want to Know More and Apply?

**We will be happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your opportunities within STARK Group IT and the Athene PMO. Please contact Head of Athene PMO, Esther Phipps on Esther.Phipps@starkbuild.co.uk for any specific questions about the role.

STARK Group STARK Group is a growing private equity-owned company with a strong legacy. STARK Group was first established in Denmark in 1896 and has today evolved into a leading European retailer and distributor of heavy building materials with net sales of approx. EUR 9 billion. With a dedicated team of more than 20,000 employees and +1,150 branches and distribution centres across the Nordics, Greenland, Germany, Austria and the UK, we live and breathe to serve professional craftsmen with heavy building materials all the way from the Austrian Alps to Tromsø, close to the Arctic circle and everywhere in between.

STARK Group is committed to reach net zero emissions by 2050 across the entire business, is a signatory to the UN Global Compact, and works within fully 2030 validated science-based targets to keep global warming below 1.5°C At STARK Group IT, we believe in the richness diversity brings. We invite individuals of all backgrounds to join us in creating and inclusive and welcoming environment. We believe in a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

Agency Policy STARK Group IT appreciates the interest of all candidates. However, we prefer to directly engage with individuals seeking employment opportunities. Therefore, we kindly request recruitment agencies, headhunters, and third-party staffing services to refrain from contacting us regarding this job posting. All applications should be submitted directly by the candidates through our official application process. We value direct communication and look forward to reviewing your application.

title: Legal, Risk & Compliance - Investigations & Forensic Senior Consultant
description:
JOB REQUISITION

Legal, Risk & Compliance - Investigations & Forensic Senior Consultant

LOCATION

HOUSTON

ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)

ATLANTA - PEACHTREE RD, AUSTIN, CHARLOTTE, CHICAGO, DALLAS, MIAMI, TAMPA

JOB DESCRIPTION

You Belong Here

The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.

At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.



Where We Need You

Protiviti is looking for a Legal Senior Consultant to join our Investigations, Litigation, and Forensic Services team.



What You Can Expect

As a Senior Consultant, you will lead defined workstreams within fraud, investigations, regulatory enforcement, e-discovery, and forensic matters from planning through delivery. You will coordinate timelines and deliverables, conduct fact-finding and evidence gathering, analyze financial and electronic information, and communicate findings to client stakeholders and internal leadership. You will work under the direction of Managers while taking increasing responsibility for investigative approaches, workstream execution, project monitoring, deliverable quality, and the development of Consultants and Interns.



What Will Help You Be Successful

  • You are motivated to learn and interested in fraud, investigations, regulatory enforcement, forensic accounting, e-discovery, and litigation support.
  • You can structure investigative work, identify key questions, and adapt as facts and case requirements evolve.
  • You analyze information coherently and critically and can distinguish facts, assumptions, and preliminary conclusions.
  • You are comfortable working with financial records, electronic evidence, transactional data, and complex documentation.
  • You are passionate about building relationships with clients and providing exceptional client experiences.
  • You have an inherent interest in project planning, workstream management, and team leadership.
  • You communicate investigative findings clearly and objectively in written and oral formats.
  • You contribute to a positive team culture and create development opportunities for junior team members.
  • You pay close attention to scope, progress, risks, deadlines, and deliverable quality.
  • You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries.


Do Your Talents Include the Following?

  • Experience with or understanding of:
  • Leading defined workstreams within fraud, investigations, or regulatory enforcement matters from planning through delivery under engagement leadership.
  • Managing client-service workstream activities, timelines, and deliverables across one or more investigations.
  • Conducting fact-finding, evidence gathering, interviews, and financial transaction review to identify potentially irregular activity.
  • Applying forensic accounting, data analytics, e-discovery methods, and digital tools to support case development and analysis.
  • Reviewing records, reports, communications, and documentation to trace funds, test patterns, and connect key findings.
  • Supporting compliance risk assessments and reviews of regulatory requirements in complex environments.
  • Helping develop investigative approaches for matters involving corporate governance, financial records, cybersecurity concerns, or potential misconduct.
  • Analyzing data to identify and investigate discrepancies and performing follow-the-money procedures.
  • Preparing chronologies, workpapers, reports, exhibits, and client-ready presentations.
  • Coaching Consultants and Interns, reviewing work products, and building skills across investigative methods and technical analysis.
  • Communicating findings clearly to client stakeholders, counsel, and internal leadership in written and oral formats.
  • Monitoring assigned scope, budget, progress, risks, and dependencies while adapting to changing case requirements.
  • Working effectively with internal and external counsel, forensic accountants, technology professionals, and other consultants.
  • Evaluating, summarizing, organizing, and interpreting complex information.


Your Educational and Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Preferred fields of study include Accounting, Analytics or Data Science, Business Administration or Management, Computer Science or Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
  • Three to five years of relevant experience in forensic accounting, investigations, fraud review, regulatory matters, e-discovery, litigation support, compliance, or related professional services.
  • Experience owning substantial portions of investigative or forensic workstreams,
  • With appropriate oversight from engagement leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience with project planning, execution, deliverable tracking, and monitoring of assigned budgets or workstream economics.
  • Experience applying data analytics, evidence-gathering methods, and digital tools in investigative casework.
  • Demonstrated ability to review junior team members’ work and provide practical coaching.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to distill complex information into clear, supportable findings.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including experience presenting findings to clients or senior stakeholders.
  • CPA, CFE, CFF, ACEDS, Relativity, or other relevant certification preferred, but not required.
  • Prior consulting, accounting, legal, regulatory, or professional-services experience preferred.


Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements vary by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

Starting salary is based on a full-time equivalent schedule. Placement in the range is dependent upon experience, skills and geographic work location. Below is the salary range for this job.

$88,000.00 - $132,000.00

Our annual bonus plan provides eligible employees additional cash and/or discretionary stock compensation opportunities. Below is the bonus target opportunity for this job.

10%

The total cash range is estimated from the sum of the base salary range plus the bonus target opportunity. Below is the estimated total cash range for this job.

$96,800.00 - $145,200.00

Employees are eligible for medical, dental, and vision coverages, FSA and HSA healthcare accounts, life and accident insurance, adoption and fertility assistance, paid parental leave up to 10 weeks, and short/long term disability. We offer eligible employees a company 401(k) savings and investment plan with an employer match of 50% on the first 6% of your contributions. We provide Choice Time Off (CTO) for vacation, personal needs, and sick time. The amount of (CTO) varies based on years of service. New hires receive up to 20 days of CTO per calendar year. Protiviti also recognizes up to 11 paid holidays each calendar year.

Learn more about the variety of rewards we offer at Protiviti at .

Any benefits outlined are part of our reward offerings for full-time employees in the U.S. Your Open Enrollment materials, insurance contracts, plan documents and Summary Plan Descriptions together comprise the official plan document which legally governs the administration of your benefit plans. Protiviti reserves the right to terminate or amend your benefit plans in any way and at any time.

If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to apply for a position, please contact us by sending an email to HRSolutions@roberthalf.com or call 1.855.744.6947 for assistance.

### Description

**Click**[**here**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kC2EC-Ux-fE)**to learn more about the City of Tracy and**[**here**](https://www.cityoftracy.org/files/assets/city/v/1/human-resources/documents/recruitment-flyers/26-048-water-operations-supervisor.pdf) **for the job announcement.**

**TENTATIVE RECRUITMENT SCHEDULE** Application Deadline: **November 6, 2026 at 3:00 PM** In-Person Panel Interviews: **Week of November 16** In-Person Selection Interviews: **TBD**

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

The ideal Water Operations Supervisor is an experienced and collaborative leader with strong technical knowledge of water treatment operations, regulatory compliance, and facility maintenance. They excel in supervising staff, coordinating daily operations, and ensuring safe and reliable water service to the community. The ideal candidate is organized, motivated, and proactive, demonstrating sound judgment and the ability to make effective decisions under pressure. They lead by example, promote teamwork, and consistently support operational efficiency, problem solving, and high-quality service delivery.

**WHY CHOOSE CITY OF TRACY**

The City of Tracy offers **excellent pay**, including **4% COLA increases** in July 2027 and 2028. Employees approved to work a compressed work schedule also enjoy strong **work–life balance** through a **9/80 schedule**, providing a three-day weekend every other week.

Our **competitive benefits package** includes fully covered HMO Medical, Dental and Vision for employee + family, generous vacation and sick leave, life insurance, optional 457(b) deferred compensation with a City match, and longevity pay. We proudly participate in **CalPERS**, with employees enrolled in either the **2% @ 55** or **2% @ 62** formula based on eligibility, with retirement calculated using a **three-year final compensation average**.

For a full overview of everything we offer, **check out our Benefits section** to learn more about the programs and support available to City of Tracy employees. Together, these benefits reflect our commitment to **employee well-being, long-term stability, and rewarding career growth.**

**DEFINITION**

Under general direction, plans, schedules, assigns, reviews, and supervises the work of water treatment plant staff at the City’s water treatment plant; oversees the operation and maintenance of water treatment plant equipment and related facilities; ensures that water operations and maintenance functions meet all applicable laws, regulations, and City policies coordinates assigned activities with other City departments, contractors and outside agencies; and performs other duties as assigned.

**SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED**

Receives general direction from assigned supervisory or management staff. Exercises direct and general supervision over assigned staff.

**CLASS CHARACTERISTICS**

This is the full supervisory-level class in the Water Treatment Plant Operator series. Incumbents are responsible for planning, organizing, supervising, reviewing, and evaluating the work of staff and for providing technical support to management in an assigned service area. Performance of the work requires the use of independence, initiative, and discretion within established guidelines. The Water Operations Supervisor is distinguished from the Water Operations Superintendent class in that the duties of the former are performed primarily in the field overseeing and supervising work crews and the latter has overall management responsibility for activities of a given division within the Department.

### Essential and Marginal Duties

**EXAMPLES OF TYPICAL JOB FUNCTIONS (Illustrative Only)**

_Management reserves the right to add, modify, change, or rescind the work assignments of different positions and to make reasonable accommodations so that qualified employees can perform the essential functions of the job._

- Plans, organizes, assigns, supervises, and reviews the work of assigned staff; trains staff in work procedures and safe work practices; evaluates employee performance, counsels employees, and effectively recommends initial disciplinary action; assists in selection and promotion.
- Participates in the development of goals, objectives, policies, and procedures for assigned services and programs; recommends and implements policies and procedures including standard operating procedures for assigned operations.
- Monitors activities of the maintenance work unit; identifies opportunities for improving service delivery and procedures; provides recommendations concerning process changes; reviews with appropriate management staff; implements improvements.
- Coordinates assigned services and operations with those of other service areas, departments, outside agencies, and community groups.
- Participates in annual budget preparation; identifies and recommends future resource needs; prepares detailed cost estimates with appropriate justifications; monitors expenditures.
- Participates in the coordination of public water system maintenance projects; monitors supplies and equipment; orders supplies and tools as necessary; assist in the preparation of documents for equipment procurement; participates in the bid process for projects.
- Supervises the use and operation of tools, equipment, and vehicles; ensures that tools, equipment, and vehicles are safely operated, maintained, and secured when not in use; schedules service, repair, and replacement of tools, equipment, and vehicles.
- Coordinates the inspection of work in progress and completed work of contractors for accuracy, proper work methods and techniques, and compliance with applicable standards and specifications.
- Supervises the preparation and maintenance of reports, records, and files; ensures the proper documentation of projects and activities.
- Collaborates and confers with property owners, developers, architects, engineers, and contractors and other City staff in acquiring information and coordinating efforts in matters of areas assigned; provides information regarding City policies, procedures, codes, and ordinances.
- Monitors changes in regulations and technology that may affect public water system services; implements policy and procedural changes after approval.
- Answers questions and provides information to the public; investigates and responds to complaints and inquiries from citizens, other departments, and agencies; recommends corrective actions to resolve issues.
- Performs other duties as assigned.

### Minimum Qualifications

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Knowledge of:**

- Principles and practices of employee supervision, including work planning, assignment review and evaluation, discipline, and the training of staff in work procedures.
- Principles and techniques for working with groups and fostering effective team interaction to ensure teamwork is conducted smoothly.
- Basic principles and practices of budget administration and monitoring.
- Principles, practices, equipment, material and tools used in the operation, cleaning, and preventive maintenance of public water system including water treatment plant and equipment.
- The operation and preventive maintenance of piping systems, including pipes, valves, and related appurtenances.
- Standard chemical and physical tests of water and related materials.
- Principles and techniques of capital improvement construction, inspection, funding, and long-term maintenance.
- Applicable Federal and State laws, City, department, and division regulations, codes, policies, and procedures related to the operations and maintenance of the public water system.
- Techniques for effectively representing the City in contacts with governmental agencies, community groups, and various business, professional, regulatory, and legislative organizations.
- Principles and procedures of record keeping, technical report writing, and preparation of correspondence.
- Techniques for providing a high level of customer service by effectively dealing with the public, vendors, contractors, and City staff.
- The structure and content of the English language, including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition, and grammar.
- Modern equipment and communication tools used for business functions and program, project, and task coordination.
- Computers and software programs (e.g., Microsoft software packages) to conduct, compile, and/or generate documentation.

**Ability to:**

- Select and supervise staff, provide training and development opportunities, ensure work is performed effectively, and evaluate performance in an objective and positive manner.
- Assist in developing and implementing goals, objectives, practices, policies, procedures, and work standards.
- Organize, implement, and direct public water system maintenance programs and activities.
- Identify problems, research, and analyze relevant information, and develop and present recommendations and justification for solution.
- Coordinate the performance of the most difficult public water system maintenance duties.
- Research, analyze, and evaluate new service delivery methods, procedures, and techniques.
- Prepare clear and concise reports, correspondence, procedures, and other written materials.
- Maintain accurate records and files of work performed.
- Make accurate arithmetic and financial computations.
- Understand, interpret, and apply all pertinent laws, codes, regulations, policies and procedures, and standards relevant to work performed.
- Effectively represent the department and the City in meetings with individuals; governmental agencies; community groups; various business, professional, and regulatory organizations.
- Effectively use computer systems, software applications, and modern business equipment to perform a variety of work tasks.
- Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing, using appropriate English grammar and syntax.
- Use tact, initiative, prudence, and independent judgment within general policy, procedural, and legal guidelines.
- Establish, maintain, and foster positive and effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.

**Education and Experience:**

_Any combination of training and experience that would provide the required knowledge, skills, and abilities is qualifying.   A typical way to obtain the required qualifications would be:_

Equivalent to graduation from the twelfth (12th) grade and three (3) years of increasingly responsible journey level experience in a public water system including water treatment plant operations, including  at least two (2) years in a lead role. An associate degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in a field closely related and public sector experience is highly desirable.

**Licenses and Certifications:**

- Possession of, or the ability to obtain, a valid Class C California Driver’s License upon appointment.
- Possession and maintenance of a California SWRCB Water Treatment Plant Operator Grade IV certification is required at time of application.
- Possession and maintenance of a California SWRCB Water Treatment Plant Grade V is required within 24 months of appointment.
- Possession and maintenance of a California SWRCB Water Distribution Grade I certification is required within eighteen (18) months of appointment.
- Possession and maintenance of a California SWRCB Backflow Prevention Assembly Tester is highly desirable.
- May be required to complete National Incident Management System (NIMS) Training.

### Additional Information

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

Must possess mobility to work in a standard office setting and use standard office equipment; strength, stamina, and mobility to work in the field and perform medium to heavy physical work; to sit, stand, and walk on level, uneven, or slippery surfaces; frequently reach, twist, turn, kneel, bend, stoop, squat, crouch, grasp and make repetitive hand movement in the performance of daily duties; to climb and descend ladders, to operate varied hand and power tools and construction equipment, and to operate a motor vehicle and visit various City sites; and vision to inspect and operate equipment. The job involves fieldwork requiring frequent walking in operational areas to identify problems or hazards.  Finger dexterity is needed to operate and repair tools and equipment.   Employees must possess the ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials and objects averaging a weight of 50 pounds or heavier weights, in all cases with the use of proper equipment and/or assistance from other staff.

**ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS**

Employees work in an office environment and in the field and are exposed to loud noise levels, cold and hot temperatures, inclement weather conditions, road hazards, vibration, confining workspace, chemicals, mechanical and/or electrical hazards, and hazardous physical substances and fumes.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

Some positions may require working shifts and/or alternate schedules as needed.

**PRE-EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS**

Prior to hire, candidates must successfully complete a pre-employment process, which may include a reference check, DOJ/FBI fingerprinting and physical exam.

**RECRUITMENT ACCOMMODATIONS**

Accommodations may be made for disabilities and religious convictions. Applicants requiring testing accommodations must submit the **Request for Reasonable Accommodations Form** to the Human Resources Analyst by phone or email prior to the test date.

**DISCLAIMER**

The City of Tracy is an **equal opportunity employer**. Equal employment opportunity applies to all aspects of personnel policy and practice, including recruitment, hiring, development, advancement, and treatment of employees, to the extent permitted by law. **The City of Tracy reserves the right to revise the examination plan described in this flyer at any time to better meet organizational needs.**

title: Senior Failure Analysis Engineer, Medium Voltage Transformers and Switchgear
description:
Why Work at SMA America

Power the future. Build your career at SMA America.

As the U.S. subsidiary of SMA Solar Technology AG, we have been at the forefront of solar inverter technology since 1981, developing solutions that make photovoltaic power plants simpler, more reliable, safer, and more cost effective. Headquartered in Rocklin, California, SMA America has spent more than two decades helping homes, businesses, and utilities across the country generate clean, reliable power. We are the only inverter manufacturer in the world offering solutions for every system size, from residential rooftops to large scale utility plants, backed by more than 1,500 patents and a presence in over 190 countries.

Innovation is only part of the story. We invest in our people, create room to grow, challenge conventional thinking, and protect a culture where teammates genuinely care about each other and the work. We hire capable people and give them the space to do the job, with clear expectations, open door leadership, and real autonomy.

If you are passionate about driving positive change and want a career where you can take ownership of your work, we would love to meet you. Together, we are not just part of the energy transition, we are helping drive it forward.

Senior Failure Analysis Engineer, Medium Voltage Transformers and Switchgear

PURPOSE OF POSITION

The Senior Failure Analysis Engineer protects SMA’s customers and brand quality by personally investigating field failures on SMA’s medium voltage solutions, including transformers, switchgear, and converters, and driving each one to an evidence based root cause. This is a hands on engineering role focused on technical failure analysis at the equipment level. It is not a quality process or supplier quality position. Working with cross functional and international teams, including SMA’s global headquarters in Germany, the role drives sustainable corrective and preventive actions across the product lifecycle.

PRIMARY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead hands on field failure investigations on medium voltage equipment, including site inspection, electrical testing, teardown, and evidence collection.
  • Perform technical failure and data analyses, and determine the failure mechanism and specific root cause.
  • Apply the 8D method for systematic root cause identification.
  • Ensure analyses are evidence based, documented in compliance with standards and global processes, and aligned with the requirements of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Conduct initial site analyses and on site technical evaluations, and provide technical consultation.
  • Create detailed failure descriptions and collaborate with headquarters to advise and support other functions.
  • Recognize and document known failure patterns and provide technical expertise to resolve them.
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary and international teams to implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
  • Execute, monitor, and evaluate corrective actions implemented by service teams and suppliers, and confirm their effectiveness.
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Quality, Supplier Quality, and regional functions.
  • Maintain close collaboration with the analysis unit at SMA headquarters and the application engineering team in the U.S.
  • Travel approximately 20 to 30% to customer sites for failure investigation and fact gathering, and to the Rocklin, CA office and tradeshows as needed.
  • Other duties as may be required or assigned.

REQUIRED RELEVANT PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent education. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in research and development, technical failure analysis, and quality engineering, with a background in customer relations.
  • Hands on field failure investigation experience on medium voltage equipment, such as transformers, switchgear, or converters, is required and is the primary focus of this role. This experience may come from the solar or energy industry or from medium voltage work in another industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify the failure mechanism and specific root cause of a medium voltage equipment failure, using site evidence, electrical test results, and physical damage analysis.
  • Expertise in the 8D method for corrective action and quality tools including 5 Why, Ishikawa diagramming, and Pareto analysis.
  • Experience in solar, utility, power generation, or another industry where medium voltage equipment is in service.
  • Ability to present quality findings and corrective actions to senior leadership.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across cross functional and international teams.
  • Ability to travel approximately 20 to 30%, including to customer sites and the Rocklin, CA office.
  • Availability for occasional early morning meetings with headquarters in Germany.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English is required. Proficiency in German is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, is required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience performing or interpreting medium voltage electrical tests, such as insulation resistance, power factor, turns ratio, and dissolved gas analysis.
  • Experience with hermetically sealed equipment.
  • Working knowledge of SAP, Salesforce, and JIRA.

Extent of responsibility: Regional.

WE OFFER

  • Compensation: $106,000 to $150,000 per year, dependent on experience and qualifications, with flexibility above this range for a candidate who clearly exceeds the requirements.
  • Eligibility for a discretionary annual profit sharing bonus.
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, including $0 premium options.
  • Work Model: Remote within the United States. Hybrid or in office presence is preferred for candidates within commuting distance of our Rocklin, CA headquarters.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Tuition reimbursement and opportunities for professional development and training.
  • Inclusive, collaborative, and innovative work environment.
