Job Summary:

The Senior IT Analyst Technical Infrastructure, Flexera Technical and Data Quality, is responsible for the administration, integration, operational health, and data quality of Caterpillar's Software Asset Management (SAM)

platform. This role provides technical support for Flexera components including inventory agents, beacons, adapters, integrations, reconciliation processes, and supporting data pipelines. The incumbent identifies and resolves inventory, normalization, integration, and data quality issues to support software compliance, audit readiness, optimization, and software lifecycle decisions. The role partners closely with Software Asset Management, Infrastructure, Endpoint Management, Cybersecurity, ServiceNow, Data Engineering, and Compliance teams.


This role plays a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of enterprise software asset data. Success is measured through improved data quality, inventory accuracy, platform reliability, audit readiness, operational efficiency, and the delivery of actionable insights that enable informed software lifecycle and compliance decisions.

What you will do:

  • Administer, support, and continuously improve the Flexera platform, including inventory agents, beacons, integrations, business adapters, evidence rules, and related SAM capabilities.
  • Manage the health and reliability of software inventory data by monitoring inventory collection, reconciliation processes, data refreshes, integrations, and platform dependencies.
  • Serve as the technical subject matter expert for Flexera platform operations, troubleshooting complex issues related to agents, integrations, inventory processing, data quality, and system performance.
  • Design and implement data quality controls, validation processes, and root-cause analysis activities to improve the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and audit readiness of software asset data.
  • Partner with infrastructure, endpoint management, ServiceNow, cybersecurity, and source-system teams to resolve data and integration issues across enterprise technology platforms.
  • Analyze large datasets using SQL, Power BI, Excel, and automation technologies to identify trends, validate business rules, and deliver actionable insights that support software compliance, optimization, and lifecycle management.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reporting solutions, technical documentation, data lineage artifacts, and operational standards to support governance, transparency, and decision-making.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities using PowerShell, Python, Power Automate, APIs, and related technologies to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and data accuracy.
  • Evaluate and implement automation, reporting, and AI-enabled solutions that improve data quality, operational efficiency, and overall platform effectiveness.

What you will have:

  • Hardware Asset Management & Governance – Expertise in hardware asset lifecycle management, asset governance, CMDB/data quality, risk management, compliance, and enterprise controls that improve visibility, accountability, and audit readiness.
  • Process Optimization, Automation & Analytics – Drives process improvement through automation, standardization, and data-driven decision making using ServiceNow, Excel, SQL, and enterprise data sources to reduce complexity, improve efficiency, and mitigate risk.
  • Leadership, Collaboration & Problem Solving – Leads cross-functional initiatives, builds strong stakeholder relationships, translates complex concepts into actionable recommendations, and develops sustainable solutions through effective communication, collaboration, and mentorship.

Basic requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in information technology, computer science, data engineering, information systems, or a related field.
  • Pre-Advanced English.
  • Five or more years of experience supporting enterprise IT platforms, ITAM/SAM technologies, discovery systems, or data integrations.
  • Hands-on experience administering or technically supporting Flexera One, FlexNet Manager Suite, or a comparable enterprise SAM platform.
  • Experience managing or troubleshooting inventory agents, beacons, adapters, discovery feeds, APIs, and reconciliation processes.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large enterprise datasets.
  • Demonstrated experience identifying and resolving data-quality issues across integrated systems.
  • Experience with at least two relevant enterprise data sources, such as SCCM/MECM, Intune, ServiceNow CMDB, Jamf, Tanium, BigFix, or Snowflake.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical problems using logs, queries, monitoring information, data lineage, and root-cause analysis.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings, operational risk, and business impact to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience documenting configurations, support procedures, data rules, integration flows, and remediation actions.

Top candidates will also have:

  • Flexera One, FlexNet Manager Suite, or Flexera ITAM administration certification.
  • Flexera implementation, upgrade, or migration experience.
  • Experience with Flexera Business Adapters, inventory evidence configuration, recognition, and normalization.
  • Power BI dashboard development and data-modeling experience.
  • PowerShell or Python scripting experience.
  • Experience with Snowflake, APIs, Power Automate, or enterprise integration platforms.
  • Familiarity with software licensing, entitlements, license reconciliation, and ELP concepts.
  • ITIL Foundation, CSAM, CITAM, CHAMP, or other relevant ITAM/SAM certification.
  • Experience supporting audit-readiness, compliance, optimization, or vulnerability use cases.

Note: This position requires the candidate to work on-site five days a week.

title: Mechanical QA/QC Engineer – Data Centre
description:
Mechanical QA/QC Engineer – Data Centre (BH-4015)

Location Vaasa, Finland Sector Engineering Salary 80,000.00 EU per annum

Job title: Mechanical QA/QC Engineer – Data Centre. Location: Finland. Company: Irish Data Centre Main Contractor. Salary: Up to €80,000 DOE

The Company

This Irish main contractor specialises in the delivery of large scale data centre and mission critical projects across Ireland and mainland Europe. With a substantial pipeline of work across the Nordic region, they are strengthening their project teams in Finland and are looking for an experienced Mechanical QA/QC Engineer to support the delivery of a major data centre development in Finland.

The Role: Mechanical QA/QC Engineer

As Mechanical QA/QC Engineer, you will take responsibility for mechanical quality assurance and quality control across a major data centre project in Helsinki, Finland. Working closely with the Mechanical Construction Manager, project engineers, subcontractors and commissioning teams, you will ensure mechanical installations are completed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, ITPs and project quality requirements. The position will cover mechanical services including HVAC, pipework, cooling systems and associated building services installations, with involvement from installation and inspection through testing, commissioning and final handover.

Must Have Requirements

  • Must have previous Mechanical QA/QC experience on large scale construction, data centre, pharmaceutical or industrial projects.
  • Proven experience required inspecting mechanical installations and managing QA/QC documentation, ITPs and inspection records.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical building services, HVAC, pipework and associated systems is required.
  • Must be comfortable working on a large construction project in Finland within a structured QA/QC environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Data centre or mission critical project experience preferred.
  • Previous experience working with a main contractor or major M&E contractor beneficial.
  • Experience with digital quality management and construction documentation systems beneficial.
  • Previous experience working on European construction projects would be an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage mechanical QA/QC activities across the project and ensure installations comply with approved drawings, specifications and project quality standards.
  • Carry out inspections of mechanical installations including HVAC, pipework, cooling systems and associated building services.
  • Prepare, manage and close out Inspection and Test Plans, inspection records and supporting quality documentation.
  • Coordinate inspections with mechanical subcontractors, construction management and relevant project stakeholders.
  • Identify non-conforming works, raise and track NCRs and ensure corrective actions are completed and properly documented.
  • Review mechanical installation documentation, technical submittals, drawings and quality records to ensure compliance.
  • Support testing and commissioning activities and ensure the required QA/QC documentation is completed ahead of system handover.
  • Assist with punch lists, snagging, system completion and compilation of final mechanical handover dossiers.

About You

You will have a strong mechanical background with practical experience of QA/QC on large construction or engineering projects. You should understand how mechanical installations are delivered on site and be comfortable inspecting works, challenging poor quality and working directly with mechanical subcontractors to resolve issues. You will be organised and technically strong, with good attention to detail when managing ITPs, inspection records, NCRs and handover documentation. Experience on data centre projects would be particularly relevant, although candidates coming from pharmaceutical, semiconductor, advanced manufacturing or other technically demanding M&E environments will also be considered.

What’s on Offer

Salary: Upto €80,000 DOE

Benefits

  • Rotational working arrangement
  • Flights
  • Accommodation
  • Pension
  • Healthcare
  • Continued professional development
  • Long term European project opportunities
  • Career progression across major data centre projects

Job Title

QA/QC Mechanical - Data Centre

Job Description Summary

QA/QC Mechanical will be responsible to ensure the flawless execution, installation, and performance of all mechanical and precision cooling systems across the data center construction site. This role focuses on implementing rigorous quality assurance frameworks to guarantee that critical mission-critical infrastructure—such as heavy HVAC networks, chilled water systems, and fire suppression setups—strictly complies with international engineering standards, client specifications, and zero-downtime operational requirements.

Job Description

About the Role:

  • On-Site Inspections & Testing: Lead daily site inspections for all mechanical systems, including HVAC, chilled water piping, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC units, fire protection, and fuel oil systems, ensuring complete alignment with project specifications.
  • Quality Documentation Control: Review, approve, and manage critical quality records, including Method Statements, Requests for Inspection (RFI), material approval requests, and Test Reports to maintain audit readiness.
  • Equipment Verification (FAT/SAT): Participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and lead on-site Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for critical mechanical machinery, ensuring zero defects before final commissioning.
  • Defect Tracking & Resolution: Identify mechanical quality deviations, issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and closely track the implementation of corrective and preventive actions by subcontractors.
  • Material & Subcontractor Compliance: Inspect incoming mechanical materials and equipment against approved datasheets and technical submittals, ensuring subcontractors adhere strictly to international standards

About You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
  • Minimum 2–3 years in data centre or other mission‑critical facilities.
  • Experience managing contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary site teams.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a fast‑paced, high‑availability construction environment.

Job Description

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that Better Never Settles. We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally, and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

  • Weekly Pay

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance Team repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Safety: Promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures.
  • Maintenance: Complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation. Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more.
  • Monitoring: Create, assign, and close out work order with data including labor hours, equipment maintenance, and parts used. Track and store department inventory.
  • Support: Mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.
  • Communication: Maintain positive working relationships across all of the Operations facility.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment (MHE) or automated conveyor systems and controls.
  • 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures.
  • 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading.
  • 1+ years of knowledge with electrical and electronic principles.
  • Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project, with the ability to create and manage documents effectively.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus on Mechanical or Electrical field.
  • Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards.
  • Experience with robotic operation and maintenance.
  • Able to troubleshoot basic input and output functions.

Physical Demands:

  • Must have ability to reach overhead, kneel, squat, climb steps/ladders, use an aerial lift, and frequently lift a maximum of 50 lbs. of equipment.

• Our patients depend on the plasma we collect, so your reliability during your scheduled hours is greatly valued. However, our part-time roles are designed with the understanding that flexibility on both sides is key.


Whether you’re looking for extra income, a way to gain valuable experience, or a schedule that fits your busy life—BioLife welcomes part-time team members just like you! Start strong with our paid, interactive training program!

· Ability to lift to 5 lbs., and occasional lifting of materials up to 32 lbs. and rarely 50 lbs.
· Fine motor coordination, depth perception, and ability to hear equipment from a distance
· Because of potential exposure to bloodborne pathogens (risk level 1), 90% of work tasks require prolonged glove wear
· 1 or more years minimum experience working in a customer or patient facing role is helpful

What Takeda can offer you:
Every day at Takeda, we feel good knowing that what we do helps improve the lives of patients with rare diseases. At BioLife, while you focus on our donors, we will support you. We offer a purpose you can believe in, a team you can count on, opportunities for career growth, and a comprehensive benefits program to include retirement benefits, medical/dental, family leave, disability insurance and more, all in a fast-paced, friendly environment.

More about us:
At Takeda, we are transforming patient care through the development of novel specialty pharmaceuticals and best in class patient support programs. Takeda is a patient-focused company that will inspire and empower you to grow through life-changing work.
Certified as a Global Top Employer, Takeda offers stimulating careers, encourages innovation, and strives for excellence in everything we do. description:

Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. Job Overview
This role leads the team behind the AI platforms the whole enterprise relies on — the GenAI tools people use every day — and the self-service AI assistants’ employees reach for first when they need IT or HR help. It also owns something most platform roles do not: whether any of it gets used. Training, communications, line-of-business enablement, and the champion network sit on this team alongside the roadmap, so a release and the ability to use it land together.

That means real scope: multiple best-in-class platforms, one gateway, the models beneath them, the cost that keeps it all sustainable, the shared library where teams publish and reuse what has already been built, and the assistants that resolve employee requests in seconds instead of tickets. You own the experience across all of it, and you are accountable for holding it to the Un-carrier bar — bold, easy, and built for the people who use it. Success looks like an enterprise that works on our platforms because they are the best, not because they are mandated, and a workforce that knows how to use them.

  • 5+ years' experience of product management in an agile software development environment.
  • 3+ years' experience in a hands-on technical role writing production code, solution engineering, or technical architecture in a large-scale company/application/product environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in the development and deployment of technological products.
  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms, GenAI applications, AI assistants, platform adoption, or AI-related vendor management.

  • Conflict Management Coaching (Required)
  • Data Driven Decision Support (Required)
  • Product Management (Required)
  • Product Management Leadership (Required)
  • Software Product Management (Required)
  • Stakeholder Management (Required)
  • Strategic Thinking (Required)
  • Talent Management (Required)

  • AI Platform Adoption and Enablement
  • Enterprise Generative AI (GenAI) Platforms
  • AI Gateway and Model Management
  • AI Cost Management
  • Employee AI Assistants
  • Vendor Management
  • Change Management
  • Cross-Functional Project Management
  • Product Delivery

Licenses and Certifications:

  • Certified Product Manager (CPM): Certification from the Association of International Product Marketing and Management (AIPMM) that validates knowledge in product management and marketing principles. (Preferred)
  • Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO): Certification that demonstrates a deep understanding of Scrum practices and product ownership. (Preferred)
  • Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP): Certification from the International Institute of Business Analysis (IIBA) that recognizes experienced business analysts. (Preferred)
  • At least 18 years of age

title: SVP Legal- Litigation
description:
T-Mobile is in pursuit of exceptional talent to join our executive team. We’re committed to excellence and innovation, and we are on the lookout for a leader who can steer our company towards new heights of success. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for driving strategic initiatives and leading a talented team of professionals. The ideal candidate will possess a proven track record of success, demonstrating a keen ability to navigate complex challenges and capitalize on emerging opportunities. As a key member of our executive team, you will play a crucial role in shaping and executing our organizational strategy and contributing to our continued growth and market leadership. Join us in our commitment to driving innovation, inspiring collaboration, fostering a positive company culture, and achieving unparalleled success.

The Senior Vice President, Litigation, reporting to the Chief Legal Officer & General Counsel, will be responsible for leading the legal team focused on Government Investigations, Business & Consumer Litigation, Antitrust, Intellectual Property, Digital Information & Governance (DIG). The successful candidate will be a key member of the Legal Department leadership team and will work and partner closely with Senior Executive business leaders across the company. This leader must be a highly effective strategic thinker and tactical implementer with a history of delivering results. This SVP will lead and manage a large in-house team of professionals, along with a select group of outside counsel.

Un-carrier® Responsibilities

  • Active member of the Legal Affairs Leadership Team.
  • Builds and sustains a broad network of trusted relationships within T-Mobile, establishing a reputation for credibility, reliability, and collaborative partnership that amplifies their impact and the team’s effectiveness.
  • Build a broad network of trusted external relationships.
  • Has the analytical abilities, insights, and experience to counsel and guide the company on pressing legal, regulatory and compliance matters within their domain, including in consultation with GC.
  • Ensures the team has fluency in AI and drives adoption of technology (including AI) that can improve quality and cost-effectiveness within Legal Affairs group.
  • Actively drives the company’s business objectives related to their functional area with the tools, resources, and expertise available to the Legal Affairs department.
  • Helps convey the company’s strategic vision and culture to their team to activate and support a healthy, aligned, and highly effective department.
  • Assembles, leads, and inspires a talented and high-functioning leadership team.
  • The architect of organizational design strategies within their organization.
  • Has a vision for where their organization is headed and well-developed understanding of how the work of the department, and the demands it faces, may change, grow, or retract.
  • Manages budget, resources, and workforce planning strategies across their team and function, making informed trade-offs to optimize cost, quality, and business impact.
  • Communicates with clarity, conviction, and executive presence across a range of audiences and settings – adapting style and message to connect effectively whether speaking to their team, business clients, senior leadership, or external counterparts in their domain.
  • Operates with strong executive discipline – managing time, priorities, and workload with the structure and efficiency expected of a senior leader across a complex, high-demand portfolio.
  • Serves as a skilled and credible negotiator on legal matters within their domain, balancing legal risk and business objectives to drive favorable outcomes for the company.
  • Maintains deep and current expertise in Litigation, Labor and Employment, Antitrust & Intellectual Property, providing sound, practical legal counsel that reflects both command of the law and a sophisticated understanding of the business context in which legal issues arise.

The Experience You’ll Bring

  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree required and active state bar license.
  • 12+ years of extensive experience leading complex, high-stakes litigation, including matters involving billions of dollars in risk exposure.
  • Experience managing government investigations, antitrust matters, intellectual property, and labor & employment matters.
  • Demonstrated experience advising C-suite executives and senior leadership on legal strategy and risk mitigation.
  • Experience managing outside counsel relationships, negotiating outside counsel rates, and managing a legal department budget.
  • Proven experience leading and developing legal teams, including organizational design and succession planning.
  • Experience driving adoption of AI and other technologies within a legal function.

Enough about what you’ve done. Let’s talk about who you are.

  • Sophisticated, nuanced strategic thinking and sound legal judgment.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with and influence senior executives, driving alignment on complex, high-stakes issues.
  • Strong communicator, able to distill complex legal and risk topics for executive and board-level audiences.
  • Collaborative, yet decisive under pressure.
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and ownership over high-stakes decisions.
  • Agile and adaptive in a fast-changing legal, regulatory, and business environment.
  • Analytical problem solver who balances legal risk with business objectives.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple complex, concurrent matters.

A Day in the Life

Medtronic's Neuroscience portfolio is dedicated to helping people regain function, reduce pain, and improve quality of life through innovative therapies. Within Neuroscience, the Pelvic Health Operating Unit develops minimally invasive neuromodulation solutions that help patients manage bladder and bowel control conditions and achieve greater independence and confidence.

Our Pelvic Health operating unit advances care for bladder and bowel control conditions through restorative, minimally invasive neuromodulation therapies. By modulating sacral and peripheral nerves, we deliver personalized, programmable solutions backed by strong clinical evidence to help restore function and improve quality of life.

Located at Medtronic's headquarters in Minneapolis, MN, this role is onsite four days per week. Travel is not required for this role.

The Senior Engineering Program Manager leads large-scale technical programs that enable the successful delivery of digital platform initiatives. This role partners closely with engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to build integrated program plans, manage dependencies, drive execution, and ensure alignment across multiple teams. The position requires strong program leadership, technical acumen, and the ability to translate complex initiatives into actionable delivery plans.

  • Lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of strategic digital platform programs.

  • Lead roadmap planning, release planning, resource forecasting, and capacity planning activities to support predictable delivery.
  • Monitor program health through delivery metrics and milestone tracking, escalating issues and recommending corrective actions when needed.

  • Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of experience OR Advanced degree with 5+ years of experience leading cross-functional technical programs in software, cloud, digital, or enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience in program planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, and delivery execution.
  • Experience coordinating multiple engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders within a structured program framework.
  • Experience developing and managing integrated program plans, schedules, milestones, and delivery roadmaps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering mobile applications, web applications, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise information technology products.
  • Experience in Agile, Scrum, or hybrid software delivery environments.
  • Experience integrating digital products with enterprise systems, third-party platforms, or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions.
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies, application programming interfaces (APIs), microservices, and system integration architectures.

title: Dealer Sepcialist
description:
What’s Under the Hood

GoFi is an AI-centric, licensed auto finance company built for a digital-first world. Built upon an entirely cloud-based infrastructure, GoFi provides a highly scalable next-gen lending platform that enables the best brands to deliver the best customer experience. GoFi powers solutions ranging from traditional turn-down finance arrangements to fully integrated co-branded finance and digital retail partnerships. GoFi is based in Dallas, TX.

That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?

In short, as a Dealer Specialist, you will work in our Dallas Operation Center supporting our indirect auto finance sales efforts to our dealership relationships throughout the country. The specialist position is responsible for capturing deals that meet the company’s risk and profitability guidelines while building and maintaining professional and profitable relationships with dealer customers within an assigned territory.

This is a tremendous opportunity for a talented, sales-focused finance professional to work with an outstanding network of automotive dealers nationwide! Be part of a growing, dynamic, and innovative company in the near/subprime automotive lending space!

In long, our Dealer Specialist is responsible for:

  • Develop and maintain positive business relationships with dealers through daily conversations and solicitations; providing exceptional customer service, effective and timely communications and responsiveness to all credit processing questions and inquiries.
  • Communicate/follow-up on credit decisions to the dealer customer to drive incremental sales volume.
  • Educate dealer representatives on our program.
  • Work with the dealer representative to provide a deal structure that is acceptable to all parties to the deal.
  • Establish and track monthly purchase objectives for assigned dealers.
  • Assist Funding team with the resolution of documentation issues.

So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking for?

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. The ability to talk and write with confidence, charisma and competence for a wide variety of audiences including management.
  • Organization and time management skills in spades. You’ll be handling multiple projects and deadlines that will require you to prioritize then re-prioritize… then… re-prioritize again.
  • Operate autonomously. This isn’t a “hold your hand” kind of role. We give you autonomy to be creative in your space and do your thing. We need an individual that is self-motivated to get the work done and get the work done well.
  • Collaborative contributor. You need the ability to coordinate and brainstorm with team members while remaining an individual contributor to the team.
  • Expert in relationships! You’ve probably taken multiple personality assessments, know what Emotional Intelligence is, and pride yourself on your ability to build relationships based on mutual trust and respect.
  • Passionate and goal-oriented. We are looking for someone that is enthusiastic about their work and is passionate about not only meeting their goals but exceeding them.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit. An attitude and approach to thinking that actively seeks out change. You’ll need a mindset that embraces critical questioning, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Strategic thinker. We are looking for an individual that takes an insightful, future oriented, open-minded and proactive approach to thinking

The Specifics.

  • High school diploma or GED required; bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent work experience.
  • Must demonstrate professional, persuasive communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to maintain composure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong sales abilities with the capacity to think quickly, adapt in dynamic situations, and effectively overcome resistance.
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient computer skills, including familiarity with the internet and standard business applications such as Microsoft Office; ability to quickly learn new software as needed.
  • Minimum of 2+ years of experience in credit analysis, with a solid understanding of deal terms and agreements, APR, credit scores, and related concepts.

Nice to Haves.

  • Prior auto industry experience preferred.
  • Experience in dealership/vendor acquisition or development

So What About the Perks? Perks matter

  • Medical, dental, and vision, oh my! DriveTime Family of Brands covers a sizable amount of insurance premiums to ensure our employees receive top-tier healthcare coverage.
  • But Wait, There’s More. 401(K), Company paid life insurance policy, short and long-term disability coverage to name a few.
  • Growth Opportunities. You grow, I grow, we all grow! But seriously, DriveTime Family of Brands is committed to providing its employees with every opportunity to grow professionally with roughly over 1,000 employees promoted year over year.
  • Tuition Reimbursement. We’re as passionate about your professional development as you are. With that, we’ll put our money where our mouth is.
  • Wellness Program. Health is wealth! This program includes self-guided coaching and journeys, cash incentives and discounts on your medical premiums through engaging in fun activities!
  • Gratitude is Green. We offer competitive pay across the organization, because, well… money matters!
  • Game Room. Gimme a break – no, not a Kit Kat ad but we do have a ping-pong table, a pool table and other games if you ever need a break in your day.
  • In-House Gym. We want our employees to be the best versions of themselves. So come early, take a break in your day, or finish strong with a workout!
  • Enjoy Social Events? Bring it on. Rally with your team for festive gatherings, team competitions or just to hang out!
  • We Care and Value YOU! Feel the love and let us treat you to company outings, personal rewards, amazing prizes & much more!
  • Paid Time Off. Not just lip service: we work hard, to play hard! Paid time off includes (for all full-time roles) wellness days, holidays, and good ole' fashioned YOU time! For our Part-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available - the more you work, the more you earn!

Anything Else? Absolutely.

DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)!

Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug-free, tobacco-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.


And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high-energy environment!

title: Principal Technical Program Manager - Computer Vision
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Motorola Solutions' innovations, products, and services play essential roles in people's lives. Our end-to-end suite of software solutions helps customers manage emergency communications, process video and evidence, and leverage cutting-edge AI-driven analytics for security and operational insights. We are industry leaders in video security and analytics, with solutions deployed in more than 120 countries across diverse environments such as school campuses, transportation systems, healthcare centers, public venues, critical infrastructure, prisons, factories, casinos, airports, financial institutions, government facilities, and retailers.
Our AI-powered security solutions integrate advanced video analytics, machine learning, and embedded intelligence to enable proactive threat detection, enhanced situational awareness, and automated decision-making.


Job Description

Reporting to the VP of AI for Motorola Solutions, the Principal Technical Program Manager - Computer Vision will be a critical, high-impact leader who thrives on turning highly ambiguous concepts into enterprise-scale Computer Vision solutions. They will be responsible for defining and driving the strategy, roadmap, and measurable success of our core Computer Vision Platform. This role is pivotal in partnering with internal product leaders to define the platform's requirements and drive the adoption of central AI models and foundational AI infrastructure across Motorola's product portfolio. This includes technical program management for our enterprise-scale cloud and edge AI platforms, ensuring our AI investments translate into quantifiable, improved customer and business outcomes. This role also includes product ownership for select end-to-end computer vision-based products.

Key Responsibilities
The Principal Technical Program Manager will own the strategy, definition, and roadmap across the following core areas, with an emphasis on the Computer Vision Platform:

  • Platform Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for the Computer Vision Platform, ensuring alignment with Motorola Solutions' overall product portfolio and strategic business goals.
  • Internal Partner Management & Alignment: Serve as the primary product leader for the platform, engaging with internal product leaders and teams across Motorola to understand their computer vision needs, define platform requirements (APIs, capabilities, scalability), and drive adoption of platform services.
  • Product Definition & Requirements: Author high-quality Market Requirements Documents (MRDs), Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), and user stories for core platform capabilities (e.g., model serving, data pipelines, edge-to-cloud synchronization) and for select end-to-end computer vision products.
  • AI Model Lifecycle Ownership: Own the product lifecycle for central, reusable computer vision models and foundational AI infrastructure, from ideation and research collaboration through deployment, adoption, and deprecation.
  • Platform Success Metrics: Define, implement, and track key business, customer, and technical metrics (e.g., platform adoption, performance, latency, cost-efficiency, and quantifiable customer outcomes) to measure the success and health of the platform and drive continuous improvement.
  • Market & Customer Insights: Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer/partner discovery along with Product Management team to identify new opportunities, validate product concepts, and inform strategic build-versus-buy decisions.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of technical program management experience, with a focus on platform products, AI/ML, or complex, cross-functional technical domains.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as an individual contributor building machine learning models, production ML pipelines, computer vision algorithms, or software engineering for ML or data-oriented products.
  • Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of computer vision and machine learning, machine learning lifecycle (MLOps), data platforms, and the challenges of building and deploying central, reusable AI infrastructure and models. Demonstrated ability to engage in technical discussions with engineering teams, understand architectural trade-offs, and define clear, measurable product requirements.
  • Product Strategy & Metrics: Proven experience defining product vision, strategy, and roadmaps. Expertise in defining and implementing metrics frameworks (KPIs, OKRs) to measure product success (adoption, revenue, customer value) and drive organizational change and accountability.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience working with AI performance metrics (e.g., Precision/Recall), real-time video processing, and inference optimization.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to operate at a Principal level, influence senior leaders across organizations, drive consensus, and communicate complex technical and strategic concepts clearly and concisely, including presenting roadmap elements and business cases.
  • Customer-focused with a track record of building strong relationships and conducting early-stage discovery to understand internal and external customer needs.
  • Domain Knowledge: Experience in video analytics for security or for retail or manufacturing operations is a plus.
  • Pathfinding: Experience bringing initial definition to "highly ambiguous" product concepts and conducting early-stage discovery for emergent initiatives.

Target Base Salary Range: $180,000 USD - $220,000 USD

  • AND 3+ years of hands-on experience as an individual contributor building machine learning models, production ML pipelines, computer vision algorithms, or software engineering for ML or data-oriented products.

title: Service Officer - Christchurch
description:
Working with the AA | Me mahi tahi tatou ki AA

For over 120 years the AA have been helping Kiwis on their adventures! Today, we're one of New Zealand's most respected and trusted brands. From our humble beginnings as a motoring enthusiast's club, the New Zealand AA (Automobile Association) has grown into a large, dynamic organisation offering many services and products to more than a million Members.

And now, we’re building the organisation of the future – more connected, modern, and purpose-driven. In this role, you will:

You’re a confident, customer-focused automotive professional who thrives on problem-solving and helping people in moments of need. You take pride in your trade skills, work well under pressure, and bring a calm, professional approach to every situation.

  • Training available / career development
  • Discounted insurance

Here, we offer a lot more than roadside assistance. We're constantly evolving and advancing into new businesses, offering new challenges and a range of opportunities.

If you’re ready to put your automotive skills to work making a real difference for Kiwi drivers every day, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and become part of a proud team that’s been supporting life’s journeys for over 100 years.

Our teams celebrate diversity and believe that everyone should be able to bring their true selves to work every day.
